```text
1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"net/http"
9		"os"
10		"sort"
11		"strings"
12		"sync"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/agnivade/levenshtein"
16	)
17	
18	// suggestLimit caps the number of ranked "did you mean" candidates on a miss.
19	const suggestLimit = 7
20	
21	// DictConfig configures the dictionary engine.
22	type DictConfig struct {
23		Endpoint string // base, e.g. https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries
24		Lang     string // e.g. "en"
25		Fuzzy    bool
26		Wordlist string // path to a newline word list; "" => /usr/share/dict/words
27		Timeout  time.Duration
28	}
29	
30	// DictEngine looks up word definitions via the Free Dictionary API, with an
31	// exact match first and a local fuzzy (nearest-headword) fallback on 404.
32	type DictEngine struct {
33		cfg  DictConfig
34		wl   *wordIndex
35		http *http.Client
36	}
37	
38	// NewDict builds a dictionary engine.
39	func NewDict(cfg DictConfig) *DictEngine {
40		if cfg.Endpoint == "" {
41			cfg.Endpoint = "https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries"
42		}
43		if cfg.Lang == "" {
44			cfg.Lang = "en"
45		}
46		if cfg.Timeout == 0 {
47			cfg.Timeout = 5 * time.Second
48		}
49		path := cfg.Wordlist
50		if path == "" {
51			path = "/usr/share/dict/words"
52		}
53		return &DictEngine{cfg: cfg, wl: &wordIndex{path: path}, http: &http.Client{Timeout: cfg.Timeout}}
54	}
55	
56	// Name returns "dictionary".
57	func (e *DictEngine) Name() string { return "dictionary" }
58	
59	// Supports reports that this engine handles dictionary lookups only.
60	func (e *DictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }
61	
62	// Detect is not meaningful for the dictionary engine.
63	func (e *DictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) { return "", nil }
64	
65	// Available probes the API with a common word.
66	func (e *DictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
67		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1500*time.Millisecond)
68		defer cancel()
69		_, status, err := e.fetch(ctx, "test")
70		return err == nil && status == http.StatusOK
71	}
72	
73	// Translate performs a dictionary lookup (exact, then fuzzy on 404).
74	func (e *DictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
75		word := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
76		if word == "" {
77			return nil, ErrEmptyInput
78		}
79	
80		entry, status, err := e.fetch(ctx, word)
81		if err == nil && status == http.StatusOK && entry != nil {
82			return single(e.result(entry, req), nil), nil
83		}
84		if err != nil {
85			return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err)), nil
86		}
87	
88		// 404: return a ranked "did you mean" list (the frontend chooses one). Gated
89		// to English because the bundled wordlist (/usr/share/dict/words) is English.
90		if status == http.StatusNotFound && e.cfg.Fuzzy && strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(e.cfg.Lang), "en") {
91			if cands, best := e.wl.nearestN(word, 2, suggestLimit); len(cands) > 0 {
92				return single(&TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: e.Name(), Suggestions: cands, SuggestDistance: best}, nil), nil
93			}
94		}
95		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word)), nil
96	}
97	
98	func (e *DictEngine) result(entry *DictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
99		return &TranslateResult{
100			Translation: entry.gloss(),
101			Target:      req.Target,
102			Engine:      e.Name(),
103			Dictionary:  entry,
104		}
105	}
106	
107	// --- Free Dictionary API wire types ---
108	
109	type apiEntry struct {
110		Word       string        `json:"word"`
111		Phonetic   string        `json:"phonetic"`
112		Phonetics  []apiPhonetic `json:"phonetics"`
113		Meanings   []apiMeaning  `json:"meanings"`
114		SourceURLs []string      `json:"sourceUrls"`
115	}
116	type apiPhonetic struct {
117		Text string `json:"text"`
118	}
119	type apiMeaning struct {
120		PartOfSpeech string          `json:"partOfSpeech"`
121		Definitions  []apiDefinition `json:"definitions"`
122		Synonyms     []string        `json:"synonyms"`
123		Antonyms     []string        `json:"antonyms"`
124	}
125	type apiDefinition struct {
126		Definition string `json:"definition"`
127		Example    string `json:"example"`
128	}
129	
130	// fetch requests one word; returns (entry, httpStatus, err). A 404 yields
131	// (nil, 404, nil) so the caller can trigger the fuzzy fallback.
132	func (e *DictEngine) fetch(ctx context.Context, word string) (*DictEntry, int, error) {
133		u := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s", strings.TrimRight(e.cfg.Endpoint, "/"), e.cfg.Lang, urlPathEscape(word))
134		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, u, nil)
135		if err != nil {
136			return nil, 0, err
137		}
138		resp, err := e.http.Do(req)
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, 0, err
141		}
142		defer resp.Body.Close()
143		if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
144			_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
145			return nil, http.StatusNotFound, nil
146		}
147		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
148			body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 512))
149			return nil, resp.StatusCode, fmt.Errorf("http %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
150		}
151		var entries []apiEntry
152		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&entries); err != nil {
153			return nil, resp.StatusCode, fmt.Errorf("decode: %w", err)
154		}
155		if len(entries) == 0 {
156			return nil, http.StatusNotFound, nil
157		}
158		return mergeEntries(entries), http.StatusOK, nil
159	}
160	
161	// mergeEntries folds the API's per-entry results into one DictEntry.
162	func mergeEntries(entries []apiEntry) *DictEntry {
163		out := &DictEntry{Word: entries[0].Word}
164		for _, en := range entries {
165			if out.Phonetic == "" && en.Phonetic != "" {
166				out.Phonetic = en.Phonetic
167			}
168			for _, p := range en.Phonetics {
169				if out.Phonetic == "" && p.Text != "" {
170					out.Phonetic = p.Text
171				}
172			}
173			for _, m := range en.Meanings {
174				meaning := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: m.PartOfSpeech, Synonyms: m.Synonyms, Antonyms: m.Antonyms}
175				for _, d := range m.Definitions {
176					meaning.Definitions = append(meaning.Definitions, Definition{Text: d.Definition, Example: d.Example})
177				}
178				out.Meanings = append(out.Meanings, meaning)
179			}
180			if out.SourceURL == "" && len(en.SourceURLs) > 0 {
181				out.SourceURL = en.SourceURLs[0]
182			}
183		}
184		return out
185	}
186	
187	// gloss returns a short one-line definition for history/plain display.
188	func (d *DictEntry) gloss() string {
189		for _, m := range d.Meanings {
190			for _, def := range m.Definitions {
191				if def.Text != "" {
192					return def.Text
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		return d.Word
197	}
198	
199	func urlPathEscape(s string) string {
200		// dictionary words are simple; escape spaces defensively.
201		return strings.ReplaceAll(s, " ", "%20")
202	}
203	
204	// --- local fuzzy word index ---
205	
206	type wordIndex struct {
207		path  string
208		once  sync.Once
209		words []string
210	}
211	
212	func (wi *wordIndex) load() {
213		wi.once.Do(func() {
214			b, err := os.ReadFile(wi.path)
215			if err != nil {
216				return // no wordlist: fuzzy silently disabled
217			}
218			for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
219				w := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
220				if w != "" {
221					wi.words = append(wi.words, w)
222				}
223			}
224		})
225	}
226	
227	// nearestN returns up to n headwords within maxDist edits of word, closest first
228	// (ties broken alphabetically), excluding word itself. The second return is the
229	// best (smallest) edit distance among the results, or 0 when there are none.
230	func (wi *wordIndex) nearestN(word string, maxDist, n int) ([]string, int) {
231		wi.load()
232		type cand struct {
233			w string
234			d int
235		}
236		var cs []cand
237		for _, w := range wi.words {
238			if w == word || abs(len(w)-len(word)) > maxDist {
239				continue
240			}
241			if d := levenshtein.ComputeDistance(word, w); d <= maxDist {
242				cs = append(cs, cand{w, d})
243			}
244		}
245		sort.Slice(cs, func(i, j int) bool {
246			if cs[i].d != cs[j].d {
247				return cs[i].d < cs[j].d
248			}
249			return cs[i].w < cs[j].w
250		})
251		if len(cs) > n {
252			cs = cs[:n]
253		}
254		out := make([]string, len(cs))
255		for i, c := range cs {
256			out[i] = c.w
257		}
258		best := 0
259		if len(cs) > 0 {
260			best = cs[0].d // slice is sorted by distance ascending
261		}
262		return out, best
263	}
264	
265	func abs(n int) int {
266		if n < 0 {
267			return -n
268		}
269		return n
270	}
271

1	package store
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/rand"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"encoding/json"
8		"os"
9		"path/filepath"
10		"strconv"
11		"strings"
12		"sync"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/sahilm/fuzzy"
16	)
17	
18	// jsonlStore is an append-only JSONL-backed Store with in-memory fuzzy search.
19	type jsonlStore struct {
20		path string
21		mu   sync.Mutex
22	}
23	
24	// OpenJSONL opens (creating parent dirs for) a JSONL history file.
25	func OpenJSONL(path string) (Store, error) {
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
27			return nil, err
28		}
29		return &jsonlStore{path: path}, nil
30	}
31	
32	func (s *jsonlStore) Close() error { return nil }
33	
34	// Add stamps the record with an id + timestamp and appends it as one JSON line.
35	func (s *jsonlStore) Add(ctx context.Context, r Record) (Record, error) {
36		if r.ID == "" {
37			r.ID = newID()
38		}
39		if r.TS.IsZero() {
40			r.TS = time.Now()
41		}
42		line, err := json.Marshal(r)
43		if err != nil {
44			return r, err
45		}
46	
47		s.mu.Lock()
48		defer s.mu.Unlock()
49		f, err := os.OpenFile(s.path, os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
50		if err != nil {
51			return r, err
52		}
53		defer f.Close()
54		// Serialize appends across processes too (server + CLI): the in-process mutex
55		// only covers this process.
56		unlock, err := lockFile(f)
57		if err != nil {
58			return r, err
59		}
60		defer unlock()
61		if _, err := f.Write(append(line, '\n')); err != nil {
62			return r, err
63		}
64		return r, nil
65	}
66	
67	// readAll loads every record in chronological (file) order.
68	func (s *jsonlStore) readAll() ([]Record, error) {
69		s.mu.Lock()
70		defer s.mu.Unlock()
71		b, err := os.ReadFile(s.path)
72		if err != nil {
73			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
74				return nil, nil
75			}
76			return nil, err
77		}
78		var out []Record
79		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
80			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
81			if line == "" {
82				continue
83			}
84			var r Record
85			if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &r) == nil {
86				out = append(out, r)
87			}
88		}
89		return out, nil
90	}
91	
92	// Recent returns up to limit records, newest first.
93	func (s *jsonlStore) Recent(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]Record, error) {
94		all, err := s.readAll()
95		if err != nil {
96			return nil, err
97		}
98		reverse(all)
99		if limit > 0 && len(all) > limit {
100			all = all[:limit]
101		}
102		return all, nil
103	}
104	
105	// Search fuzzy-ranks records by "input ⏎ output", best match first.
106	func (s *jsonlStore) Search(ctx context.Context, query string, limit int) ([]Record, error) {
107		all, err := s.readAll()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		q := strings.TrimSpace(query)
112		if q == "" {
113			reverse(all)
114			if limit > 0 && len(all) > limit {
115				all = all[:limit]
116			}
117			return all, nil
118		}
119		hay := make([]string, len(all))
120		for i, r := range all {
121			hay[i] = r.Input + " " + r.Output
122		}
123		matches := fuzzy.Find(q, hay)
124		out := make([]Record, 0, len(matches))
125		for _, m := range matches {
126			out = append(out, all[m.Index])
127			if limit > 0 && len(out) >= limit {
128				break
129			}
130		}
131		return out, nil
132	}
133	
134	func reverse(rs []Record) {
135		for i, j := 0, len(rs)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
136			rs[i], rs[j] = rs[j], rs[i]
137		}
138	}
139	
140	// newID is a sortable-enough unique id: base36 nanos + 4 random bytes.
141	func newID() string {
142		var b [4]byte
143		_, _ = rand.Read(b[:])
144		return strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 36) + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b[:])
145	}

57	// loadHistory opens the store and runs a query, handling the disabled case.
58	func loadHistory(cmd *cobra.Command, query func(store.Store) ([]store.Record, error)) ([]store.Record, error) {
59		cfg, _, err := config.Load()
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		st := openStore(cfg)
64		if st == nil {
65			return nil, fmt.Errorf("history is disabled in %s", config.Path())
66		}

68		return query(st)

71	func printRecords(recs []store.Record, tsv bool) error {
72		if flagJSON {
73			enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
74			enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
75			return enc.Encode(recs)
76		}
77		if tsv {
78			for _, r := range recs {
79				fmt.Printf("%s\t%s\t%s>%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n",
80					r.ID, r.TS.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05"),
81					r.SourceLang, r.TargetLang, r.Engine,
82					escapeTSV(r.Input), escapeTSV(r.Output))
83			}
84			return nil
85		}
86		w := tabwriter.NewWriter(os.Stdout, 0, 2, 2, ' ', 0)
87		for _, r := range recs {
88			fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s→%s\t%s\t→ %s\t(%s)\n",
89				r.SourceLang, r.TargetLang, oneline(r.Input, 40), oneline(r.Output, 40), r.Engine)
90		}
91		return w.Flush()
92	}
93	
94	func escapeTSV(s string) string {
95		r := strings.NewReplacer("\t", " ", "\n", " ", "\r", " ")
96		return r.Replace(s)
97	}
98	
99	func oneline(s string, n int) string {
100		s = strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(s), "\n", " ")
101		rs := []rune(s)
102		if len(rs) <= n {
103			return s
104		}
105		return string(rs[:n-1]) + "…"
106	}

13	// LocalDictConfig configures the offline bilingual dictionary engine.
14	type LocalDictConfig struct {
15		Dir          string
16		CedictURL    string
17		EcdictURL    string
18		AutoDownload bool        // auto-fetch CC-CEDICT (small) on first Chinese lookup
19		Fuzzy        bool        // emit ranked suggestions on a miss

24	// LocalDictEngine looks up definitions offline: Chinese → CC-CEDICT (zh→en),
25	// English → ECDICT (en→zh). It satisfies the Engine interface and maps results
26	// into the same DictEntry/Suggestions shape the TUI already renders.
27	type LocalDictEngine struct {
28		cfg LocalDictConfig
29		ce  *cedictIndex
30		ec  *ecdictDB
31		wl  *wordIndex // /usr/share/dict/words, for English "did you mean"
32	}

34	// NewLocalDict builds a local bilingual dictionary engine.
35	func NewLocalDict(cfg LocalDictConfig) *LocalDictEngine {
36		return &LocalDictEngine{
37			cfg: cfg,
38			ce:  newCedictIndex(CedictPath(cfg.Dir)),
39			ec:  newEcdictDB(EcdictDBPath(cfg.Dir)),
40			wl:  &wordIndex{path: "/usr/share/dict/words"},
41		}
42	}

45	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }

47	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) {
48		return "", nil
49	}

51	// Available reports true if at least one data source (or the API fallback) is usable.
52	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
53		if fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) || e.ec.available() {
54			return true
55		}
56		if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
57			return e.cfg.APIFallback.Available(ctx)
58		}
59		return false
60	}

62	// Translate routes by script: Chinese → CC-CEDICT, else → ECDICT.
63	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
64		word := strings.TrimSpace(req.Text)
65		if word == "" {
66			return nil, ErrEmptyInput
67		}
68		if lang.IsChinese(word) {
69			return e.lookupZh(ctx, word, req), nil
70		}
71		return e.lookupEn(ctx, word, req), nil
72	}

74	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupZh(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
75		if !fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) {
76			if e.cfg.AutoDownload {
77				if err := DownloadCedict(ctx, e.cfg.CedictURL, CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir), nil); err != nil {
78					return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
79				}
80			} else {
81				return single(notInstalled(req, "CC-CEDICT not installed — run `translate dict update cedict`"), nil)
82			}
83		}
84		if entries := e.ce.lookup(word); len(entries) > 0 {
85			return single(cedictResult(word, entries, req), nil)
86		}
87		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
88			if sugg := e.ce.prefixSuggest(word, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
89				// CC-CEDICT prefix matches carry no edit distance → 0 (unknown).
90				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, 0), nil)
91			}
92		}
93		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
94	}
95	
96	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupEn(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
97		if !e.ec.available() {
98			// No ECDICT yet: fall back to dictionaryapi.dev (English defs) if enabled.
99			if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
100				ch, err := e.cfg.APIFallback.Translate(ctx, req)
101				if err == nil {
102					return ch
103				}
104			}
105			return single(notInstalled(req, "ECDICT not installed — run `translate dict update ecdict`"), nil)
106		}
107		en, err := e.ec.lookup(ctx, word)
108		if err != nil {
109			return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
110		}
111		if en != nil {
112			return single(ecdictResult(en, req), nil)
113		}
114		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
115			if sugg, best := e.wl.nearestN(strings.ToLower(word), 2, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
116				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, best), nil)
117			}
118		}
119		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
120	}
121	
122	// --- result mapping into the existing DictEntry / Suggestions shape ---
123	
124	func cedictResult(word string, entries []*cedictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
125		d := &DictEntry{Word: word}
126		if len(entries) > 0 {
127			d.Phonetic = entries[0].Pinyin
128		}
129		for _, en := range entries {
130			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: en.Pinyin}
131			for _, def := range en.Defs {
132				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: def})
133			}
134			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
135		}
136		gloss := ""
137		if len(entries) > 0 && len(entries[0].Defs) > 0 {
138			gloss = entries[0].Defs[0]
139		}
140		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
141	}
142	
143	func ecdictResult(en *ecdictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
144		d := &DictEntry{Word: en.Word, Phonetic: en.Phonetic}
145		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
146			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "中文"}
147			for _, line := range zh {
148				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
149			}
150			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
151		}
152		if de := splitEcdict(en.Definition); len(de) > 0 {
153			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "definition"}
154			for _, line := range de {
155				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
156			}
157			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
158		}
159		gloss := ""
160		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
161			gloss = zh[0]
162		}
163		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
164	}

10	
11	type ecdictEntry struct {
12		Word, Phonetic, Translation, Definition string
13	}
14	
15	// ecdictDB queries the locally-built ECDICT SQLite (English → Chinese). Point
16	// lookups are on-disk (near-zero steady-state RAM). Opened lazily.
17	type ecdictDB struct {
18		path string
19		once sync.Once
20		err  error
21		db   *sql.DB
22	}
23	
24	func newEcdictDB(path string) *ecdictDB { return &ecdictDB{path: path} }
25	
26	func (e *ecdictDB) available() bool {
27		_, err := os.Stat(e.path)
28		return err == nil
29	}
30	
31	func (e *ecdictDB) open() error {
32		e.once.Do(func() {
33			if _, err := os.Stat(e.path); err != nil {
34				e.err = err
35				return
36			}
37			db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+e.path+"?_pragma=query_only(true)")
38			if err != nil {
39				e.err = err
40				return
41			}
42			e.db = db
43		})
44		return e.err
45	}
46	
47	// lookup returns the exact (case-insensitive) entry, or nil if not found.
48	func (e *ecdictDB) lookup(ctx context.Context, word string) (*ecdictEntry, error) {
49		if err := e.open(); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		row := e.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,
53			`SELECT word, phonetic, translation, definition FROM entries WHERE word_lc = ? LIMIT 1`,
54			strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(word)))
55		var en ecdictEntry
56		switch err := row.Scan(&en.Word, &en.Phonetic, &en.Translation, &en.Definition); err {
57		case nil:
58			return &en, nil
59		case sql.ErrNoRows:
60			return nil, nil
61		default:
62			return nil, err
63		}
64	}
65	
66	// splitEcdict splits ECDICT translation/definition fields — their senses are
67	// joined by a literal backslash-n, not a real newline.
68	func splitEcdict(s string) []string {
69		var out []string
70		for _, p := range strings.Split(s, `\n`) {
71			if p = strings.TrimSpace(p); p != "" {
72				out = append(out, p)
73			}
74		}
75		return out
76	}

1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"bufio"
5		"os"
6		"regexp"
7		"sort"
8		"strings"
9		"sync"
10	)
11	
12	// cedictLine matches: Traditional Simplified [pin1 yin1] /def1/def2/
13	var cedictLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+\[([^\]]*)\]\s+/(.*)/\s*$`)
14	
15	type cedictEntry struct {
16		Trad, Simp, Pinyin string
17		Defs               []string
18	}
19	
20	// cedictIndex is an in-memory CC-CEDICT (Chinese → English), keyed on both the
21	// traditional and simplified forms. Loaded lazily on first lookup.
22	type cedictIndex struct {
23		path  string
24		once  sync.Once
25		err   error
26		byKey map[string][]*cedictEntry
27		keys  []string // sorted, for prefix suggestions
28	}
29	
30	func newCedictIndex(path string) *cedictIndex { return &cedictIndex{path: path} }
31	
32	func (ci *cedictIndex) load() error {
33		ci.once.Do(func() {
34			f, err := os.Open(ci.path)
35			if err != nil {
36				ci.err = err
37				return
38			}
39			defer f.Close()
40			ci.byKey = map[string][]*cedictEntry{}
41			sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
42			sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64<<10), 1<<20)
43			for sc.Scan() {
44				line := sc.Text()
45				if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
46					continue
47				}
48				m := cedictLine.FindStringSubmatch(line)
49				if m == nil {
50					continue
51				}
52				e := &cedictEntry{Trad: m[1], Simp: m[2], Pinyin: m[3]}
53				for _, d := range strings.Split(m[4], "/") {
54					if d = strings.TrimSpace(d); d != "" {
55						e.Defs = append(e.Defs, d)
56					}
57				}
58				ci.byKey[e.Simp] = append(ci.byKey[e.Simp], e)
59				if e.Trad != e.Simp {
60					ci.byKey[e.Trad] = append(ci.byKey[e.Trad], e)
61				}
62			}
63			ci.err = sc.Err()
64			ci.keys = make([]string, 0, len(ci.byKey))
65			for k := range ci.byKey {
66				ci.keys = append(ci.keys, k)
67			}
68			sort.Strings(ci.keys)
69		})
70		return ci.err
71	}
72	
73	func (ci *cedictIndex) lookup(word string) []*cedictEntry {
74		if ci.load() != nil {
75			return nil
76		}
77		return ci.byKey[word]
78	}
79	
80	// prefixSuggest returns up to n headwords beginning with word (excluding it).
81	// Chinese uses prefix, not edit distance (CJK edit distance is noisy).
82	func (ci *cedictIndex) prefixSuggest(word string, n int) []string {
83		if ci.load() != nil {
84			return nil
85		}
86		i := sort.SearchStrings(ci.keys, word)
87		var out []string
88		for ; i < len(ci.keys) && len(out) < n; i++ {
89			k := ci.keys[i]
90			if !strings.HasPrefix(k, word) {
91				break
92			}
93			if k != word {
94				out = append(out, k)
95			}
96		}
97		return out
98	}
99

1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"context"

8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/debug"

12	// SmartDictConfig parameterizes the smart-dict engine.
13	type SmartDictConfig struct {
14		// CloseDistance is the English edit distance at/below which a fuzzy "did you
15		// mean" is treated as a likely typo and returned as-is; a farther match (and
16		// any hard miss) triggers the LLM fallback. 0 disables the typo shortcut, so
17		// every non-exact lookup falls back.
18		CloseDistance int
19		// Preset is the LLM prompt style used for the fallback; "" => PresetDictionary
20		// (a gloss plus example sentences).
21		Preset string
22	}
23	
24	// SmartDictEngine composes a dictionary engine with an LLM: it answers from the
25	// dictionary when it can, and falls back to the LLM when the word is missing or the
26	// fuzzy match is too far off. It is a distinct, selectable engine — the plain
27	// dictionary engine is left untouched.
28	//
29	// This is the first engine to branch on a produced result's quality (the Chain
30	// only fails over on hard errors), so the fallback always stamps a Warning: the
31	// downgrade from an offline lookup to an LLM answer is never silent.
32	type SmartDictEngine struct {
33		dict Engine
34		llm  Engine
35		cfg  SmartDictConfig
36	}
37	
38	// NewSmartDict builds a smart-dict engine over a dictionary and an LLM backend.
39	func NewSmartDict(dict, llm Engine, cfg SmartDictConfig) *SmartDictEngine {
40		return &SmartDictEngine{dict: dict, llm: llm, cfg: cfg}
41	}
42	
43	// Name returns "smart-dict".
44	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Name() string { return "smart-dict" }
45	
46	// Supports reports that this engine handles dictionary lookups.
47	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }
48	
49	// Detect is not meaningful for a dictionary engine.
50	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) {
51		return "", nil
52	}
53	
54	// Available reports true when either backend can serve (a dictionary hit, or the
55	// LLM fallback).
56	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
57		return e.dict.Available(ctx) || e.llm.Available(ctx)
58	}
59	
60	// Translate looks the word up in the dictionary and, on a miss or a too-weak fuzzy
61	// match, falls back to the LLM (streaming preserved).
62	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
63		dictCh, err := e.dict.Translate(ctx, req)
64		if err != nil {
65			// A setup failure (e.g. empty input) — nothing to fall back to.
66			return nil, err
67		}
68	
69		out := make(chan Chunk, 32)
70		go func() {
71			defer close(out)
72			// The dictionary engines are single-shot (no token stream), so drain fully
73			// before deciding whether the answer is good enough.
74			res, derr := Drain(dictCh, nil)
75			if e.dictAnswered(res, derr) {
76				debug.Logf("smart-dict: %q answered from dictionary", strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
77				out <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkDone, Result: res}
78				return
79			}
80			debug.Logf("smart-dict: %q → LLM fallback (no usable dictionary entry)", strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
81			e.fallback(ctx, req, derr, out)
82		}()
83		return out, nil
84	}
85	
86	// dictAnswered reports whether the dictionary produced a result good enough to
87	// return without asking the LLM: an exact entry, or a fuzzy suggestion close enough
88	// to be a likely typo (within CloseDistance).
89	func (e *SmartDictEngine) dictAnswered(res *TranslateResult, derr error) bool {
90		if derr != nil || res == nil {
91			return false // hard miss (ErrNoDictEntry) or transport error → fall back
92		}
93		if res.Dictionary != nil {
94			return true // exact hit
95		}
96		// A close typo (distance known and within threshold) stays as "did you mean".
97		// Unknown distance (0, e.g. Chinese prefix matches) counts as too far → fall back.
98		if len(res.Suggestions) > 0 && res.SuggestDistance != 0 && res.SuggestDistance <= e.cfg.CloseDistance {
99			return true
100		}
101		return false // suggestions too far, "not installed" notes, or empty → fall back
102	}
103	
104	// fallback runs the LLM in translate mode and pipes its chunks to out, stamping a
105	// warning on the terminal result so the downgrade is visible.
106	func (e *SmartDictEngine) fallback(ctx context.Context, req Request, derr error, out chan<- Chunk) {
107		word := strings.TrimSpace(req.Text)
108	
109		r := req
110		r.Mode = ModeTranslate
111		r.Preset = e.cfg.Preset
112		if r.Preset == "" {
113			r.Preset = PresetDictionary
114		}
115		r.Target = smartTarget(req.Text, req.Target)
116	
117		llmCh, err := e.llm.Translate(ctx, r)
118		if err != nil {
119			out <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkError, Err: fmt.Errorf("smart-dict: no dictionary entry for %q and LLM fallback failed: %w", word, err)}
120			return
121		}
122		for ch := range llmCh {
123			if ch.Kind == ChunkDone && ch.Result != nil {
124				ch.Result.Warnings = append(ch.Result.Warnings,
125					fmt.Sprintf("no dictionary entry for %q — defined via %s (LLM)", word, ch.Result.Engine))
126			}
127			out <- ch
128		}
129	}
130	
131	// smartTarget picks the LLM fallback's target language, mirroring the bilingual
132	// dictionary (Chinese ↔ English): Chinese input → English; English/other input →
133	// the caller's target, or Chinese when that target is English/unset.
134	func smartTarget(text, target string) string {
135		if lang.IsChinese(text) {
136			return "en"
137		}
138		t := strings.TrimSpace(target)
139		if t == "" || t == "auto" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(t), "en") {
140			return "zh"
141		}
142		return t
143	}
144

1	package engine

3	import (
4		"context"

8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/debug"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/lang"
10	)
11	
12	// SmartAutoEngine is the "smart" default: it treats a single word/term as a
13	// dictionary lookup (delegating to the smart-dict engine, which itself falls back
14	// to the LLM on a miss) and a phrase or sentence as an LLM translation. It is
15	// bidirectional-friendly — the caller sets Pair/PairHome/PairAway and the routed
16	// Target, and both branches honor them.
17	//
18	// Because dictionary word lookups are direction-agnostic (script routes them to
19	// CC-CEDICT vs ECDICT) and phrase translation uses the pair-aware LLM prompt, a
20	// single word like "test" is answered from the dictionary instead of risking an
21	// LLM echo, and a full sentence is translated into the other pair language.
22	type SmartAutoEngine struct {
23		smart Engine // dictionary + LLM fallback (serves ModeDict)
24		llm   Engine // LLM translate, possibly a fallback chain (serves ModeTranslate)
25	}
26	
27	// NewSmartAuto builds a smart-auto engine over a smart-dict engine (word lookups)
28	// and an LLM/translate engine (phrases).
29	func NewSmartAuto(smart, llm Engine) *SmartAutoEngine {
30		return &SmartAutoEngine{smart: smart, llm: llm}
31	}
32	
33	// Name returns "smart-auto".
34	func (e *SmartAutoEngine) Name() string { return "smart-auto" }
35	
36	// Supports translate mode (the main-path request mode); it dispatches to a
37	// dictionary lookup internally when the input looks like a single word.
38	func (e *SmartAutoEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeTranslate }
39	
40	// Detect is not meaningful here (the LLM/dict sub-engines own detection).
41	func (e *SmartAutoEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) {
42		return "", nil
43	}
44	
45	// Available reports true when either branch can serve.
46	func (e *SmartAutoEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
47		return e.smart.Available(ctx) || e.llm.Available(ctx)
48	}
49	
50	// Translate routes a single word/term to the dictionary (smart-dict) and a phrase
51	// to the LLM. Streaming is preserved by returning the chosen sub-engine's channel.
52	func (e *SmartAutoEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
53		if isLookup(req.Text) {
54			debug.Logf("smart-auto: %q → dictionary lookup (smart-dict), target=%s", truncateText(req.Text), req.Target)
55			r := req
56			r.Mode = ModeDict
57			return e.smart.Translate(ctx, r)
58		}
59		debug.Logf("smart-auto: %q → LLM translate, target=%s pair=%v", truncateText(req.Text), req.Target, req.Pair)
60		r := req
61		r.Mode = ModeTranslate
62		return e.llm.Translate(ctx, r)
63	}
64	
65	// isLookup reports whether text should be treated as a dictionary lookup (a
66	// single word or short term) rather than a phrase to translate. Latin/other: one
67	// token of letters (plus '-' / apostrophe), up to 32 runes. CJK: a short run of
68	// Han without spaces (a word or idiom, up to 4 characters). Anything with
69	// internal whitespace is a phrase.
70	func isLookup(text string) bool {
71		t := strings.TrimSpace(text)
72		if t == "" {
73			return false
74		}
75		if strings.ContainsAny(t, " \t\n\r") {
76			return false // multiple tokens → phrase
77		}
78		if lang.IsChinese(t) {
79			return len([]rune(t)) <= 4
80		}
81		for _, r := range t {
82			if !unicode.IsLetter(r) && r != '-' && r != '\'' {
83				return false // digits/punctuation → not a plain word
84			}
85		}
86		return len([]rune(t)) <= 32
87	}
88	
89	// truncateText shortens a string for a single-line debug label.
90	func truncateText(s string) string {
91		s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
92		r := []rune(s)
93		if len(r) > 40 {
94			return string(r[:40]) + "…"
95		}
96		return s
97	}

231	function renderMarkdown(r: TranslateResult): string {
232	  // Plain paragraph (not an H1) so long translations read comfortably.
233	  const lines = [r.translation, ""];
234	  if (r.alternatives?.length)
235	    lines.push("## Alternatives", ...r.alternatives.map((a) => `- ${a}`), "");
236	  if (r.notes) lines.push("## Notes", r.notes, "");
237	  if (r.warnings?.length)
238	    lines.push("## Warnings", ...r.warnings.map((w) => `> ${w}`), "");
239	  return lines.join("\n");
240	}
241

243	  return (

246	      {r.model ? (

252	      />
253	      <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label title="Target" text={r.target} />
254	      {typeof r.confidence === "number" ? (
255	        <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label
256	          title="Confidence"
257	          text={r.confidence.toFixed(2)}
258	        />
259	      ) : null}
260	    </List.Item.Detail.Metadata>
261	  );
262	}

1	import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
2	
3	/** Debounce a value so an expensive call only fires after the user pauses typing. */
4	export function useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
5	  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
6	  useEffect(() => {
7	    const id = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
8	    return () => clearTimeout(id);
9	  }, [value, delayMs]);
10	  return debounced;
11	}
12
```

13	// LocalDictConfig configures the offline bilingual dictionary engine.
14	type LocalDictConfig struct {
15		Dir          string
16		CedictURL    string
17		EcdictURL    string
18		AutoDownload bool        // auto-fetch CC-CEDICT (small) on first Chinese lookup
19		Fuzzy        bool        // emit ranked suggestions on a miss

24	// LocalDictEngine looks up definitions offline: Chinese → CC-CEDICT (zh→en),
25	// English → ECDICT (en→zh). It satisfies the Engine interface and maps results
26	// into the same DictEntry/Suggestions shape the TUI already renders.
27	type LocalDictEngine struct {
28		cfg LocalDictConfig
29		ce  *cedictIndex
30		ec  *ecdictDB
31		wl  *wordIndex // /usr/share/dict/words, for English "did you mean"
32	}
33	
34	// NewLocalDict builds a local bilingual dictionary engine.
35	func NewLocalDict(cfg LocalDictConfig) *LocalDictEngine {
36		return &LocalDictEngine{
37			cfg: cfg,
38			ce:  newCedictIndex(CedictPath(cfg.Dir)),
39			ec:  newEcdictDB(EcdictDBPath(cfg.Dir)),
40			wl:  &wordIndex{path: "/usr/share/dict/words"},
41		}
42	}
43	
44	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Name() string         { return "dictionary" }
45	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }
46	
47	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) {
48		return "", nil
49	}
50	
51	// Available reports true if at least one data source (or the API fallback) is usable.
52	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
53		if fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) || e.ec.available() {
54			return true
55		}
56		if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
57			return e.cfg.APIFallback.Available(ctx)
58		}
59		return false
60	}
61	
62	// Translate routes by script: Chinese → CC-CEDICT, else → ECDICT.
63	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
64		word := strings.TrimSpace(req.Text)
65		if word == "" {
66			return nil, ErrEmptyInput
67		}
68		if lang.IsChinese(word) {
69			return e.lookupZh(ctx, word, req), nil
70		}
71		return e.lookupEn(ctx, word, req), nil
72	}
73	
74	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupZh(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
75		if !fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) {
76			if e.cfg.AutoDownload {
77				if err := DownloadCedict(ctx, e.cfg.CedictURL, CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir), nil); err != nil {
78					return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
79				}
80			} else {
81				return single(notInstalled(req, "CC-CEDICT not installed — run `translate dict update cedict`"), nil)
82			}
83		}
84		if entries := e.ce.lookup(word); len(entries) > 0 {
85			return single(cedictResult(word, entries, req), nil)
86		}
87		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
88			if sugg := e.ce.prefixSuggest(word, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
89				// CC-CEDICT prefix matches carry no edit distance → 0 (unknown).
90				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, 0), nil)
91			}
92		}
93		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
94	}
95	
96	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupEn(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
97		if !e.ec.available() {
98			// No ECDICT yet: fall back to dictionaryapi.dev (English defs) if enabled.
99			if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
100				ch, err := e.cfg.APIFallback.Translate(ctx, req)
101				if err == nil {
102					return ch
103				}
104			}
105			return single(notInstalled(req, "ECDICT not installed — run `translate dict update ecdict`"), nil)
106		}
107		en, err := e.ec.lookup(ctx, word)
108		if err != nil {
109			return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
110		}
111		if en != nil {
112			return single(ecdictResult(en, req), nil)
113		}
114		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
115			if sugg, best := e.wl.nearestN(strings.ToLower(word), 2, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
116				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, best), nil)
117			}
118		}
119		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
120	}
121	
122	// --- result mapping into the existing DictEntry / Suggestions shape ---
123	
124	func cedictResult(word string, entries []*cedictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
125		d := &DictEntry{Word: word}
126		if len(entries) > 0 {
127			d.Phonetic = entries[0].Pinyin
128		}
129		for _, en := range entries {
130			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: en.Pinyin}
131			for _, def := range en.Defs {
132				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: def})
133			}
134			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
135		}
136		gloss := ""
137		if len(entries) > 0 && len(entries[0].Defs) > 0 {
138			gloss = entries[0].Defs[0]
139		}
140		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
141	}
142	
143	func ecdictResult(en *ecdictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
144		d := &DictEntry{Word: en.Word, Phonetic: en.Phonetic}
145		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
146			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "中文"}
147			for _, line := range zh {
148				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
149			}
150			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
151		}
152		if de := splitEcdict(en.Definition); len(de) > 0 {
153			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "definition"}
154			for _, line := range de {
155				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
156			}
157			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
158		}
159		gloss := ""
160		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
161			gloss = zh[0]
162		}
163		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
164	}
165	
166	func suggestResult(sugg []string, req Request, bestDist int) *TranslateResult {
167		return &TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Suggestions: sugg, SuggestDistance: bestDist}
168	}
169	
170	func notInstalled(req Request, note string) *TranslateResult {
171		return &TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Notes: note}
172	}
173	
174	func fileExists(p string) bool {
175		_, err := os.Stat(p)
176		return err == nil
177	}

```text
1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/debug"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/lang"
10	)
11	
12	// SmartDictConfig parameterizes the smart-dict engine.
13	type SmartDictConfig struct {
14		// CloseDistance is the English edit distance at/below which a fuzzy "did you
15		// mean" is treated as a likely typo and returned as-is; a farther match (and
16		// any hard miss) triggers the LLM fallback. 0 disables the typo shortcut, so
17		// every non-exact lookup falls back.
18		CloseDistance int
19		// Preset is the LLM prompt style used for the fallback; "" => PresetDictionary
20		// (a gloss plus example sentences).
21		Preset string
22	}
23	
24	// SmartDictEngine composes a dictionary engine with an LLM: it answers from the
25	// dictionary when it can, and falls back to the LLM when the word is missing or the
26	// fuzzy match is too far off. It is a distinct, selectable engine — the plain
27	// dictionary engine is left untouched.
28	//
29	// This is the first engine to branch on a produced result's quality (the Chain
30	// only fails over on hard errors), so the fallback always stamps a Warning: the
31	// downgrade from an offline lookup to an LLM answer is never silent.
32	type SmartDictEngine struct {
33		dict Engine
34		llm  Engine
35		cfg  SmartDictConfig
36	}
37	
38	// NewSmartDict builds a smart-dict engine over a dictionary and an LLM backend.
39	func NewSmartDict(dict, llm Engine, cfg SmartDictConfig) *SmartDictEngine {
40		return &SmartDictEngine{dict: dict, llm: llm, cfg: cfg}
41	}
42	
43	// Name returns "smart-dict".
44	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Name() string { return "smart-dict" }
45	
46	// Supports reports that this engine handles dictionary lookups.
47	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }
48	
49	// Detect is not meaningful for a dictionary engine.
50	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) {
51		return "", nil
52	}
53	
54	// Available reports true when either backend can serve (a dictionary hit, or the
55	// LLM fallback).
56	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
57		return e.dict.Available(ctx) || e.llm.Available(ctx)
58	}
59	
60	// Translate looks the word up in the dictionary and, on a miss or a too-weak fuzzy
61	// match, falls back to the LLM (streaming preserved).
62	func (e *SmartDictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
63		dictCh, err := e.dict.Translate(ctx, req)
64		if err != nil {
65			// A setup failure (e.g. empty input) — nothing to fall back to.
66			return nil, err
67		}
68	
69		out := make(chan Chunk, 32)
70		go func() {
71			defer close(out)
72			// The dictionary engines are single-shot (no token stream), so drain fully
73			// before deciding whether the answer is good enough.
74			res, derr := Drain(dictCh, nil)
75			if e.dictAnswered(res, derr) {
76				debug.Logf("smart-dict: %q answered from dictionary", strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
77				out <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkDone, Result: res}
78				return
79			}
80			debug.Logf("smart-dict: %q → LLM fallback (no usable dictionary entry)", strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
81			e.fallback(ctx, req, derr, out)
82		}()
83		return out, nil
84	}
85	
86	// dictAnswered reports whether the dictionary produced a result good enough to
87	// return without asking the LLM: an exact entry, or a fuzzy suggestion close enough
88	// to be a likely typo (within CloseDistance).
89	func (e *SmartDictEngine) dictAnswered(res *TranslateResult, derr error) bool {
90		if derr != nil || res == nil {
91			return false // hard miss (ErrNoDictEntry) or transport error → fall back
92		}
93		if res.Dictionary != nil {
94			return true // exact hit
95		}
96		// A close typo (distance known and within threshold) stays as "did you mean".
97		// Unknown distance (0, e.g. Chinese prefix matches) counts as too far → fall back.
98		if len(res.Suggestions) > 0 && res.SuggestDistance != 0 && res.SuggestDistance <= e.cfg.CloseDistance {
99			return true
100		}
101		return false // suggestions too far, "not installed" notes, or empty → fall back
102	}
103	
104	// fallback runs the LLM in translate mode and pipes its chunks to out, stamping a
105	// warning on the terminal result so the downgrade is visible.
106	func (e *SmartDictEngine) fallback(ctx context.Context, req Request, derr error, out chan<- Chunk) {
107		word := strings.TrimSpace(req.Text)
108	
109		r := req
110		r.Mode = ModeTranslate
111		r.Preset = e.cfg.Preset
112		if r.Preset == "" {
113			r.Preset = PresetDictionary
114		}
115		r.Target = smartTarget(req.Text, req.Target)
116	
117		llmCh, err := e.llm.Translate(ctx, r)
118		if err != nil {
119			out <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkError, Err: fmt.Errorf("smart-dict: no dictionary entry for %q and LLM fallback failed: %w", word, err)}
120			return
121		}
122		for ch := range llmCh {
123			if ch.Kind == ChunkDone && ch.Result != nil {
124				ch.Result.Warnings = append(ch.Result.Warnings,
125					fmt.Sprintf("no dictionary entry for %q — defined via %s (LLM)", word, ch.Result.Engine))
126			}
127			out <- ch
128		}
129	}
130	
131	// smartTarget picks the LLM fallback's target language, mirroring the bilingual
132	// dictionary (Chinese ↔ English): Chinese input → English; English/other input →
133	// the caller's target, or Chinese when that target is English/unset.
134	func smartTarget(text, target string) string {
135		if lang.IsChinese(text) {
136			return "en"
137		}
138		t := strings.TrimSpace(target)
139		if t == "" || t == "auto" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(t), "en") {
140			return "zh"
141		}
142		return t
143	}
144
```

14	// Service is the warm, transport-agnostic core: it builds the translate/define
15	// engines once at startup and holds the history store for the process lifetime.
16	// A single Service is safe to share across many goroutines — the engines are
17	// concurrency-safe and the store serializes its own writes.
18	//
19	// The Service deliberately never touches state.json (the CLI's remembered pair):
20	// a long-lived server must not fight the interactive CLI over that file.
21	type Service struct {
22		cfg      *config.Config
23		res      config.Resolved
24		trans    engine.Engine // warm translate engine
25		define   engine.Engine // warm define engine
26		store    store.Store   // shared history; nil when disabled / NoHistory
27		provider string        // resolved provider name (for per-request model overrides)
28	
29		source string // resolved default source (usually "auto")
30		home   string // resolved home target
31		away   string // resolved pair "away" language; "" when pair is off
32		pair   bool
33	}
34	
35	// Options tunes Service construction.
36	type Options struct {
37		NoHistory bool // do not open/record history
38	}
39	
40	// Params is one translation request. Empty fields fall back to the Service
41	// defaults resolved at startup; Pair is a tri-state (nil => use the default).
42	type Params struct {
43		Text         string
44		Source       string // "" => service default (usually "auto")
45		Target       string // "" => service home target
46		Preset       string // "" => service default
47		Instructions string // "" => service default
48		Model        string // "" => the warm engine's model
49		MaxAlts      int    // 0 => engine default
50		Pair         *bool  // nil => service default; non-nil overrides
51	}
52	
53	// NewService resolves config (flags empty, env honored) once, warms both engines,
54	// and opens the history store. It fails fast on a misconfigured provider, mirroring
55	// the CLI's guard in runRoot.
56	func NewService(cfg *config.Config, opt Options) (*Service, error) {
57		res := cfg.Resolve(config.Overrides{}, config.ModeCLI)
58		if res.Provider == nil && res.Engine != "auto" {
59			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no provider configured; check %s", config.Path())
60		}
61		trans, err := BuildEngine(res)
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, err
64		}
65		def := DefineEngine(res, false, false)
66		st := openStore(cfg, opt.NoHistory)
67		return newService(cfg, res, trans, def, st), nil
68	}
69	
70	// newService assembles a Service from already-built parts. It is the unexported
71	// seam used by tests to inject stub engines and an in-memory store (no network).
72	func newService(cfg *config.Config, res config.Resolved, trans, def engine.Engine, st store.Store) *Service {
73		source, home, away, pair := resolveRouting(res)
74		provider := ""
75		if res.Provider != nil {
76			provider = res.Provider.Name
77		}
78		return &Service{
79			cfg: cfg, res: res, trans: trans, define: def, store: st,
80			provider: provider, source: source, home: home, away: away, pair: pair,
81		}
82	}
83	
84	// resolveRouting fuzzy-resolves the source/target/pair-with languages the same way
85	// the CLI does (resolvePair + lang.Resolve), so "chinese" → "zh" etc.
86	func resolveRouting(res config.Resolved) (source, home, away string, pair bool) {
87		sm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.Source)
88		tm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.Target)
89		source, home = sm.Code, tm.Code
90		pair = res.Pair
91		if res.Pair {
92			pwm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.PairWith)
93			away = pwm.Code
94		}
95		return source, home, away, pair
96	}
97	
98	// Translate performs a non-streaming translation and records it in history.
99	func (s *Service) Translate(ctx context.Context, p Params) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
100		return s.translate(ctx, p, false, nil)
101	}
102	
103	// TranslateStream performs a streaming translation, delivering tokens to onToken
104	// as they arrive, and records the final result in history.
105	func (s *Service) TranslateStream(ctx context.Context, p Params, onToken func(string)) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
106		return s.translate(ctx, p, true, onToken)
107	}
108	
109	func (s *Service) translate(ctx context.Context, p Params, stream bool, onToken func(string)) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
110		req := s.buildRequest(p, stream)
111		ch, err := s.trans.Translate(ctx, req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, err
114		}
115		res, err := engine.Drain(ch, onToken)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, err
118		}
119		s.record(ctx, res, req.Text, req.Source, req.Target)
120		return res, nil
121	}
122	
123	// buildRequest maps Params onto an engine.Request, mirroring the CLI's oneShot +
124	// EffectiveTarget so the API and CLI route identically.
125	func (s *Service) buildRequest(p Params, stream bool) engine.Request {
126		source := firstNonEmpty(p.Source, s.source)
127		home := firstNonEmpty(p.Target, s.home)
128		pair := s.pair
129		if p.Pair != nil {
130			pair = *p.Pair
131		}
132		target := EffectiveTarget(pair, home, s.away, p.Text)
133	
134		req := engine.Request{
135			Text:     p.Text,
136			Source:   source,
137			Target:   target,
138			Mode:     engine.ModeTranslate,
139			Stream:   stream,
140			MaxAlts:  p.MaxAlts,
141			Preset:   firstNonEmpty(p.Preset, s.res.Preset),
142			Extra:    firstNonEmpty(p.Instructions, s.res.Instructions),
143			Pair:     pair,
144			PairHome: home,
145			PairAway: s.away,
146		}
147		if p.Model != "" {
148			// Scope the override to the resolved provider so a copilot model id never
149			// leaks into an Ollama fallback (see engine.Request.ModelProvider).
150			req.Model = p.Model
151			req.ModelProvider = s.provider
152		}
153		return req
154	}
155	
156	// Define performs a dictionary/definition lookup (not recorded in history, matching
157	// the CLI's `translate define`).
158	func (s *Service) Define(ctx context.Context, word string) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
159		ch, err := s.define.Translate(ctx, engine.Request{Text: word, Mode: engine.ModeDict, Stream: false})
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		return engine.Drain(ch, nil)
164	}
165	
166	// HistoryRecent returns up to limit history records, newest first (empty when
167	// history is disabled).
168	func (s *Service) HistoryRecent(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]store.Record, error) {
169		if s.store == nil {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return s.store.Recent(ctx, limit)
173	}
174	
175	// HistorySearch fuzzy-searches history (empty when history is disabled).
176	func (s *Service) HistorySearch(ctx context.Context, query string, limit int) ([]store.Record, error) {
177		if s.store == nil {
178			return nil, nil
179		}
180		return s.store.Search(ctx, query, limit)
181	}
182	
183	// Close releases the history store.
184	func (s *Service) Close() error {
185		if s.store != nil {
186			return s.store.Close()
187		}
188		return nil
189	}
190	
191	// record persists a successful, complete result. Truncated results (a stream cut
192	// short) are never recorded, so a partial translation is never cached as complete.
193	func (s *Service) record(ctx context.Context, res *engine.TranslateResult, input, source, target string) {
194		if s.store == nil || res == nil || res.Truncated {
195			return
196		}
197		_, _ = s.store.Add(ctx, ToRecord(res, input, source, target))
198	}
199	
200	// openStore opens the history store, or returns nil when history is disabled or
201	// suppressed. Unlike the CLI helper it stays silent on failure (the server logs
202	// separately); a nil store simply disables history for this process.
203	func openStore(cfg *config.Config, noHistory bool) store.Store {
204		if !cfg.History.Enabled || noHistory {
205			return nil
206		}
207		path := cfg.History.Path
208		if path == "" {
209			path = xdgpath.HistoryFile()
210		}
211		st, err := store.OpenJSONL(path)
212		if err != nil {
213			return nil
214		}
215		return st
216	}
217	
218	func firstNonEmpty(a, b string) string {
219		if a != "" {
220			return a
221		}
222		return b
223	}
224

1	// Package appcore holds the transport-agnostic core shared by every front-end:
2	// the engine builders (constructed from resolved config) and a Service that wraps
3	// a warm engine + history store behind Translate/Define/History methods. The
4	// one-shot CLI, the HTTP server (translate serve), and the MCP server (translate
5	// mcp) all drive this same core and diverge only at their transport edge.
6	//
7	// It imports only config/engine/store/lang/debug — never tui or cmd — so both cmd
8	// and the server packages can import it without an import cycle.
9	package appcore
10	
11	import (
12		"fmt"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/config"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/engine"
17	)
18	
19	// BuildEngine constructs the Engine for an invocation from resolved settings.
20	// engine="auto" builds a fallback Chain over the providers named in chain.order;
21	// engine="smartauto" builds the smart default (dictionary for words, LLM for
22	// phrases, bidirectional); a named provider builds a single LLM engine.
23	func BuildEngine(res config.Resolved) (engine.Engine, error) {
24		cfg := res.Cfg
25	
26		switch res.Engine {
27		case "auto":
28			return BuildAutoChain(res)
29		case "smartauto":
30			// Needs an LLM provider for the word-miss fallback and phrase translation;
31			// without one, behave like the plain auto chain (google/dict).
32			if res.Provider == nil {
33				return BuildAutoChain(res)
34			}
35			return SmartAutoFromConfig(res), nil
36		case "google":
37			return GoogleFromConfig(cfg), nil
38		case "llm":
39			// "llm" means "the resolved provider" (already chosen by Resolve).
40			if res.Provider != nil {
41				return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), nil
42			}
43			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown engine/provider %q (check %s)", res.Engine, config.Path())
44		default:
45			// A named provider (e.g. "copilot", "ollama").
46			if res.Provider != nil {
47				return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), nil
48			}
49			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown engine/provider %q (check %s)", res.Engine, config.Path())
50		}
51	}
52	
53	// BuildAutoChain builds the "auto" fallback Chain over the providers/google named
54	// in chain.order. (google/dict engines otherwise join only via smart-auto or the
55	// TUI ^e cycle.)
56	func BuildAutoChain(res config.Resolved) (engine.Engine, error) {
57		cfg := res.Cfg
58		var engines []engine.Engine
59		for _, name := range cfg.Chain.Order {
60			switch {
61			case cfg.ProviderByName(name) != nil:
62				p := cfg.ProviderByName(name)
63				engines = append(engines, LLMFromProvider(p, p.ModelForTier(res.Tier)))
64			case name == "google" && cfg.Google.Enabled:
65				engines = append(engines, GoogleFromConfig(cfg))
66			}
67			// "dict" is wired in via smart-auto / the TUI engine cycle.
68		}
69		if len(engines) == 0 {
70			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no engines available in chain.order (check %s)", config.Path())
71		}
72		if len(engines) == 1 {
73			return engines[0], nil
74		}
75		return engine.NewChain(engines, 5*time.Second), nil
76	}
77	
78	// LLMFromProvider builds an LLM engine for a provider using the given model id.
79	func LLMFromProvider(p *config.Provider, model string) *engine.LLMEngine {
80		if model == "" {
81			model = p.Model
82		}
83		return engine.NewLLM(engine.LLMConfig{
84			Name:      p.Name,
85			BaseURL:   p.BaseURL,
86			Model:     model,
87			APIKeyEnv: p.APIKeyEnv,
88		})
89	}
90	
91	// GoogleFromConfig builds the free Google engine from config.
92	func GoogleFromConfig(cfg *config.Config) *engine.GoogleEngine {
93		return engine.NewGoogle(engine.GoogleConfig{
94			Endpoint:  cfg.Google.Endpoint,
95			ExtraDT:   cfg.Google.ExtraDT,
96			UserAgent: cfg.Google.UserAgent,
97			Timeout:   time.Duration(cfg.Google.TimeoutMs) * time.Millisecond,
98		})
99	}
100	
101	// DictFromConfig builds the dictionary engine from config: the offline bilingual
102	// engine (source=local, default) or the dictionaryapi.dev engine (source=api).
103	func DictFromConfig(cfg *config.Config) engine.Engine {
104		if cfg.Dict.Source == "api" {
105			return engine.NewDict(engine.DictConfig{
106				Endpoint: cfg.Dict.Endpoint,
107				Lang:     cfg.Dict.Lang,
108				Fuzzy:    cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
109				Wordlist: cfg.Dict.Wordlist,
110			})
111		}
112		var apiFb *engine.DictEngine
113		if cfg.Dict.APIFallback {
114			apiFb = engine.NewDict(engine.DictConfig{
115				Endpoint: cfg.Dict.Endpoint,
116				Lang:     cfg.Dict.Lang,
117				Fuzzy:    cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
118				Wordlist: cfg.Dict.Wordlist,
119			})
120		}
121		return engine.NewLocalDict(engine.LocalDictConfig{
122			Dir:          cfg.Dict.Dir,
123			CedictURL:    cfg.Dict.CedictURL,
124			EcdictURL:    cfg.Dict.EcdictURL,
125			AutoDownload: cfg.Dict.AutoDownload,
126			Fuzzy:        cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
127			APIFallback:  apiFb,
128		})
129	}
130	
131	// SmartDictFromConfig builds the smart-dict engine: the plain dictionary plus an
132	// LLM fallback (resolved provider/model) for misses and too-weak fuzzy matches.
133	// The caller must ensure res.Provider != nil.
134	func SmartDictFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
135		cfg := res.Cfg
136		return engine.NewSmartDict(DictFromConfig(cfg), LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), engine.SmartDictConfig{
137			CloseDistance: cfg.SmartDict.CloseDistance,
138			Preset:        cfg.SmartDict.Preset,
139		})
140	}
141	
142	// SmartAutoFromConfig builds the smart-auto default: a single word/term is a
143	// dictionary lookup (smart-dict, with an LLM fallback), and a phrase is an LLM
144	// translation via the auto chain (so phrases keep provider→google resilience).
145	// The caller must ensure res.Provider != nil.
146	func SmartAutoFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
147		llm, err := BuildAutoChain(res)
148		if err != nil {
149			// No chain engines (unlikely once a provider exists): fall back to the bare
150			// resolved provider so phrases can still translate.
151			llm = LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model)
152		}
153		return engine.NewSmartAuto(SmartDictFromConfig(res), llm)
154	}
155	
156	// LearnEngineFromConfig builds the engine for learning mode: a bare LLM engine
157	// (the resolved provider/model), bypassing smart-auto/dictionary routing so a
158	// single word still gets the structured tutor treatment. Caller ensures Provider != nil.
159	func LearnEngineFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
160		return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model)
161	}
162	
163	// DefineEngine picks the dictionary engine for a definition lookup: the plain
164	// offline dictionary, or smart-dict (with an LLM fallback) when a provider is
165	// available and not overridden. plain forces plain; smart forces smart. It is the
166	// single source of truth shared by `translate define` and the Service.
167	func DefineEngine(res config.Resolved, plain, smart bool) engine.Engine {
168		cfg := res.Cfg
169		if plain || res.Provider == nil {
170			return DictFromConfig(cfg)
171		}
172		if smart || cfg.SmartDict.DefineDefault {
173			return SmartDictFromConfig(res)
174		}
175		return DictFromConfig(cfg)
176	}
177

1	package config
2	
3	import (
4		"os"
5		"strings"
6	)
7	
8	// Overrides carries explicit CLI-flag values (empty string == flag not set).
9	type Overrides struct {
10		Source       string
11		Target       string
12		Engine       string
13		Provider     string
14		Model        string
15		Tier         string
16		Preset       string
17		Instructions string
18		Pair         bool // --pair forces pair mode on
19		PairWith     string
20		Learn        bool // --learn forces learning mode on (implies pair)
21		Debug        bool // --debug forces verbose logging on
22	}
23	
24	// Mode identifies which front-end an invocation resolves for, selecting the
25	// [cli] or [tui] overlay (if present).
26	type Mode int
27	
28	const (
29		ModeCLI Mode = iota // one-shot: arguments or piped stdin
30		ModeTUI             // interactive Bubble Tea front-end
31	)
32	
33	// Resolved is the effective, merged view handed to the engine layer and TUI.
34	type Resolved struct {
35		Source       string // raw language string (fuzzy-resolved by the lang package)
36		Target       string
37		Engine       string // "auto" or a provider name
38		Provider     *Provider
39		Model        string
40		Tier         string
41		Preset       string
42		Instructions string
43		Pair         bool
44		PairWith     string
45		Learn        bool
46		Stream       bool
47		Color        string
48		Debug        bool
49	
50		// LiveTranslate/DebounceMs are TUI-only knobs, resolved here (through the
51		// per-mode overlay) so the front-end never reads c.General directly.
52		LiveTranslate bool
53		DebounceMs    int
54	
55		Cfg *Config
56	}
57	
58	// Precedence per setting is flag > env (TRANSLATE_*) > [cli]/[tui] overlay > config
59	// > built-in default. (Env is kept above config so a one-off `TRANSLATE_TARGET=fr`
60	// works without editing config.toml; flags still win over both.)
61	func envVal(name string) string { return strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)) }
62	
63	// overlayFor returns the per-front-end overlay for a mode, or nil when none is set.
64	func overlayFor(c *Config, mode Mode) *Overlay {
65		switch mode {
66		case ModeCLI:
67			return c.CLI
68		case ModeTUI:
69			return c.TUI
70		}
71		return nil
72	}
73	
74	// applyOverlay copies each set (non-nil) overlay field onto g. Model is not a
75	// General field; Resolve reads it from the overlay directly.
76	func applyOverlay(g *General, ov *Overlay) {
77		if ov == nil {
78			return
79		}
80		if ov.Engine != nil {
81			g.Engine = *ov.Engine
82		}
83		if ov.Tier != nil {
84			g.Tier = *ov.Tier
85		}
86		if ov.Preset != nil {
87			g.Preset = *ov.Preset
88		}
89		if ov.Instructions != nil {
90			g.Instructions = *ov.Instructions
91		}
92		if ov.DefaultTarget != nil {
93			g.DefaultTarget = *ov.DefaultTarget
94		}
95		if ov.DefaultSource != nil {
96			g.DefaultSource = *ov.DefaultSource
97		}
98		if ov.Pair != nil {
99			g.Pair = *ov.Pair
100		}
101		if ov.PairWith != nil {
102			g.PairWith = *ov.PairWith
103		}
104		if ov.Learn != nil {
105			g.Learn = *ov.Learn
106		}
107		if ov.Stream != nil {
108			g.Stream = *ov.Stream
109		}
110		if ov.LiveTranslate != nil {
111			g.LiveTranslate = *ov.LiveTranslate
112		}
113		if ov.DebounceMs != nil {
114			g.DebounceMs = *ov.DebounceMs
115		}
116		if ov.Debug != nil {
117			g.Debug = *ov.Debug
118		}
119	}
120	
121	// Resolve merges flag overrides, environment variables, the per-mode overlay, and
122	// config into the effective settings for one invocation.
123	func (c *Config) Resolve(o Overrides, mode Mode) Resolved {
124		// g is the effective [general] after the [cli]/[tui] overlay (a value copy, so
125		// the on-disk config is untouched).
126		g := c.General
127		ov := overlayFor(c, mode)
128		applyOverlay(&g, ov)
129	
130		pick := func(flag, envName, cfgVal string) string {
131			if flag != "" {
132				return flag
133			}
134			if v := envVal(envName); v != "" {
135				return v
136			}
137			return cfgVal
138		}
139	
140		r := Resolved{
141			Cfg:           c,
142			Source:        pick(o.Source, "TRANSLATE_SOURCE", g.DefaultSource),
143			Target:        pick(o.Target, "TRANSLATE_TARGET", g.DefaultTarget),
144			Engine:        pick(o.Engine, "TRANSLATE_ENGINE", g.Engine),
145			Tier:          pick(o.Tier, "TRANSLATE_TIER", g.Tier),
146			Preset:        pick(o.Preset, "TRANSLATE_PRESET", g.Preset),
147			Instructions:  pick(o.Instructions, "TRANSLATE_INSTRUCTIONS", g.Instructions),
148			Pair:          o.Pair || g.Pair || envVal("TRANSLATE_PAIR") != "",
149			PairWith:      pick(o.PairWith, "TRANSLATE_PAIR_WITH", g.PairWith),
150			Learn:         o.Learn || g.Learn || envVal("TRANSLATE_LEARN") != "",
151			Color:         g.Color,
152			Stream:        g.Stream,
153			LiveTranslate: g.LiveTranslate,
154			DebounceMs:    g.DebounceMs,
155			Debug:         o.Debug || g.Debug || envVal("TRANSLATE_DEBUG") != "",
156		}
157	
158		// Learning mode is inherently bidirectional; it reuses pair's home/away
159		// direction routing, so enabling learn enables pair.
160		if r.Learn {
161			r.Pair = true
162		}
163	
164		// Resolve which provider backs an LLM request.
165		provName := pick(o.Provider, "TRANSLATE_PROVIDER", "")
166		if provName == "" {
167			if c.ProviderByName(r.Engine) != nil {
168				provName = r.Engine // engine was itself a provider name (e.g. "copilot")
169			} else {
170				provName = c.firstLLMProvider()
171			}
172		}
173		r.Provider = c.ProviderByName(provName)
174	
175		// Resolve the model: explicit override, else the overlay's model, else the
176		// provider's tier model.
177		cfgModel := ""
178		if ov != nil && ov.Model != nil {
179			cfgModel = *ov.Model
180		}
181		r.Model = pick(o.Model, "TRANSLATE_MODEL", cfgModel)
182		if r.Model == "" && r.Provider != nil {
183			r.Model = r.Provider.ModelForTier(r.Tier)
184		}
185		return r
186	}
187	
188	// firstLLMProvider returns the first provider named in chain.Order that exists,
189	// else the first configured provider, else "".
190	func (c *Config) firstLLMProvider() string {
191		for _, name := range c.Chain.Order {
192			if c.ProviderByName(name) != nil {
193				return name
194			}
195		}
196		if len(c.Providers) > 0 {
197			return c.Providers[0].Name
198		}
199		return ""
200	}

1	// Package xdgpath resolves XDG-style config/data/state directories for translate.
2	//
3	// It deliberately does NOT use github.com/adrg/xdg or os.UserConfigDir(): both
4	// return ~/Library/Application Support on macOS, which breaks this tool's
5	// ~/.config convention. Instead it honors the XDG_* environment variables and
6	// otherwise falls back to the freedesktop defaults (~/.config, ~/.local/share,
7	// ~/.local/state) on macOS AND Linux alike.
8	package xdgpath
9	
10	import (
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13	)
14	
15	// app is the per-tool subdirectory used under each base dir.
16	const app = "translate"
17	
18	// base returns $env if set, else $HOME/def.
19	func base(env, def string) string {
20		if v := os.Getenv(env); v != "" {
21			return v
22		}
23		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
24		if err != nil {
25			home = "."
26		}
27		return filepath.Join(home, def)
28	}
29	
30	// ConfigDir returns the translate config directory (e.g. ~/.config/translate).
31	func ConfigDir() string { return filepath.Join(base("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", ".config"), app) }
32	
33	// DataDir returns the translate data directory (e.g. ~/.local/share/translate).
34	func DataDir() string { return filepath.Join(base("XDG_DATA_HOME", ".local/share"), app) }
35	
36	// StateDir returns the translate state directory (e.g. ~/.local/state/translate).
37	func StateDir() string { return filepath.Join(base("XDG_STATE_HOME", ".local/state"), app) }
38	
39	// CacheDir returns the translate cache directory (e.g. ~/.cache/translate). Used
40	// for regenerable artifacts like TTS audio; it is intentionally NOT created by
41	// EnsureDirs (cache is optional and created lazily on first write).
42	func CacheDir() string { return filepath.Join(base("XDG_CACHE_HOME", ".cache"), app) }
43	
44	// ConfigFile returns the full path to config.toml.
45	func ConfigFile() string { return filepath.Join(ConfigDir(), "config.toml") }
46	
47	// StateFile returns the full path to state.json.
48	func StateFile() string { return filepath.Join(StateDir(), "state.json") }
49	
50	// HistoryFile returns the default history path (JSONL).
51	func HistoryFile() string { return filepath.Join(DataDir(), "history.jsonl") }
52	
53	// EnsureDirs creates the config, data, and state directories (0700) if missing.
54	func EnsureDirs() error {
55		for _, d := range []string{ConfigDir(), DataDir(), StateDir()} {
56			if err := os.MkdirAll(d, 0o700); err != nil {
57				return err
58			}
59		}
60		return nil
61	}
62
```
</details></tool-use>

1	# Frequency-aware "did you mean" suggestion ranking
2	
3	**Status**: P? — needs a spike
4	**Effort**: S–M
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` P? · `internal/engine/{smartdict,ecdict}.go` · `raycast/extension/src/lib/did-you-mean.tsx` · [../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md)
6	
7	## Context
8	
9	2026-07, surfaced while adding the Raycast "did you mean?" UX. The dictionary engine
10	returns fuzzy `suggestions[]` for single-word typos (consumed by Raycast
11	Translate/Define, and the CLI `define`). Ranking is **edit-distance only**, so the
12	obvious correction doesn't always surface first:
13	
14	- `recieve` → `[relieve, believe, reachieve, recarve, recede, receive, recidive]`
15	  (`receive` is 6th)
16	- `cononical` → `[canonical, acanonical, canonicals, …]` (`canonical` happens to be 1st)
17	
18	Google ranks by frequency ("Showing results for **canonical**"). We want the common
19	word on top.
20	
21	## Investigation
22	
23	- **ECDICT has frequency data** — `frq`, `bnc` columns (+ collins/oxford flags). A
24	  re-rank by `(editDistance asc, frequency desc)` would float common words up.
25	- Suggestions are produced in `internal/engine` (smart-dict / ecdict fuzzy lookup), so
26	  re-ranking there benefits **all** frontends at once — CLI `define`, Raycast, and the
27	  new `serve` / `mcp` adapters.
28	- `TranslateResult.SuggestDistance` exists but is `json:"-"` (not serialized). Exposing
29	  it (e.g. `suggest_distance`) would let a frontend auto-apply a confident correction
30	  ("Showing results for X · search instead for Y", Google-style) instead of only listing.
31	
32	## Options considered
33	
34	| Option | What | Verdict |
35	|---|---|---|
36	| A. Edit-distance only (current) | fuzzy by Levenshtein | simple; the right word is often not on top |
37	| B. Frequency-weighted re-rank | sort by (distance, then ECDICT `frq`/`bnc`) | best value; small change in the dict engine; helps every frontend |
38	| C. Expose `SuggestDistance` in `--json` | frontend decides auto-correct vs. list | pairs with B for a Google-style "showing results for X" |
39	| D. Keyboard-adjacency (qwerty) weighting | typo model | marginal over B; more complex |
40	
41	## Current blocker / open questions
42	
43	- Does the bundled ECDICT actually populate `frq`/`bnc` for enough headwords? (verify)
44	- Chinese suggestions are prefix matches with no distance/frequency — leave as-is, or
45	  pinyin/stroke rank?
46	- Threshold/cap: only show suggestions within distance N; how many to return.
47	
48	## Decision (if any)
49	
50	`2026-07 deferred` — the extension already surfaces the full list (usable, just not
51	ideally ordered). Do **B** (and optionally **C**) when polishing the did-you-mean UX.
52	Frontends need no change for B; C would let Translate/Define auto-apply the top
53	correction.
54	
55	## References
56	
57	- ECDICT schema (`frq`/`bnc`/collins/oxford): https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT
58	- Raycast did-you-mean component: `raycast/extension/src/lib/did-you-mean.tsx`
59
```
</details></tool-use>

2	
3	**Status**: P? — local-dev shipped; publish deferred
4	**Effort**: L
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` P? · `raycast/extension/` · [../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md) · [homebrew-distribution.md](homebrew-distribution.md)

7	## Context
8	
9	2026-07. The Raycast integration shipped as two local tracks (`raycast/script-commands/`
10	bash + `raycast/extension/` TypeScript). The TS extension runs via `just raycast-dev`
11	(`ray develop`) and **persists in root search after dev stops**, so personal use needs
12	no store at all. The open question is whether — and how — to distribute it beyond this
13	machine.
14	
15	## Investigation
16	
17	- **Calling a user-installed binary is a sanctioned pattern** ("✅ Calling known system
18	  binaries"). The store's hard rule targets *bundling opaque/heavy binaries*, which we
19	  don't do — we shell out to a Homebrew/`go install` `translate`.
20	- **Soft guideline friction**: the store discourages requiring users to manually install
21	  external tools ("avoid... automate where possible"). Our binary dependency is exactly
22	  that — advisory, not an auto-reject, but the most likely reviewer comment. Mitigate
23	  with graceful binary detection + a "not installed → install instructions" onboarding
24	  view + README.
25	- **Private org store** (Raycast for Teams/Pro): publish via `owner` in package.json +
26	  `npm run publish`; visible only to org members, **no public human review**. Best fit if
27	  distributing to a controlled group who all have the binary.
28	- **Public store requirements**: `author` = a *registered Raycast username* (currently
29	  fails `ray lint` — `daviddwlee84` 404s against Raycast's user API), `license: MIT`
30	  (wrapper only; the Go binary's license is untouched since we don't bundle it), a custom
31	  512×512 icon (the current one is a placeholder), ≥3 screenshots (2000×1250), a
32	  `CHANGELOG.md`, a Title-Case category, `package-lock.json`, and `ray lint` clean.
33	- **No telemetry, no Keychain**. If published, expose the openrouter API key via the
34	  Raycast preferences API (`required: true`), not by reading `config.toml`.
35	- **Platform**: mark `platforms: ["macOS"]` (already set) — the binary shell-out doesn't
36	  work on Raycast's iOS/Windows clients.
37	
38	## Options considered
39	
40	| Option | What | Verdict |
41	|---|---|---|
42	| A. Local dev only (personal) | `ray develop`, per-machine, no review | current default — done |
43	| B. Private org store (Pro/Team) | `owner` + `npm run publish`, internal-only | best if sharing to a team; needs Pro |
44	| C. Public store | PR to raycast/extensions, automated + human review | widest reach; expect binary-dependency review friction |
45	
46	## Current blocker / open questions
47	
48	- Is public publication worth it given the crowded category, or is local/private enough?
49	  (Differentiators are real — see [../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md)
50	  competitive section — but the binary dependency is a review headwind.)
51	- What's the binary-not-found onboarding UX (detection + actionable install view)?
52	- Register/confirm the Raycast `author` handle before any publish (blocks `ray lint`).
53	
54	## Decision (if any)

56	`2026-07 deferred` — ship the local-dev extension first and dogfood it; **private/
57	personal is the current path**, public store stays deferred.
58	
59	Publish prerequisites now IN PLACE: registered author (`da-wei_lee`), `license: MIT`,
