```text
1	package server
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"fmt"
6		"io"
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/appcore"
11	)
12	
13	// translateStream serves GET /v1/translate/stream as Server-Sent Events. It is a
14	// GET (browser EventSource is GET-only) taking query params, and emits:
15	//
16	//	event: token    data: "<json-encoded token>"   (zero or more)
17	//	event: warning  data: "<message>"              (only if the result was truncated)
18	//	event: done     data: <TranslateResult JSON>   (terminal, success)
19	//	event: error    data: "<message>"              (terminal, failure)
20	//
21	// Payloads are always JSON so multi-line tokens survive SSE's line framing.
22	//
23	// Note: visible token cadence depends on the upstream provider — copilot-proxy
24	// buffers Claude /v1/messages, so Claude models still arrive in a burst regardless
25	// of this transport. SSE's win is dict/google/OpenAI-style providers and fan-out.
26	func (h *handlers) translateStream(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
27		q := r.URL.Query()
28		text := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("text"))
29		if text == "" {
30			writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "empty_input", `query param "text" is required`)
31			return
32		}
33		flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
34		if !ok {
35			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "no_flush", "streaming is not supported by this server")
36			return
37		}
38	
39		p := appcore.Params{
40			Text:         text,
41			Source:       q.Get("source"),
42			Target:       q.Get("target"),
43			Preset:       q.Get("preset"),
44			Instructions: q.Get("instructions"),
45			Model:        q.Get("model"),
46			Pair:         parseBoolPtr(q.Get("pair")),
47		}
48	
49		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
50		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
51		w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
52		w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no") // disable proxy buffering (nginx)
53		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
54		flusher.Flush() // commit headers so the client opens the stream immediately
55	
56		onToken := func(tok string) {
57			writeSSEString(w, "token", tok)
58			flusher.Flush()
59		}
60		// r.Context() cancels on client disconnect and is threaded through the engine,
61		// aborting the upstream LLM request — no extra plumbing needed.
62		res, err := h.svc.TranslateStream(r.Context(), p, onToken)
63		if err != nil {
64			writeSSEString(w, "error", err.Error())
65			flusher.Flush()
66			return
67		}
68		// Truncated is transient (json:"-"), so it would vanish from the done payload —
69		// surface it explicitly as a warning before the terminal event.
70		if res.Truncated {
71			writeSSEString(w, "warning", "result was truncated (max_tokens); output is partial")
72			flusher.Flush()
73		}
74		writeSSEJSON(w, "done", res)
75		flusher.Flush()
76	}
77	
78	// writeSSE writes one framed SSE event with an already-JSON data payload.
79	func writeSSE(w io.Writer, event string, data []byte) {
80		fmt.Fprintf(w, "event: %s\ndata: %s\n\n", event, data)
81	}
82	
83	// writeSSEString frames a string payload (JSON-encoded so it stays single-line).
84	func writeSSEString(w io.Writer, event, s string) {
85		b, _ := json.Marshal(s)
86		writeSSE(w, event, b)
87	}
88	
89	// writeSSEJSON frames an arbitrary value as compact JSON.
90	func writeSSEJSON(w io.Writer, event string, v any) {
91		b, err := json.Marshal(v)
92		if err != nil {
93			writeSSEString(w, "error", "failed to encode result: "+err.Error())
94			return
95		}
96		writeSSE(w, event, b)
97	}
98	
99	// parseBoolPtr maps a query flag to a tri-state *bool (absent => nil).
100	func parseBoolPtr(s string) *bool {
101		if s == "" {
102			return nil
103		}
104		v := s == "1" || strings.EqualFold(s, "true") || strings.EqualFold(s, "yes") || strings.EqualFold(s, "on")
105		return &v
106	}
107

## 1. README / docs / design docs

**`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/README.md`** (284 lines) — user-facing CLI reference: install, usage table, `[cli]`/`[tui]` per-front-end config, TUI keys, engines & fallback chain, smart-auto, pair mode, bilingual mode, dictionary/smart-dict, `translate serve` (HTTP API), `translate mcp`, a Charm v2 developer note, and Architecture. The Architecture section is the load-bearing design principle for all frontends:

> `internal/appcore` is the transport-agnostic core: it holds the engine builders and a `Service` (a warm engine + history store) that the one-shot CLI, the HTTP server (`internal/server`), and the MCP server (`internal/mcpserver`) all drive — so every front-end shares one translation path and `appcore` never imports `tui` or `cmd`.

**`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/docs/raycast-extension.md`** (200 lines) — *the* Raycast design doc. Core principle (lines 9-11):

> **Core principle: reuse the binary, don't reimplement.** Every tier below shells out to the existing `translate` CLI (`--json`) and renders the result. No translation, engine, or dictionary logic is duplicated in TypeScript/bash.

Sections: integration-tier table (Quick Link / Script Command / TS Extension / AI Extension — "We ship the middle two"; AI Extensions deferred because "the AI API requires **Raycast Pro**"), how Raycast extensions work (manifest modes, `execFile` vs `useExec`, preferences, input/UI, `ray` tooling), Gotchas, Competitive landscape (2026), How ours is built, Publishing & distribution, References.

The differentiation framing (lines 95-111) is the strategic roadmap statement:

> **What `translate` does that they don't:**

## 3. Raycast extension docs + the prefill question

**Answer: clipboard/selection prefill is ALREADY opt-in, and moreover it is now opt-*out*-by-default — the shipped default is "Nothing".** Commit `e87db06` ("fix(raycast): plain Translate no longer auto-grabs input (default \"Nothing\")") flipped `"default": "selection"` → `"default": "none"`; the follow-up docs commit `04e0ac3` recorded it.

Exact preference, `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/package.json:17-31` (a **per-command** preference on `translate`, not a global one):

```json
"preferences": [
  {
    "name": "prefill",
    "title": "Prefill input from",
    "description": "When opening Translate, seed the input box from the current selection or the clipboard (empty when there is nothing to grab, so you can also just type). Defaults to Nothing — use Translate Selection to act on the selection/clipboard.",
    "type": "dropdown",
    "required": false,
    "default": "none",
    "data": [
      { "title": "Selected text", "value": "selection" },
      { "title": "Clipboard", "value": "clipboard" },
      { "title": "Nothing (type manually)", "value": "none" }
    ]
  }
]
```

Commit `e87db06` body (the rationale):

> Auto-seeding the Translate box from the clipboard on every open felt surprising. Default the "Prefill input from" preference to Nothing so plain Translate starts empty/predictable; selection/clipboard capture stays the job of Translate Selection (which opens Translate prefilled). Users who want auto-prefill can still opt in.

Doc text added by `04e0ac3`, at `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/docs/raycast-extension.md:119-134`:

> - **TS extension** — [`../raycast/extension/`](../raycast/extension/): commands `translate` (view: type-to-translate, language dropdown, engine-override submenu, Copy/Paste/Speak, typo "did you mean?" suggestions, opt-in selection prefill), `translate-selection` (no-view: grabs the selection/clipboard and opens Translate prefilled via `launchCommand` — editable, not blind-paste), `define` (view: dictionary lookup + LLM fallback + "did you mean" suggestions), and `history` (view: browse/search past translations). … Live translate is debounced + abortable to avoid an LLM call per keystroke, with an opt-in `⌘↵` streaming view (`spawnTranslateStream` → `translate … --stream` → live `Detail`). Typo suggestions reuse the engine's fuzzy `suggestions[]` (a shared `did-you-mean.tsx` component) — no CLI change; single-word lookups route to the offline dict, full sentences to the LLM which corrects implicitly.

Config-inheritance text added by `9ffdff1` (same paragraph, lines 133-136):

> Default target, live-debounce, and tier are inherited from the CLI config (`config show --json`) when the matching Raycast preference is empty, so `config.toml` is the single source of truth (a Raycast preference overrides it).

`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/README.md:58-62`:

> Translate-as-you-type is **debounced** (default 700 ms, tunable via the "Live translate debounce" preference) and cancels superseded in-flight requests, so typing a phrase doesn't fire an LLM call per keystroke. Opening **Translate** seeds the input from the current selection (or clipboard) per the "Prefill input from" preference — set it to "Nothing" to always start empty.

`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/README.md:40-46`:

> ## Preferences
> Binary path, default target language, engine, model tier, live-translate debounce, and how Translate prefills its input (selection / clipboard / nothing). Leave **target / tier / debounce** empty to inherit them from the `translate` config (`~/.config/translate/config.toml`, read via `config show --json`) — configure them once and Raycast honors them; set a preference to override the config for Raycast.

**One inconsistency worth flagging.** The code's in-language default disagrees with the manifest default — `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/translate.tsx:75`:

```ts
const mode = prefs.prefill ?? "selection";
```

In practice Raycast injects the manifest default (`"none"`), so behavior is correct; but if `prefs.prefill` were ever `undefined` (e.g. a code path not going through Raycast's preference resolution, or a stale `raycast-env.d.ts`), it would silently fall back to grabbing the selection — the exact behavior `e87db06` removed. `"none"` would be the safer literal here.

Global preferences (`package.json:72-116`): `binaryPath`, `defaultTarget` ("Leave empty to inherit the translate config's default_target"), `engine`, `tier` (dropdown with a `"Use config default"` = `""` option), `liveDebounceMs` ("min 250… Leave empty to inherit the translate config's debounce_ms (falls back to 700)"). Inheritance is implemented in `translate.tsx:56-69` via `readConfig()` → `translate config show --json` (`src/lib/translate.ts:217-227`, cached per command run); the CLI side is `cmd/config.go` (TOML→map→JSON round-trip, so keys stay snake_case).

Related pitfall: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/pitfalls/raycast-launchd-path-translate-not-found.md` — launchd PATH, absolute-binary probe, "**Test from Raycast, not a terminal.**"

## 5. Contributor conventions

**There is no `CLAUDE.md`.** The agent contract is `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/AGENTS.md` (135 lines, starts directly at `## Releasing & versioning` — no title, and no "Hard invariants" section despite `pitfalls/README.md:19` and `:21-25` referring to one).

**Commit style** — `AGENTS.md:38-40`:

> There is no CHANGELOG; the annotated tag message is the release note. Keep commit subjects in `feat(scope): …` / `fix(scope): …` form so `git log <prev-tag>..<tag>` reads as a coherent changelog.

Observed scopes in practice: `feat(raycast)`, `fix(raycast)`, `docs(raycast)`, `docs(backlog)`, `feat(cli)`, `feat(serve)`, `feat(mcp)`, `feat(tui)`, `fix(lang)`, `refactor(appcore)`, `chore(build)`, `build:`, `docs:`. Bodies are multi-line prose explaining rationale. Every one of the last 50 commits carries the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>` (48 occurrences).

**Versioning** — `AGENTS.md:2-36`: version comes from `debug.ReadBuildInfo`, so "**the version *is* the git tag**"; pre-1.0 SemVer rules; adding a `config.toml` field requires bumping `config.SchemaVersion` in `internal/config/config.go` (auto-migration on next run; breaking key changes need an explicit migration in `runRoot`); 5-step ship-to-machine procedure ending in `just upgrade-go` in the dotfiles repo.

**Backlog/pitfall workflow** — `AGENTS.md:47-135` (a `project-knowledge-harness` snippet between sentinel markers): `TODO.md` is the single index ("Do **not** create new `ROADMAP.md` / `IDEAS.md` / `BACKLOG.md` files"); three ways to add an entry (`scripts/add-todo.sh` preferred, `backlog/inbox.md` quick-capture, direct edit + `scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only`); add `backlog/<slug>.md` for `P?`/`[L]`/`[XL]`/multi-option items; on implementing, run `scripts/promote-todo.sh --title … --summary …` in the same commit and mark the backlog doc `Status: shipped` (never delete). Pitfall docs must be **titled by symptom**, with verbatim error text. Caveat: the referenced `scripts/` directory does **not** exist in this repo — those helper scripts ship with the skill (`.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/`), not the project, so `add-todo.sh` / `promote-todo.sh` / `todo-kanban.sh` are not runnable from the repo root as written.

**Go code style** — README "Developer note — Charm v2" (lines 248-255) is the one hard trap:

> This project pins the **v2** Charm stack on the `charm.land/*` vanity module paths (`charm.land/bubbletea/v2`, `bubbles/v2`, `lipgloss/v2`, `huh/v2`) — **not** `github.com/charmbracelet/*`. v1 code will not compile here. When editing the TUI: `View()` returns `tea.View` (wrap strings with `tea.NewView`); keys arrive as `tea.KeyPressMsg`; alt-screen is the declarative `View.AltScreen` field; window size is requested via `tea.RequestWindowSize`.

**TS style:** Prettier + `@raycast/eslint-config`, strict TS, 2-space, double quotes, trailing commas; every `src/lib/*` export carries a JSDoc block explaining the *why* (launchd PATH, `useExec` timeout, abort-on-supersede).

1	# Publish the Raycast extension to the store
2	
3	**Status**: P? — local-dev shipped; publish deferred
4	**Effort**: L
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` P? · `raycast/extension/` · [../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md) · [homebrew-distribution.md](homebrew-distribution.md)
6	
7	## Context
8	
9	2026-07. The Raycast integration shipped as two local tracks (`raycast/script-commands/`
10	bash + `raycast/extension/` TypeScript). The TS extension runs via `just raycast-dev`
11	(`ray develop`) and **persists in root search after dev stops**, so personal use needs
12	no store at all. The open question is whether — and how — to distribute it beyond this
13	machine.
14	
15	## Investigation
16	
17	- **Calling a user-installed binary is a sanctioned pattern** ("✅ Calling known system
18	  binaries"). The store's hard rule targets *bundling opaque/heavy binaries*, which we
19	  don't do — we shell out to a Homebrew/`go install` `translate`.
20	- **Soft guideline friction**: the store discourages requiring users to manually install
21	  external tools ("avoid... automate where possible"). Our binary dependency is exactly
22	  that — advisory, not an auto-reject, but the most likely reviewer comment. Mitigate
23	  with graceful binary detection + a "not installed → install instructions" onboarding
24	  view + README.
25	- **Private org store** (Raycast for Teams/Pro): publish via `owner` in package.json +
26	  `npm run publish`; visible only to org members, **no public human review**. Best fit if
27	  distributing to a controlled group who all have the binary.
28	- **Public store requirements**: `author` = a *registered Raycast username* (currently
29	  fails `ray lint` — `daviddwlee84` 404s against Raycast's user API), `license: MIT`
30	  (wrapper only; the Go binary's license is untouched since we don't bundle it), a custom
31	  512×512 icon (the current one is a placeholder), ≥3 screenshots (2000×1250), a
32	  `CHANGELOG.md`, a Title-Case category, `package-lock.json`, and `ray lint` clean.
33	- **No telemetry, no Keychain**. If published, expose the openrouter API key via the
34	  Raycast preferences API (`required: true`), not by reading `config.toml`.
35	- **Platform**: mark `platforms: ["macOS"]` (already set) — the binary shell-out doesn't
36	  work on Raycast's iOS/Windows clients.
37	
38	## Options considered
39	
40	| Option | What | Verdict |
41	|---|---|---|
42	| A. Local dev only (personal) | `ray develop`, per-machine, no review | current default — done |
43	| B. Private org store (Pro/Team) | `owner` + `npm run publish`, internal-only | best if sharing to a team; needs Pro |
44	| C. Public store | PR to raycast/extensions, automated + human review | widest reach; expect binary-dependency review friction |
45	
46	## Current blocker / open questions
47	
48	- Is public publication worth it given the crowded category, or is local/private enough?
49	  (Differentiators are real — see [../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md)
50	  competitive section — but the binary dependency is a review headwind.)
51	- What's the binary-not-found onboarding UX (detection + actionable install view)?
52	- Register/confirm the Raycast `author` handle before any publish (blocks `ray lint`).
53	
54	## Decision (if any)
55	
56	`2026-07 deferred` — ship the local-dev extension first and dogfood it; **private/
57	personal is the current path**, public store stays deferred.
58	
59	Publish prerequisites now IN PLACE: registered author (`da-wei_lee`), `license: MIT`,
60	a designed 512×512 icon (`assets/extension-icon.png`, source `.svg`), `CHANGELOG.md`,
61	an extension `README.md`, and a graceful binary-not-found onboarding view. Remaining
62	before a public PR: **3–6 screenshots (2000×1250, GUI capture)** and a decision on the
63	binary-dependency review friction (a private org store sidesteps it entirely). The
64	full dev→publish process is documented in
65	[../docs/raycast-extension.md](../docs/raycast-extension.md) "Publishing & distribution".

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# @raycast.schemaVersion 1

# @raycast.author David Lee
# @raycast.authorURL https://github.com/daviddwlee84

set -euo pipefail

# Raycast runs under launchd and does NOT inherit your shell PATH, so a bare
# `translate` is usually not found. Resolve an absolute path instead.
find_translate() {
  for d in "$HOME/.local/bin" /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/go/bin"; do
    [ -x "$d/translate" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$d/translate"; return 0; }
  done
  command -v translate 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

BIN="$(find_translate)" || { echo "translate CLI not found (see ~/.local/bin)."; exit 1; }

"$BIN" define "$1"

The extension also doesn't use any Form components at all.

```text
// Package state persists small session state (the last language pair and source
// mode) so a bare `translate` resumes where the user left off.
package state

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/xdgpath"
)

// State is the persisted last-session snapshot.
type State struct {
	Source     string    `json:"source"`                // "auto" or a code
	Target     string    `json:"target"`                // code
	SourceMode string    `json:"source_mode,omitempty"` // auto | fixed
	Provider   string    `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Engine     string    `json:"engine,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt  time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// Load reads the state file, returning a zero State if it does not exist.
func Load() (*State, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(xdgpath.StateFile())
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return &State{}, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	var s State
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &s); err != nil {
		return &State{}, nil // corrupt state is non-fatal
	}
	return &s, nil
}

// Save writes the state atomically (temp file + rename).
func Save(s *State) error {
	if err := xdgpath.EnsureDirs(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	p := xdgpath.StateFile()
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(p), ".state-*.json")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmpName := tmp.Name()
	defer os.Remove(tmpName)
	if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
		tmp.Close()
		return err
	}
=== engine errors ===
package engine

import "errors"

// Sentinel errors returned across the engine layer.
var (
	// ErrEmptyInput is returned when a request has no text to translate.
	ErrEmptyInput = errors.New("engine: empty input")
	// ErrNoResult is returned when a channel closed without a terminal result.
	ErrNoResult = errors.New("engine: stream closed without a result")
	// ErrNoEngineForMode is returned by the chain when no engine supports the mode.
	ErrNoEngineForMode = errors.New("engine: no engine supports this mode")
	// ErrAllEnginesFailed is returned by the chain when every candidate failed.
	ErrAllEnginesFailed = errors.New("engine: all engines failed")
	// ErrNoDictEntry is returned when a dictionary lookup finds nothing.
	ErrNoDictEntry = errors.New("engine: no dictionary entry")
)

## 3. How "Translate" works today

### Clipboard / selection auto-fetch
`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/translate.tsx:74-91`:

```tsx
// On first open, seed the input from the current selection (or clipboard), per the
// "Prefill input from" preference — unless we were launched with a seed (from
// Translate Selection). Empty when there's nothing to grab, so you can also type.
useEffect(() => {
  if (ctx?.seed) return;
  const mode = prefs.prefill ?? "selection";
  if (mode === "none") return;
  (async () => {
    let seed = "";
    if (mode === "selection") {
      try {
        seed = (await getSelectedText()).trim();
      } catch {
        seed = "";
      }
    } else if (mode === "clipboard") {
      seed = ((await Clipboard.readText()) ?? "").trim();
    }
    if (seed) setText(seed);
  })();
}, []);
```

Key points:
- APIs used: **`getSelectedText()`** (selection mode, throws → swallowed to `""`) and **`Clipboard.readText()`** (clipboard mode). `Clipboard.readText()` is used as the *fallback* only in `translate-selection.tsx:26`, not in `translate.tsx` (in `translate.tsx` the two modes are mutually exclusive — selection mode does **not** fall back to clipboard).
- Manifest default is `"none"` (commit `e87db06` "plain Translate no longer auto-grabs input"), so out of the box Translate opens empty. **Note a latent inconsistency**: the in-code fallback is `prefs.prefill ?? "selection"` (:76) — if the preference were ever `undefined`, code would auto-grab the selection, contradicting the manifest default.
- `launchContext.seed` from Translate Selection wins and short-circuits (:75); it also seeds initial state at :50 (`useState(ctx?.seed ?? "")`).

### Config inheritance from the CLI (`config show --json`)
`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/translate.tsx:54-69`:

```tsx
// Inherit the default target + debounce from the CLI config (~/.config/translate)
// when the matching Raycast preference is empty. Falls back to "en"/700ms.
useEffect(() => {
  if (to && prefs.liveDebounceMs) return; // nothing to inherit
  readConfig()
    .then((cfg) => {
      if (!to && cfg.general?.default_target) setTo(cfg.general.default_target);
      if (!prefs.liveDebounceMs && cfg.general?.debounce_ms)
        setDebounceMs(Math.max(250, cfg.general.debounce_ms));
    })
    .catch(() => { /* fall back to defaults */ })
    .finally(() => setTo((t) => t || "en"));
}, []);
```

Reader helper, `src/lib/translate.ts:198-227`:

```ts
export interface CliConfig {
  general?: {
    default_target?: string; default_source?: string; debounce_ms?: number;
    engine?: string; tier?: string; live_translate?: boolean;
  };
}
let cachedConfig: CliConfig | undefined;
export async function readConfig(): Promise<CliConfig> {
  if (cachedConfig) return cachedConfig;
  const bin = resolveBinary();
  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, ["config", "show", "--json"], {
    timeout: 10_000, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024, env: baseEnv(),
  });
  cachedConfig = JSON.parse(stdout) as CliConfig;
  return cachedConfig;
}
```

Precedence, per-setting:
- **target**: `launchContext.to` → `prefs.defaultTarget` → `config.general.default_target` → `"en"` (:51, :56-69).
- **debounce**: `prefs.liveDebounceMs` (clamped ≥250) → `config.general.debounce_ms` (clamped ≥250) → `700` (:46-49, :62-63).
- **tier**: inherited **by omission** — `runTranslate` only appends `--tier` when a value is set (`src/lib/translate.ts:134-135`), and the manifest default is `""`. `CliConfig.general.tier` is declared but never read in TS.
- **engine**: same by-omission pattern (`src/lib/translate.ts:132-133`).
- `default_source` / `live_translate` are declared in `CliConfig` but unused.

CLI side: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/cmd/config.go:28-56` — `config show --json` round-trips TOML → `map[string]any` → JSON so the JSON keys stay snake_case (`general.default_target`), explicitly "Lets other front-ends (the Raycast extension) read the effective config." Backing struct: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/internal/config/config.go:74-91` (`General.DefaultTarget`, `.DebounceMs`, `.Engine`, `.Tier`, `.LiveTranslate`). Note this is `config.Load()` (raw file + defaults), **not** `cfg.Resolve(...)`, so `[cli]`/`[tui]` overlays (`config.go:56-71`) are *not* applied to what Raycast reads.

### Debounce + abort
`translate.tsx:95-118`: `useDebouncedValue(text, debounceMs)` → `usePromise(..., [debouncedText, to, engine], { abortable })`; the signal is threaded into `execFile` so a superseded call is killed. `pending` (:117-118) keeps the loading bar up while typed text is ahead of the debounced value.

## 4. History feature

**The extension stores nothing of its own.** No `LocalStorage`, no `Cache`, no JSON file written by TS (grep for `LocalStorage|Cache|useCachedPromise` in `src/` returns nothing). History is entirely CLI-owned.

### Extension side
`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/history.tsx:7-85` — `usePromise` calls `runHistory(undefined, 200, signal)` once (:9-14); each row is a `List.Item` with `title=output`, `subtitle=input`, `keywords=[input, output, source_lang, target_lang, engine]` (:42-53), a Detail markdown (`renderEntry`, :87-89) and metadata (source/target/engine/model/when, :99-111). Actions: Copy Output, Paste Output, Copy Input (⌘I), Reload (⌘R).

> **Notable**: `history.tsx` never passes a query — it fetches 200 rows and relies on Raycast's built-in client-side filtering over title/subtitle/`keywords`. The `translate history search` path in `runHistory` (`lib/translate.ts:177-179`) is therefore **dead code from the extension's perspective**. There is no `onSearchTextChange` on the `List`.

### CLI invocation (`lib/translate.ts:170-188`)

```ts
export async function runHistory(query?, limit = 200, signal?): Promise<HistoryEntry[]> {
  const bin = resolveBinary();
  const q = query?.trim();
  const args = q
    ? ["history", "search", q, "--json"]
    : ["history", "--json", "--limit", String(limit)];
  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, args, {
    timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024, env: baseEnv(), signal,
  });
  const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
  return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as HistoryEntry[]) : [];
}
```

TS row type (`lib/translate.ts:57-66`): `{ id, ts, source_lang, target_lang, engine?, model?, input, output }`.

### Storage backend (Go)
- **File**: JSONL, default `~/.local/share/translate/history.jsonl` — `internal/xdgpath/paths.go:51` (`HistoryFile()`), overridable via `[history].path`; `[history].enabled`/`backend` at `internal/config/config.go:154-158`.
- **Schema** (`internal/store/store.go:12-24`): `id, ts, source_lang, target_lang, engine, model?, input, output, alternatives?, notes?, favorite?` — the TS interface omits `alternatives`, `notes`, `favorite`.
- **Interface** (`store.go:27-36`): `Add / Recent / Search / Close`.
- **Write** (`internal/store/jsonl.go:35-65`): append-only, `O_APPEND|O_CREATE|O_WRONLY 0600`, in-process mutex **plus** an advisory `flock` (`internal/store/flock_unix.go`) so `translate serve` and the CLI can append concurrently. IDs: base36 nanos + 4 random bytes (`jsonl.go:141-145`).
- **Read** (`jsonl.go:68-103`): whole-file read, tolerant line-by-line `json.Unmarshal` (bad lines skipped), reversed for newest-first.
- **Search** (`jsonl.go:106-132`): in-memory `github.com/sahilm/fuzzy` over `input + " " + output`.
- **CLI surface** (`cmd/history.go:16-55`): `history [--limit N] [--tsv] [--json]` and `history search <query>`; `printRecords` (:71-92) JSON-encodes the full `[]store.Record` when `--json`.
- **Write path from a translation**: `cmd/root.go:335-342` `recordAndRemember` → `appcore.ToRecord` (`internal/appcore/record.go:36-51`, which substitutes `detected_source` when source was `auto`). Suppressed by `--no-history` (`cmd/root.go:314-317`).

### Extension component
`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/lib/did-you-mean.tsx:10-39` — a `List.Section title="Did you mean?"`; first item gets `Icon.Checkmark` + accessory `"closest"`, rest get `Icon.MagnifyingGlass`; single action "Use This" → `onPick(s)`.

(Minor: `const [best, ...rest] = suggestions;` then `{[best, ...rest].map(...)}` at :17-20 rebuilds the identical array — harmless dead destructuring.)

### Trigger conditions
- Translate (`translate.tsx:121-123`): `showSuggestions = !!data && !data.translation && !!data.suggestions?.length` — i.e. an *empty translation* plus suggestions. Rendered at :156-157, `onPick={setText}` (re-runs the search).
- Define (`define.tsx:30-31`): `!!data && !data.dictionary && !!data.suggestions?.length`, `onPick={setWord}` (:58). Also drives `isShowingDetail` off (:39).

### CLI/engine side (where suggestions are actually computed)
- Wire field: `internal/engine/engine.go:103-112` — `Suggestions []string \`json:"suggestions,omitempty"\`` and `SuggestDistance int \`json:"-"\`` (**deliberately not serialized**, so the extension cannot see the distance today).
- **English fuzzy** — Levenshtein over a word list: `internal/engine/dict.go:230-263` `wordIndex.nearestN(word, maxDist=2, n=suggestLimit=7)`, sorted by `(distance asc, alphabetical)`; word list is `/usr/share/dict/words` (`dict.go:49-52`, `localdict.go:40`), config-overridable via `[dict].wordlist`. Cap constant `suggestLimit = 7` at `dict.go:19`.
- **Emission points**: `internal/engine/dict.go:88-94` (API 404 path, English-gated) and `internal/engine/localdict.go:114-118` (ECDICT miss) / `:87-92` (Chinese).
- **Chinese** uses *prefix* matching, not edit distance: `internal/engine/cedict.go:80-98` `prefixSuggest`, returned with `SuggestDistance = 0` ("unknown") — see `localdict.go:88-91`.
- **Quality gate**: `internal/engine/smartdict.go:89-102` `dictAnswered` — a dictionary result counts as "answered" only for an exact hit, or when `SuggestDistance != 0 && <= cfg.CloseDistance`; otherwise it falls through to an LLM definition with a stamped warning (`smartdict.go:106-129`).
- **Why Translate (not just Define) sees suggestions**: `internal/engine/smartauto.go:52-63` routes single-token input (`isLookup`, :68-86: no internal whitespace, letters/`-`/`'` only, ≤32 runes; CJK ≤4 runes) to `ModeDict`, so a one-word typo comes back as an empty translation + suggestions. Sentences go to the LLM.
- Other frontends consuming the same field: `cmd/define.go:73-77` (`"no exact match — did you mean: …"`), `internal/tui/view.go:202-203, 309-313` + `internal/tui/update.go:316-319` (second Enter opens the ranked list), `internal/mcpserver/tools.go:119-120`.

### The backlog spike
`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/backlog/suggestion-ranking.md` (status **P? — needs a spike**, effort S–M, `2026-07 deferred`), indexed at `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/TODO.md:46`.

- Problem: `recieve` → `receive` is 6th; ranking is edit-distance-only.
- Preferred option **B**: re-rank by `(editDistance asc, frequency desc)` in `internal/engine` so CLI/Raycast/MCP/serve all benefit; option **C**: serialize `SuggestDistance` for Google-style auto-correct.
- Open question in the doc: *"Does the bundled ECDICT actually populate `frq`/`bnc`?"* — **partial answer found**: the locally-built SQLite schema at `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/internal/engine/dictdata.go:33-35` is
  `CREATE TABLE entries(word, word_lc, phonetic, translation, definition, pos, frq INTEGER, exchange)` and the insert at `dictdata.go:128` populates `frq` — so **`frq` exists in the DB, `bnc` does not** (it is not imported). The only index is `idx_word_lc` (`dictdata.go:170`); there is no fuzzy/prefix index over ECDICT — English suggestions come from `/usr/share/dict/words`, which has no frequency data, so a frequency re-rank needs a join back into `entries` (or a new `frq`-carrying candidate source).

## 6. CLI shell-out mechanics & shared helpers

Everything funnels through one module: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-translate-cli-tui/raycast/extension/src/lib/translate.ts`.

**Binary resolution** (:75-108) — Raycast runs under launchd with a restricted PATH:

```ts
const PROBE_DIRS = [
  join(homedir(), ".local", "bin"), "/opt/homebrew/bin",
  "/usr/local/bin", join(homedir(), "go", "bin"),
];
let cachedBin: string | undefined;
export function resolveBinary(): string {
  const prefs = getPreferenceValues<Prefs>();
  if (prefs.binaryPath && existsSync(prefs.binaryPath)) return prefs.binaryPath;
  if (cachedBin) return cachedBin;
  for (const dir of PROBE_DIRS) {
    const candidate = join(dir, "translate");
    if (existsSync(candidate)) { cachedBin = candidate; return candidate; }
  }
  throw new Error("translate CLI not found. Set the binary path in extension preferences, or install it (just install / brew install daviddwlee84/tap/translate).");
}
export function isBinaryMissing(e: unknown): boolean {
  return e instanceof Error && e.message.startsWith("translate CLI not found");
}
```

**Env** (:110-113): `baseEnv()` = `{...process.env, HOME: process.env.HOME ?? homedir()}` — HOME is forced through so the CLI finds `~/.config/translate/config.toml` (API keys live there, not in shell env).

**Exec helpers** — all `promisify(execFile)` (`pexecFile`, :8), never `useExec` (10 s cap):

| fn | line | argv | timeout / maxBuffer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runTranslate` | :124-145 | `[text, "--to", to, "--json"]` + optional `--from/--engine/--tier/--no-history` | 60 s / 16 MB |
| `runDefine` | :152-164 | `["define", word, "--json"]` | 60 s / 16 MB |
| `runHistory` | :170-188 | `["history","--json","--limit",N]` or `["history","search",q,"--json"]` | 30 s / 32 MB |
| `readConfig` | :217-227 | `["config","show","--json"]` (module-level cache) | 10 s / 4 MB |
| `speak` | :191-196 | `[text,"--to",to,"--speak"]`, fire-and-forget `execFile`, callback ignores errors | none |
| `spawnTranslateStream` | :243-262 | `spawn(bin, [text,"--to",to,"--stream","--no-history", …])` | returns a cancel fn that SIGTERMs |

`runTranslate` core (:128-144):

```ts
const prefs = getPreferenceValues<Prefs>();
const bin = resolveBinary();
const args = [text, "--to", opts.to ?? prefs.defaultTarget ?? "en", "--json"];
if (opts.from) args.push("--from", opts.from);
const engine = opts.engine ?? prefs.engine; if (engine) args.push("--engine", engine);
const tier = opts.tier ?? prefs.tier;       if (tier)   args.push("--tier", tier);
if (opts.noHistory) args.push("--no-history");
const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, args, {
  timeout: 60_000,               // LLM engines routinely exceed useExec's 10s default
  maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
  env: baseEnv(),
  signal: opts.signal,           // cancel a superseded call when the user keeps typing
});
return JSON.parse(stdout) as TranslateResult;
```

**Error handling**: no try/catch in the helpers — rejections propagate to `usePromise`'s `error`, and each view branches `isBinaryMissing(error) ? <BinaryNotFound/> : <List.EmptyView icon={Icon.Warning} …>`. `JSON.parse` failures surface as raw parse errors. The CLI exits 0 even when an engine fails (auto-fallback), so failure info is read from `warnings[]` in the JSON, rendered in the Detail markdown (`translate.tsx:237-238`, `define.tsx:118`).

**Shared types** (`lib/translate.ts:25-66`), explicitly mirroring `internal/engine/engine.go`'s `TranslateResult`: `Definition`, `Meaning`, `DictEntry`, `TranslateResult` (incl. `suggestions?: string[]`), `HistoryEntry`, plus the `LANGS` dropdown list (:12-23) that must be kept in sync by hand with the static dropdowns in `package.json` (command arguments can't read it at runtime).

**Two separate `Prefs` shapes**: `lib/translate.ts:68-73` (`binaryPath/defaultTarget/engine/tier`) vs a local one in `translate.tsx:35-39` (`defaultTarget/liveDebounceMs/prefill`). Neither is the generated `Preferences` type from `raycast-env.d.ts`.

**Relevant Go flags** (`cmd/root.go:74-93`): `--json` (:88), `--stream` (:89, described as "for piped consumers, e.g. the Raycast extension"), `--no-history` (:90), `--to/--from/--engine/--tier`. The `--stream` TTY-gate OR is at `cmd/root.go:430`.

# 2. Word lookup / dictionary / "define" mode

Yes — two entry points:

**a) `translate define <word>`** (`cmd/define.go:33-68`). Engine choice is centralized in `internal/appcore/build.go:167-176`:

```go
func DefineEngine(res config.Resolved, plain, smart bool) engine.Engine {
	if plain || res.Provider == nil { return DictFromConfig(cfg) }
	if smart || cfg.SmartDict.DefineDefault { return SmartDictFromConfig(res) }
	return DictFromConfig(cfg)
}
```

**b) Automatic word-vs-sentence routing** in the default `smartauto` engine — `internal/engine/smartauto.go:70-87`:

```go
func isLookup(text string) bool {
	if strings.ContainsAny(t, " \t\n\r") { return false }   // multi-token → phrase
	if lang.IsChinese(t) { return len([]rune(t)) <= 4 }
	for _, r := range t { if !unicode.IsLetter(r) && r != '-' && r != '\'' { return false } }
	return len([]rune(t)) <= 32
}
```

So a single word typed into plain `translate <word> --json` goes to the dictionary; a sentence goes to the LLM.

- `/usr/share/dict/words` — the **English typo wordlist** (235,976 lines here), used only for "did you mean" (see §4).

# 4. Fuzzy matching / "did you mean"

There are **four independent fuzzy mechanisms**:

**(a) English dictionary typos** — `internal/engine/dict.go:230-263`, corpus = `/usr/share/dict/words` loaded lazily (`dict.go:206-225`):

```go
// nearestN returns up to n headwords within maxDist edits of word, closest first
func (wi *wordIndex) nearestN(word string, maxDist, n int) ([]string, int) {
	for _, w := range wi.words {
		if w == word || abs(len(w)-len(word)) > maxDist { continue }
		if d := levenshtein.ComputeDistance(word, w); d <= maxDist { cs = append(cs, cand{w, d}) }
	}
	sort.Slice(cs, ...)   // (distance asc, then alphabetical)
	...
	return out, best      // best = smallest distance
}
```
Called with `maxDist=2`, `n=suggestLimit=7` (`internal/engine/dict.go:19`, `dict.go:91`, `internal/engine/localdict.go:115`). Algorithm: `github.com/agnivade/levenshtein`. **Ranking is edit-distance only, ties alphabetical** — this is why `recieve` puts `receive` 6th (documented in `backlog/suggestion-ranking.md:12-19`, tracked as `TODO.md:46`; proposed fix: re-rank by ECDICT `frq`/`bnc`, and expose `SuggestDistance` as `suggest_distance`).

**(b) Chinese** — `internal/engine/cedict.go:82-97`: sorted-key **prefix** scan, not edit distance ("CJK edit distance is noisy"), so `SuggestDistance` is 0/unknown for these (`localdict.go:88-91`).

**(c) The close-typo gate** — `internal/engine/smartdict.go:89-102` decides suggestions-vs-LLM:

```go
if res.Dictionary != nil { return true }                      // exact hit
if len(res.Suggestions) > 0 && res.SuggestDistance != 0 &&
   res.SuggestDistance <= e.cfg.CloseDistance { return true }  // likely typo → "did you mean"
return false                                                   // too far / miss → LLM
```
`close_distance` default 1 (`internal/config/config.go:294`). `SuggestDistance` is `json:"-"` (`internal/engine/engine.go:112`) so frontends **cannot** see it today.

**(d) Language names** — `internal/lang/lang.go:94-144`: normalized Levenshtein similarity over codes/names/aliases, `-0.05` penalty for aliases, confidence floor `0.5`, returns best + up to 2 alternatives; falls through to echoing the query as an opaque code. Exposed by `translate lang resolve` and used on every `--to/--from`.

Plus cobra's own subcommand suggestion (`root.SuggestionsMinimumDistance = 2`, `cmd/root.go:95`) and `sahilm/fuzzy` for history search (`internal/store/jsonl.go:123`).

Frontend consumption today: `raycast/extension/src/lib/did-you-mean.tsx` (shared component), triggered in `translate.tsx:122-123` (`!data.translation && data.suggestions?.length`) and `define.tsx:30-31` (`!data.dictionary && data.suggestions?.length`).

...

- OpenAI path: `POST {base}/chat/completions`, SSE reader at `llm.go:583-621`.
- Anthropic path: `POST {base}/messages`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, `max_tokens` 4096 (8192 for learn/bilingual), SSE reader at `llm.go:628-675`.

Providers/tiers (`internal/config/config.go:227-231`, `internal/engine/models.go:41-46`): `fast=claude-haiku-4-5`, `default=claude-sonnet-5`, `max=claude-opus-4-8` via copilot-proxy `http://localhost:4141/v1` (no key); `ollama` `http://localhost:11434/v1` `llama3.2:3b`; `openrouter` (needs `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`); plus keyless `google` translate_a/single (`internal/engine/google.go`).

Fallback: `internal/engine/chain.go:81-154` — tries in `chain.order`, fails over **only before the first token**, caches "down" verdicts for 5 s (`chain.go:56-67`), and appends the reasons as `warnings[]` on the served result (`chain.go:121-123`).

Prompt presets: `concise` / `contextual` / `dictionary` (`internal/engine/prompt.go:12-75`), plus a pair-mode directive (`prompt.go:81`) and learn/bilingual structured-JSON prompts.

**Streaming**: engines emit `ChunkToken` → `ChunkDone`/`ChunkError` on a channel that always closes (`internal/engine/engine.go:192-220`). CLI gate:

```go

stream := (flagStream || (streamPref && stdoutTTY)) && !flagJSON && !learn
```
So `--json` **never** streams; `--stream` forces it over a pipe (added for Raycast). Real-world caveat, documented in `docs/raycast-extension.md:47-51` and `internal/server/sse.go:23-25`: copilot-proxy buffers Claude `/v1/messages`, so Claude models arrive in a burst regardless.

**Caching**: there is **no persistent translation cache**. Only (a) a session-scoped in-memory TUI cache keyed on preset/engine/model/source/target/text/learn/pair (`internal/tui/cache.go:11-35`), and (b) a TTS audio cache (`internal/tts/cache.go`). Every CLI invocation is cold — including re-parsing CC-CEDICT (~0.9 s) for each Chinese `define`.

**Latency budget for a Raycast caller** (measured above): dictionary hit 70 ms · fuzzy suggestions 120 ms · Chinese dict 0.9 s · LLM 6.5 s. Client-side timeout bug worth knowing: `NewLLM` sets a whole-request `http.Client{Timeout: 60s}` that also caps the streamed body read (`llm.go:39-46`, tracked at `TODO.md:37`).

Alternative transports if you don't want per-keystroke process spawns: `translate serve` (loopback HTTP, `POST /v1/translate`, `GET /v1/translate/stream` SSE, `POST /v1/define`, `GET /v1/history?q=&limit=` token-guarded, `GET /healthz`, Swagger at `/docs` — routes in `internal/server/server.go:60-69`, request bodies in `internal/server/handlers.go:21-30,63-66`), and `translate mcp` (tools `translate`/`define`/`history`, `internal/mcpserver/tools.go:17-84`). Both share one warm `appcore.Service` (`internal/appcore/service.go:21-96`), which avoids the cold-start costs entirely.

## Gaps relevant to building a Define-style Raycast command

1. **`define` does not record history** (`cmd/define.go` opens no store; `internal/appcore/service.go:157`) — plain `translate <word> --json` *does* (via smartauto → dictionary, see the `"engine":"dictionary"` rows in `history.jsonl`). Getting "open detail → appears in history" needs either using the root command for the lookup, or a new flag/command.

## Goal UX (from the user, modeled on Raycast's built-in "Define Word")
1. Open command → search bar empty → the list below shows **recent lookup history**.
2. Type → a list of **candidate headwords** appears, each row = `word` + a truncated definition preview (exactly like Raycast Define Word: typing "test" shows test / testing / tested / tests / testosterone / tester / testimony / testifying, each with the dictionary gloss as subtitle).
3. Fuzzy finding × LLM fallback: candidates come from the local dictionary (prefix + typo/edit-distance); when the local dict has nothing, fall back to the LLM.
4. Press Enter on a row → push a **Detail page** with the full definition, and *that* is the moment the lookup is written to history (browsing/typing must NOT pollute history).
5. Target/definition language must be selectable — possibly from the very start (before the view opens).

## Repo facts already established (trust these; verify only if you need detail)

### Architecture principle
`docs/raycast-extension.md:9-11`: "**Core principle: reuse the binary, don't reimplement.** Every tier below shells out to the existing `translate` CLI (`--json`) and renders the result. No translation, engine, or dictionary logic is duplicated in TypeScript/bash."
`internal/appcore` is the transport-agnostic core shared by CLI / `serve` / `mcp`; it never imports `tui` or `cmd`.

### Existing Raycast extension — `raycast/extension/`

- `src/define.tsx` — current Define: `List`, hardcoded 500ms debounce, calls `runDefine(word)`, shows ONE result inline via `isShowingDetail`, plus a "did you mean" section when `!data.dictionary && data.suggestions?.length`. No history, no candidate list, no Detail push, no language picker.
- `src/history.tsx` — `usePromise(runHistory(undefined, 200))`, relies on Raycast's built-in client-side filtering over title/subtitle/keywords; never passes a query (so `history search` is dead code from TS).
- `src/lib/translate.ts` — the ONLY shell-out module. `resolveBinary()` :75-108 (probes `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/go/bin`; throws a message `isBinaryMissing()` :105 matches), `baseEnv()` :110-113 (forces `HOME`), `pexecFile` = `promisify(execFile)`, `runTranslate` :124-145 (60s/16MB), `runDefine` :152-164 (`["define", word, "--json"]`, 60s/16MB), `runHistory` :170-188 (`["history","--json","--limit",N]` 30s/32MB), `readConfig` :217-227 (`["config","show","--json"]`, module-level cache), `speak` :191-196, `spawnTranslateStream` :243-262. TS types at :25-66 mirror `internal/engine/engine.go`. `LANGS` :12-23 is a hardcoded 10-language subset duplicated in `package.json:44-55`.
- `src/lib/did-you-mean.tsx` — shared `List.Section title="Did you mean?"` component, `onPick` callback.
- `src/lib/hooks.ts:4-11` — `useDebouncedValue<T>(value, delayMs)`.
- `src/lib/binary-not-found.tsx:18-47` — `List.EmptyView` onboarding.
- `src/lib/stream-view.tsx` — pushed `Detail` fed by `spawnTranslateStream`.
- No `Form` anywhere. No LocalStorage/Cache use anywhere. No TS tests, no test runner. `ray build` type-checks (strict), `ray lint` lints.
- Config inheritance: `translate.tsx:54-69` — when the Raycast pref is empty, inherit `general.default_target` / `general.debounce_ms` from `readConfig()`; tier/engine inherit by *omission* (flag only appended when set).

- Commands: `translate [text]`, `define <word>` (`cmd/define.go:21`, flags `--plain` `--smart`), `history [--limit N] [--tsv] [--json]`, `history search <q>`, `config path|show`, `lang resolve <q>`, `dict update`, `init`, `speak`, `serve`, `mcp`. Persistent flags in `cmd/root.go:74-93` incl. `--to/-t --from/-f --engine --tier --json --stream --no-history --speak`.

Root `translate <word>` DOES record (via smartauto→dictionary), see `cmd/root.go:335-342` → `appcore.ToRecord` (`internal/appcore/record.go:36-51`), suppressed by `--no-history` (`cmd/root.go:314-328`).

- **Hard dictionary miss exits 1 with plain stderr and NO JSON**: `translate define --plain zzzznotaword --json` → `translate: dictionary: engine: no dictionary entry: "zzzznotaword"`, exit 1.
- `--json` never streams (`cmd/root.go:430`).

### Dictionary data & fuzzy internals (the raw material for the candidate list)
- ECDICT SQLite at `~/.local/share/translate/dict/ecdict.db` (93 MB here). Schema `internal/engine/dictdata.go:33-35`: `entries(word, word_lc, phonetic, translation, definition, pos, frq INTEGER, exchange)`; only index is `idx_word_lc` (`dictdata.go:170`). `frq` IS populated (`dictdata.go:128`); `bnc` is NOT imported. Prefix suggestions: `cedict.go:82-97` `prefixSuggest` (sorted-key prefix scan, no edit distance, `SuggestDistance=0`).

- `engine.TranslateResult` (`internal/engine/engine.go:103-112`): `Suggestions []string \`json:"suggestions,omitempty"\``, `SuggestDistance int \`json:"-"\`` (deliberately NOT serialized).
- `internal/engine/smartdict.go:89-129` `dictAnswered` gate: exact hit → answered; suggestions with `SuggestDistance != 0 && <= cfg.CloseDistance` (default 1) → answered; else LLM fallback with a stamped warning.

`internal/store/store.go:12-24` `Record{id, ts, source_lang, target_lang, engine, model?, input, output, alternatives?, notes?, favorite?}`; JSONL at `~/.local/share/translate/history.jsonl`, append is flock-guarded (`internal/store/jsonl.go:35-65`, `flock_unix.go`); `Recent(limit)` reads the WHOLE file each call (`jsonl.go:68-103`); `Search` = in-memory `sahilm/fuzzy` over `input+" "+output` (`jsonl.go:106-132`). **No filters by lang/engine/date, no delete, no favorite toggle, no `history add`.** Dictionary misses currently record empty-output rows.

### Language table
`internal/lang/lang.go:30-66` — 35 entries `{Code, Name, Aliases}`; accessors `lang.List()` :147-151, `lang.Name(code)` :154-164, `lang.Resolve(q)` :94-144 (normalized Levenshtein, alias penalty 0.05, confidence floor 0.5), `lang.Base()`. **Not exposed as JSON anywhere** — `lang resolve --json` silently ignores `--json` (`cmd/lang.go:26-29`). Hence the hardcoded 10-lang subset in TS.

### Latency budget (measured on this machine)
ECDICT hit 0.07 s · English fuzzy suggestions 0.12 s · Chinese CC-CEDICT define 0.92 s (cold parse each process) · LLM fallback 6.5 s (copilot-proxy claude-sonnet-5). No persistent translation cache exists. `translate serve` (`internal/server/server.go:60-69`: `POST /v1/translate`, `GET /v1/translate/stream`, `POST /v1/define`, `GET /v1/history?q=&limit=`, `/healthz`, `/docs`) keeps ONE warm `appcore.Service` and avoids all cold-start cost, but requires the user to run a server.

### Conventions
- `AGENTS.md`: commit subjects `feat(scope): …` / `fix(scope): …`; version == git tag; **adding a `config.toml` field requires bumping `config.SchemaVersion` in `internal/config/config.go`** (additive changes auto-migrate; breaking ones need explicit migration in `runRoot`); backlog items go in `TODO.md` + `backlog/<slug>.md` (never new ROADMAP/IDEAS/BACKLOG files); pitfalls in `pitfalls/<slug>.md` titled by symptom.

No CI.
- Charm **v2** on `charm.land/*` paths (TUI only).

## Design constraints / open questions to resolve in your plan

A. **The CLI has no "search the dictionary by prefix and return N candidates with previews" capability.** Design it as the primary new CLI surface (Go), in `internal/engine` + a `cmd/` wiring, with `--json`. Decide: new subcommand vs a flag on `define`. Specify the exact JSON shape, the ranking function (exact → prefix ranked by `frq` desc → edit-distance ≤2 typo candidates enriched with ECDICT previews), the Chinese path (CC-CEDICT prefix), the degraded path when ECDICT/CC-CEDICT is absent, and that it MUST exit 0 with `[]` rather than exit 1 like `define` does today. Consider whether `internal/appcore` and `serve`/`mcp` should also expose it (the architecture principle says core logic lives in `internal/engine`/`appcore`, not `cmd`).

B. **History on Enter, not on keystroke.** Decide how: make `define` record history by default (respecting `[history].enabled` + `--no-history`) so the list stage passes `--no-history` and the detail stage doesn't — vs. any alternative. Note this is a CLI behavior change (minor bump). Also decide what the empty-search history list shows (all translations vs only dictionary/word lookups) and how to filter it given `history --json` has no field filters (client-side filter in TS on `engine`/single-token `input`? or a new CLI filter flag?). Note dictionary misses currently write empty-output rows — decide whether those should appear.

C. **Language selection.** The dictionary path is script-fixed (English→Chinese via ECDICT, Chinese→English via CC-CEDICT); `--to` only really changes the **LLM fallback** definition language. Design: a Raycast **command argument** dropdown (visible in the Raycast root bar before the view opens) + an in-view `List.Dropdown` searchBarAccessory, defaulting to `general.default_target` from `readConfig()`. Address the LANGS duplication: propose `translate lang list --json` (exposing `lang.List()`) so TS can populate the in-view dropdown at runtime, while the static `package.json` argument dropdown stays a hand-synced short list. Say explicitly what happens when target == the dictionary's fixed direction.

D. **Per-keystroke process spawn cost.** ECDICT prefix search over an indexed SQLite column should be single-digit ms, so a ~150-250 ms debounce is fine for English. Chinese is 0.9 s cold per process — propose a mitigation (e.g. the search command touches CC-CEDICT only for CJK input; or an on-disk index; or opportunistically use `translate serve` if `/healthz` answers) and be explicit about the trade-off. "selection";` while the manifest default (`package.json:17-31`) is `"none"` (flipped in commit `e87db06`). The user reports Translate still auto-fills from the clipboard. Diagnose the likely cause (a persisted user-set preference value from before the default flip survives a manifest-default change) and include the code fix.

21	func newDefineCmd() *cobra.Command {

23			Use:   "define <word>",

25			Args:  cobra.MinimumNArgs(1),
26			RunE:  runDefine,

28		c.Flags().BoolVar(&flagDefinePlain, "plain", false, "force the offline dictionary (no LLM fallback)")

33	func runDefine(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
34		cfg, _, err := config.Load()
35		if err != nil {
36			return err
37		}
38		if !cfg.Dict.Enabled {
39			return fmt.Errorf("dictionary is disabled in %s", config.Path())
40		}
41		res := cfg.Resolve(overrides(), config.ModeCLI)
42		de := appcore.DefineEngine(res, flagDefinePlain, flagDefineSmart)
43		word := strings.Join(args, " ")
44	
45		ch, err := de.Translate(cmd.Context(), engine.Request{Text: word, Mode: engine.ModeDict, Stream: false})
46		if err != nil {
47			return err
48		}
49		res2, err := engine.Drain(ch, nil)
50		if err != nil {
51			return err
52		}
53	
54		if flagJSON {
55			enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
56			enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
57			return enc.Encode(res2)
58		}
59		// Surface an LLM-fallback downgrade the same way the CLI translate path does.
60		for _, w := range res2.Warnings {
61			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: warning: %s\n", w)
62		}
63		fmt.Print(renderDict(res2))
64		if flagSpeak && cfg.TTS.Enabled {
65			speakDefine(cmd.Context(), cfg, res2)
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	// renderDict formats a dictionary result as plain text (no ANSI, pipe-safe).
71	func renderDict(res *engine.TranslateResult) string {
72		d := res.Dictionary
73		if d == nil {
74			if len(res.Suggestions) > 0 {
75				return "no exact match — did you mean: " + strings.Join(res.Suggestions, ", ") + "\n"
76			}
77			return res.Translation + "\n"
78		}
79		var b strings.Builder
80		head := d.Word
81		if d.Phonetic != "" {
82			head += "  " + d.Phonetic
83		}
84		b.WriteString(head + "\n")
85		for _, m := range d.Meanings {
86			b.WriteString("  " + m.PartOfSpeech + "\n")
87			for i, def := range m.Definitions {
88				if i >= 4 { // cap definitions per part of speech
89					break
90				}
91				b.WriteString("    • " + def.Text + "\n")
92				if def.Example != "" {
93					b.WriteString("      \"" + def.Example + "\"\n")
94				}
95			}
96		}
97		return b.String()
98	}

1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"database/sql"
6		"os"
7		"strings"
8		"sync"
9	)
10	
11	type ecdictEntry struct {
12		Word, Phonetic, Translation, Definition string
13	}
14	
15	// ecdictDB queries the locally-built ECDICT SQLite (English → Chinese). Point
16	// lookups are on-disk (near-zero steady-state RAM). Opened lazily.
17	type ecdictDB struct {
18		path string
19		once sync.Once
20		err  error
21		db   *sql.DB
22	}
23	
24	func newEcdictDB(path string) *ecdictDB { return &ecdictDB{path: path} }
25	
26	func (e *ecdictDB) available() bool {
27		_, err := os.Stat(e.path)
28		return err == nil
29	}
30	
31	func (e *ecdictDB) open() error {
32		e.once.Do(func() {
33			if _, err := os.Stat(e.path); err != nil {
34				e.err = err
35				return
36			}
37			db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+e.path+"?_pragma=query_only(true)")
38			if err != nil {
39				e.err = err
40				return
41			}
42			e.db = db
43		})
44		return e.err
45	}
46	
47	// lookup returns the exact (case-insensitive) entry, or nil if not found.
48	func (e *ecdictDB) lookup(ctx context.Context, word string) (*ecdictEntry, error) {
49		if err := e.open(); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		row := e.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,
53			`SELECT word, phonetic, translation, definition FROM entries WHERE word_lc = ? LIMIT 1`,
54			strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(word)))
55		var en ecdictEntry
56		switch err := row.Scan(&en.Word, &en.Phonetic, &en.Translation, &en.Definition); err {
57		case nil:
58			return &en, nil
59		case sql.ErrNoRows:
60			return nil, nil
61		default:
62			return nil, err
63		}
64	}
65	
66	// splitEcdict splits ECDICT translation/definition fields — their senses are
67	// joined by a literal backslash-n, not a real newline.
68	func splitEcdict(s string) []string {
69		var out []string
70		for _, p := range strings.Split(s, `\n`) {
71			if p = strings.TrimSpace(p); p != "" {
72				out = append(out, p)
73			}
74		}
75		return out
76	}
77

1	package engine

3	import (
4		"context"

16	)
17	
18	// suggestLimit caps the number of ranked "did you mean" candidates on a miss.
19	const suggestLimit = 7
20	
21	// DictConfig configures the dictionary engine.
22	type DictConfig struct {
23		Endpoint string // base, e.g. https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries
24		Lang     string // e.g. "en"
25		Fuzzy    bool
26		Wordlist string // path to a newline word list; "" => /usr/share/dict/words
27		Timeout  time.Duration
28	}
29	
30	// DictEngine looks up word definitions via the Free Dictionary API, with an
31	// exact match first and a local fuzzy (nearest-headword) fallback on 404.
32	type DictEngine struct {
33		cfg  DictConfig
34		wl   *wordIndex
35		http *http.Client
36	}
37	
38	// NewDict builds a dictionary engine.
39	func NewDict(cfg DictConfig) *DictEngine {
40		if cfg.Endpoint == "" {
41			cfg.Endpoint = "https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries"
42		}
43		if cfg.Lang == "" {
44			cfg.Lang = "en"
45		}
46		if cfg.Timeout == 0 {
47			cfg.Timeout = 5 * time.Second
48		}
49		path := cfg.Wordlist
50		if path == "" {
51			path = "/usr/share/dict/words"
52		}
53		return &DictEngine{cfg: cfg, wl: &wordIndex{path: path}, http: &http.Client{Timeout: cfg.Timeout}}
54	}
55	
56	// Name returns "dictionary".
57	func (e *DictEngine) Name() string { return "dictionary" }
58	
59	// Supports reports that this engine handles dictionary lookups only.
60	func (e *DictEngine) Supports(m Mode) bool { return m == ModeDict }
61	
62	// Detect is not meaningful for the dictionary engine.
63	func (e *DictEngine) Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error) { return "", nil }
64	
65	// Available probes the API with a common word.
66	func (e *DictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
67		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1500*time.Millisecond)
68		defer cancel()
69		_, status, err := e.fetch(ctx, "test")
70		return err == nil && status == http.StatusOK
71	}
72	
73	// Translate performs a dictionary lookup (exact, then fuzzy on 404).
74	func (e *DictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
75		word := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Text))
76		if word == "" {
77			return nil, ErrEmptyInput
78		}
79	
80		entry, status, err := e.fetch(ctx, word)
81		if err == nil && status == http.StatusOK && entry != nil {
82			return single(e.result(entry, req), nil), nil
83		}
84		if err != nil {
85			return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err)), nil
86		}
87	
88		// 404: return a ranked "did you mean" list (the frontend chooses one). Gated
89		// to English because the bundled wordlist (/usr/share/dict/words) is English.
90		if status == http.StatusNotFound && e.cfg.Fuzzy && strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(e.cfg.Lang), "en") {
91			if cands, best := e.wl.nearestN(word, 2, suggestLimit); len(cands) > 0 {
92				return single(&TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: e.Name(), Suggestions: cands, SuggestDistance: best}, nil), nil
93			}
94		}
95		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word)), nil
96	}
97	
98	func (e *DictEngine) result(entry *DictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
99		return &TranslateResult{
100			Translation: entry.gloss(),
101			Target:      req.Target,
102			Engine:      e.Name(),
103			Dictionary:  entry,
104		}
105	}
106	
107	// --- Free Dictionary API wire types ---
108	
109	type apiEntry struct {
110		Word       string        `json:"word"`
111		Phonetic   string        `json:"phonetic"`
112		Phonetics  []apiPhonetic `json:"phonetics"`
113		Meanings   []apiMeaning  `json:"meanings"`
114		SourceURLs []string      `json:"sourceUrls"`
115	}
116	type apiPhonetic struct {
117		Text string `json:"text"`
118	}
119	type apiMeaning struct {
120		PartOfSpeech string          `json:"partOfSpeech"`
121		Definitions  []apiDefinition `json:"definitions"`
122		Synonyms     []string        `json:"synonyms"`
123		Antonyms     []string        `json:"antonyms"`
124	}
125	type apiDefinition struct {
126		Definition string `json:"definition"`
127		Example    string `json:"example"`
128	}
129	
130	// fetch requests one word; returns (entry, httpStatus, err). A 404 yields
131	// (nil, 404, nil) so the caller can trigger the fuzzy fallback.
132	func (e *DictEngine) fetch(ctx context.Context, word string) (*DictEntry, int, error) {
133		u := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s", strings.TrimRight(e.cfg.Endpoint, "/"), e.cfg.Lang, urlPathEscape(word))
134		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, u, nil)
135		if err != nil {
136			return nil, 0, err
137		}
138		resp, err := e.http.Do(req)
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, 0, err
141		}
142		defer resp.Body.Close()
143		if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
144			_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
145			return nil, http.StatusNotFound, nil
146		}
147		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
148			body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 512))
149			return nil, resp.StatusCode, fmt.Errorf("http %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
150		}
151		var entries []apiEntry
152		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&entries); err != nil {
153			return nil, resp.StatusCode, fmt.Errorf("decode: %w", err)
154		}
155		if len(entries) == 0 {
156			return nil, http.StatusNotFound, nil
157		}
158		return mergeEntries(entries), http.StatusOK, nil
159	}
160	
161	// mergeEntries folds the API's per-entry results into one DictEntry.
162	func mergeEntries(entries []apiEntry) *DictEntry {
163		out := &DictEntry{Word: entries[0].Word}
164		for _, en := range entries {
165			if out.Phonetic == "" && en.Phonetic != "" {
166				out.Phonetic = en.Phonetic
167			}
168			for _, p := range en.Phonetics {
169				if out.Phonetic == "" && p.Text != "" {
170					out.Phonetic = p.Text
171				}
172			}
173			for _, m := range en.Meanings {
174				meaning := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: m.PartOfSpeech, Synonyms: m.Synonyms, Antonyms: m.Antonyms}
175				for _, d := range m.Definitions {
176					meaning.Definitions = append(meaning.Definitions, Definition{Text: d.Definition, Example: d.Example})
177				}
178				out.Meanings = append(out.Meanings, meaning)
179			}
180			if out.SourceURL == "" && len(en.SourceURLs) > 0 {
181				out.SourceURL = en.SourceURLs[0]
182			}
183		}
184		return out
185	}
186	
187	// gloss returns a short one-line definition for history/plain display.
188	func (d *DictEntry) gloss() string {
189		for _, m := range d.Meanings {
190			for _, def := range m.Definitions {
191				if def.Text != "" {
192					return def.Text
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		return d.Word
197	}
198	
199	func urlPathEscape(s string) string {
200		// dictionary words are simple; escape spaces defensively.
201		return strings.ReplaceAll(s, " ", "%20")
202	}
203	
204	// --- local fuzzy word index ---
205	
206	type wordIndex struct {
207		path  string
208		once  sync.Once
209		words []string
210	}
211	
212	func (wi *wordIndex) load() {
213		wi.once.Do(func() {
214			b, err := os.ReadFile(wi.path)
215			if err != nil {
216				return // no wordlist: fuzzy silently disabled
217			}
218			for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
219				w := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
220				if w != "" {
221					wi.words = append(wi.words, w)
222				}
223			}
224		})
225	}
226	
227	// nearestN returns up to n headwords within maxDist edits of word, closest first
228	// (ties broken alphabetically), excluding word itself. The second return is the
229	// best (smallest) edit distance among the results, or 0 when there are none.
230	func (wi *wordIndex) nearestN(word string, maxDist, n int) ([]string, int) {
231		wi.load()
232		type cand struct {
233			w string
234			d int
235		}
236		var cs []cand
237		for _, w := range wi.words {
238			if w == word || abs(len(w)-len(word)) > maxDist {
239				continue
240			}
241			if d := levenshtein.ComputeDistance(word, w); d <= maxDist {
242				cs = append(cs, cand{w, d})
243			}
244		}
245		sort.Slice(cs, func(i, j int) bool {
246			if cs[i].d != cs[j].d {
247				return cs[i].d < cs[j].d
248			}
249			return cs[i].w < cs[j].w
250		})
251		if len(cs) > n {
252			cs = cs[:n]
253		}
254		out := make([]string, len(cs))
255		for i, c := range cs {
256			out[i] = c.w
257		}
258		best := 0
259		if len(cs) > 0 {
260			best = cs[0].d // slice is sorted by distance ascending
261		}
262		return out, best
263	}
264	
265	func abs(n int) int {
266		if n < 0 {
267			return -n
268		}
269		return n
270	}
271

50	
51	// Available reports true if at least one data source (or the API fallback) is usable.
52	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Available(ctx context.Context) bool {
53		if fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) || e.ec.available() {
54			return true
55		}
56		if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
57			return e.cfg.APIFallback.Available(ctx)
58		}
59		return false
60	}
61	
62	// Translate routes by script: Chinese → CC-CEDICT, else → ECDICT.
63	func (e *LocalDictEngine) Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error) {
64		word := strings.TrimSpace(req.Text)
65		if word == "" {
66			return nil, ErrEmptyInput
67		}
68		if lang.IsChinese(word) {
69			return e.lookupZh(ctx, word, req), nil
70		}
71		return e.lookupEn(ctx, word, req), nil
72	}
73	
74	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupZh(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
75		if !fileExists(CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir)) {
76			if e.cfg.AutoDownload {
77				if err := DownloadCedict(ctx, e.cfg.CedictURL, CedictPath(e.cfg.Dir), nil); err != nil {
78					return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
79				}
80			} else {
81				return single(notInstalled(req, "CC-CEDICT not installed — run `translate dict update cedict`"), nil)
82			}
83		}
84		if entries := e.ce.lookup(word); len(entries) > 0 {
85			return single(cedictResult(word, entries, req), nil)
86		}
87		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
88			if sugg := e.ce.prefixSuggest(word, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
89				// CC-CEDICT prefix matches carry no edit distance → 0 (unknown).
90				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, 0), nil)
91			}
92		}
93		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
94	}
95	
96	func (e *LocalDictEngine) lookupEn(ctx context.Context, word string, req Request) <-chan Chunk {
97		if !e.ec.available() {
98			// No ECDICT yet: fall back to dictionaryapi.dev (English defs) if enabled.
99			if e.cfg.APIFallback != nil {
100				ch, err := e.cfg.APIFallback.Translate(ctx, req)
101				if err == nil {
102					return ch
103				}
104			}
105			return single(notInstalled(req, "ECDICT not installed — run `translate dict update ecdict`"), nil)
106		}
107		en, err := e.ec.lookup(ctx, word)
108		if err != nil {
109			return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w", err))
110		}
111		if en != nil {
112			return single(ecdictResult(en, req), nil)
113		}
114		if e.cfg.Fuzzy {
115			if sugg, best := e.wl.nearestN(strings.ToLower(word), 2, suggestLimit); len(sugg) > 0 {
116				return single(suggestResult(sugg, req, best), nil)
117			}
118		}
119		return single(nil, fmt.Errorf("dictionary: %w: %q", ErrNoDictEntry, word))
120	}
121	
122	// --- result mapping into the existing DictEntry / Suggestions shape ---
123	
124	func cedictResult(word string, entries []*cedictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
125		d := &DictEntry{Word: word}
126		if len(entries) > 0 {
127			d.Phonetic = entries[0].Pinyin
128		}
129		for _, en := range entries {
130			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: en.Pinyin}
131			for _, def := range en.Defs {
132				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: def})
133			}
134			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
135		}
136		gloss := ""
137		if len(entries) > 0 && len(entries[0].Defs) > 0 {
138			gloss = entries[0].Defs[0]
139		}
140		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
141	}
142	
143	func ecdictResult(en *ecdictEntry, req Request) *TranslateResult {
144		d := &DictEntry{Word: en.Word, Phonetic: en.Phonetic}
145		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
146			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "中文"}
147			for _, line := range zh {
148				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
149			}
150			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
151		}
152		if de := splitEcdict(en.Definition); len(de) > 0 {
153			mn := Meaning{PartOfSpeech: "definition"}
154			for _, line := range de {
155				mn.Definitions = append(mn.Definitions, Definition{Text: line})
156			}
157			d.Meanings = append(d.Meanings, mn)
158		}
159		gloss := ""
160		if zh := splitEcdict(en.Translation); len(zh) > 0 {
161			gloss = zh[0]
162		}
163		return &TranslateResult{Translation: gloss, Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Dictionary: d}
164	}
165	
166	func suggestResult(sugg []string, req Request, bestDist int) *TranslateResult {
167		return &TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Suggestions: sugg, SuggestDistance: bestDist}
168	}
169	
170	func notInstalled(req Request, note string) *TranslateResult {
171		return &TranslateResult{Target: req.Target, Engine: "dictionary", Notes: note}
172	}
173	
174	func fileExists(p string) bool {
175		_, err := os.Stat(p)
176		return err == nil
177	}
178

1	package engine
2	
3	import (
4		"bufio"
5		"os"
6		"regexp"
7		"sort"
8		"strings"
9		"sync"
10	)
11	
12	// cedictLine matches: Traditional Simplified [pin1 yin1] /def1/def2/
13	var cedictLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+\[([^\]]*)\]\s+/(.*)/\s*$`)
14	
15	type cedictEntry struct {
16		Trad, Simp, Pinyin string
17		Defs               []string
18	}
19	
20	// cedictIndex is an in-memory CC-CEDICT (Chinese → English), keyed on both the
21	// traditional and simplified forms. Loaded lazily on first lookup.
22	type cedictIndex struct {
23		path  string
24		once  sync.Once
25		err   error
26		byKey map[string][]*cedictEntry
27		keys  []string // sorted, for prefix suggestions
28	}
29	
30	func newCedictIndex(path string) *cedictIndex { return &cedictIndex{path: path} }
31	
32	func (ci *cedictIndex) load() error {
33		ci.once.Do(func() {
34			f, err := os.Open(ci.path)
35			if err != nil {
36				ci.err = err
37				return
38			}
39			defer f.Close()
40			ci.byKey = map[string][]*cedictEntry{}
41			sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
42			sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64<<10), 1<<20)
43			for sc.Scan() {
44				line := sc.Text()
45				if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
46					continue
47				}
48				m := cedictLine.FindStringSubmatch(line)
49				if m == nil {
50					continue
51				}
52				e := &cedictEntry{Trad: m[1], Simp: m[2], Pinyin: m[3]}
53				for _, d := range strings.Split(m[4], "/") {
54					if d = strings.TrimSpace(d); d != "" {
55						e.Defs = append(e.Defs, d)
56					}
57				}
58				ci.byKey[e.Simp] = append(ci.byKey[e.Simp], e)
59				if e.Trad != e.Simp {
60					ci.byKey[e.Trad] = append(ci.byKey[e.Trad], e)
61				}
62			}
63			ci.err = sc.Err()
64			ci.keys = make([]string, 0, len(ci.byKey))
65			for k := range ci.byKey {
66				ci.keys = append(ci.keys, k)
67			}
68			sort.Strings(ci.keys)
69		})
70		return ci.err
71	}
72	
73	func (ci *cedictIndex) lookup(word string) []*cedictEntry {
74		if ci.load() != nil {
75			return nil
76		}
77		return ci.byKey[word]
78	}
79	
80	// prefixSuggest returns up to n headwords beginning with word (excluding it).
81	// Chinese uses prefix, not edit distance (CJK edit distance is noisy).
82	func (ci *cedictIndex) prefixSuggest(word string, n int) []string {
83		if ci.load() != nil {
84			return nil
85		}
86		i := sort.SearchStrings(ci.keys, word)
87		var out []string
88		for ; i < len(ci.keys) && len(out) < n; i++ {
89			k := ci.keys[i]
90			if !strings.HasPrefix(k, word) {
91				break
92			}
93			if k != word {
94				out = append(out, k)
95			}
96		}
97		return out
98	}
99

2	
3	import (
4		"compress/gzip"

7		"encoding/csv"

11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"strconv"
14		"strings"
15	
16		_ "modernc.org/sqlite"
17	
18		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/xdgpath"
19	)
20	
21	// DictDir returns the directory holding local dictionary data.
22	func DictDir(dir string) string {
23		if dir != "" {
24			return dir
25		}
26		return filepath.Join(xdgpath.DataDir(), "dict")
27	}
28	
29	// CedictPath / EcdictDBPath are the on-disk locations of the two data sources.
30	func CedictPath(dir string) string   { return filepath.Join(DictDir(dir), "cedict_ts.u8") }
31	func EcdictDBPath(dir string) string { return filepath.Join(DictDir(dir), "ecdict.db") }
32	
33	const ecdictSchema = `CREATE TABLE entries(
34	  word TEXT, word_lc TEXT, phonetic TEXT, translation TEXT,
35	  definition TEXT, pos TEXT, frq INTEGER, exchange TEXT);`
36	
37	// DownloadCedict fetches the gzipped CC-CEDICT, decompresses it, and writes the
38	// plain text file atomically (~9.4 MB).
39	func DownloadCedict(ctx context.Context, url, dst string, prog func(string)) error {
40		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), 0o700); err != nil {
41			return err
42		}
43		if prog != nil {
44			prog("downloading CC-CEDICT…")
45		}
46		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
47		if err != nil {
48			return err
49		}
50		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
51		if err != nil {
52			return err
53		}
54		defer resp.Body.Close()
55		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
56			return fmt.Errorf("cedict download: http %d", resp.StatusCode)
57		}
58		gz, err := gzip.NewReader(resp.Body)
59		if err != nil {
60			return err
61		}
62		defer gz.Close()
63	
64		tmp := dst + ".tmp"
65		f, err := os.Create(tmp)
66		if err != nil {
67			return err
68		}
69		if _, err := io.Copy(f, gz); err != nil {
70			f.Close()
71			os.Remove(tmp)
72			return err
73		}
74		if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
75			os.Remove(tmp)
76			return err
77		}
78		return os.Rename(tmp, dst)
79	}
80	
81	// BuildEcdictDB downloads the ECDICT CSV (~63 MB, MIT) and builds a queryable
82	// SQLite database (~80-100 MB) from it, atomically. Streams the CSV so it never
83	// holds the whole file in memory.
84	func BuildEcdictDB(ctx context.Context, csvURL, dbPath string, prog func(string)) (err error) {
85		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dbPath), 0o700); err != nil {
86			return err
87		}
88		if prog != nil {
89			prog("downloading ECDICT CSV (~63 MB)…")
90		}
91		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, csvURL, nil)
92		if err != nil {
93			return err
94		}
95		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
96		if err != nil {
97			return err
98		}
99		defer resp.Body.Close()
100		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
101			return fmt.Errorf("ecdict download: http %d", resp.StatusCode)
102		}
103	
104		tmp := dbPath + ".tmp"
105		_ = os.Remove(tmp)
106		db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+tmp+"?_pragma=journal_mode(off)&_pragma=synchronous(off)")
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		// On any error, close and remove the partial db.
111		defer func() {
112			if err != nil {
113				db.Close()
114				os.Remove(tmp)
115			}
116		}()
117	
118		if _, err = db.ExecContext(ctx, ecdictSchema); err != nil {
119			return err
120		}
121		if prog != nil {
122			prog("importing entries…")
123		}
124		tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
125		if err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		stmt, err := tx.PrepareContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO entries(word,word_lc,phonetic,translation,definition,pos,frq,exchange) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132	
133		r := csv.NewReader(resp.Body)
134		r.FieldsPerRecord = -1 // tolerate ragged rows
135		r.LazyQuotes = true
136		if _, err = r.Read(); err != nil { // header row
137			return err
138		}
139		n := 0
140		for {
141			if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
142				return err
143			}
144			rec, rerr := r.Read()
145			if rerr == io.EOF {
146				break
147			}
148			if rerr != nil || len(rec) < 4 {
149				continue
150			}
151			frq := 0
152			if len(rec) > 9 {
153				frq, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(rec[9]))
154			}
155			pos, exchange := "", ""
156			if len(rec) > 4 {
157				pos = rec[4]
158			}
159			if len(rec) > 10 {
160				exchange = rec[10]
161			}
162			if _, err = stmt.ExecContext(ctx, rec[0], strings.ToLower(rec[0]), rec[1], rec[3], rec[2], pos, frq, exchange); err != nil {
163				return err
164			}
165			n++
166		}
167		if err = tx.Commit(); err != nil {
168			return err
169		}
170		if _, err = db.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE INDEX idx_word_lc ON entries(word_lc)`); err != nil {
171			return err
172		}
173		if err = db.Close(); err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		if prog != nil {
177			prog(fmt.Sprintf("built %d entries", n))
178		}
179		return os.Rename(tmp, dbPath)
180	}
181
