```text
1	// Package engine defines the translation backend abstraction and its
2	// implementations (LLM via OpenAI-compatible APIs, free web APIs, dictionaries).
3	//
4	// The engine layer is pure Go with context.Context and imports zero TUI code:
5	// the one-shot CLI and the Bubble Tea TUI drive the identical Engine values and
6	// diverge only at presentation.
7	package engine
8	
9	import "context"
10	
11	// Mode selects what kind of lookup a Request performs.
12	type Mode int
13	
14	const (
15		// ModeTranslate is register-aware, faithful translation (the default).
16		ModeTranslate Mode = iota
17		// ModeDict is a dictionary/definition lookup.
18		ModeDict
19	)
20	
21	// Request is the single input to every engine. A Source of "" or "auto" asks
22	// the engine to detect the source language.
23	type Request struct {
24		Text    string
25		Source  string // BCP-47-ish code or "auto"/""
26		Target  string // e.g. "en", "zh"
27		Mode    Mode
28		MaxAlts int    // cap on Alternatives; 0 => engine default
29		Stream  bool   // caller wants token streaming (LLM only; others ignore)
30		Model   string // optional per-request model override (LLM engines)
31		// ModelProvider scopes Model to one provider by name; other engines ignore
32		// the override (so a copilot model id never leaks to an Ollama fallback).
33		ModelProvider string
34		Preset        string // LLM prompt style: "" => concise (LLM translate only)
35		Extra         string // extra user instructions appended to the system prompt
36	
37		// Pair marks a bidirectional "pair" request: the text is written in one of
38		// two languages (PairHome/PairAway) and must be translated into the OTHER.
39		// The LLM translate prompt uses this to detect-and-route and, critically, to
40		// never echo the input unchanged. Target still carries the caller's routed
41		// best guess (for history/display and non-LLM engines).
42		Pair     bool
43		PairHome string // one pair language (e.g. the home target, "zh-TW")
44		PairAway string // the other pair language (e.g. "en")
45	
46		// Learn marks a language-learning request. It is bidirectional (implies Pair,
47		// with PairHome=native and PairAway=foreign) and adaptive: native-language input
48		// is translated-and-taught (glosses + examples), foreign-language input is
49		// grammar-corrected-and-explained. The LLM engine answers with a strict JSON
50		// object (parsed into TranslateResult.Learn) and, because the output is
51		// structured, always runs NON-STREAMING regardless of Stream.
52		Learn bool
53	
54		// Bilingual marks a whole-document bilingual ("doc mode") request: Segments
55		// carries the full ordered document (prose to translate + code shown only as
56		// context) and the LLM returns a JSON map of prose-segment number → translation.
57		// Context-aware and single-call. LLM engines only (google/dict ignore it), and
58		// like Learn it always runs NON-STREAMING.
59		Bilingual bool
60		Segments  []Segment
61	}
62	
63	// Segment is one unit of a Bilingual document request: a prose block to translate,
64	// or a command/code block included only as surrounding context (Code == true).
65	type Segment struct {
66		Text string
67		Code bool
68	}
69	
70	// TranslateResult is the "Marvin-lite" typed result. Every engine fills what it
71	// can; zero-value fields are simply absent. It is also the history record shape.
72	type TranslateResult struct {
73		Translation    string   `json:"translation"`
74		DetectedSource string   `json:"detected_source,omitempty"`
75		Target         string   `json:"target"`
76		Alternatives   []string `json:"alternatives,omitempty"`
77		Notes          string   `json:"notes,omitempty"`
78		Confidence     float64  `json:"confidence,omitempty"`
79	
80		// Warnings records non-fatal problems, e.g. a chain engine that failed before
81		// this (fallback) engine served the result — so a downgrade is never silent.
82		Warnings []string `json:"warnings,omitempty"`
83	
84		// Truncated is set when a streamed result ended before the model finished
85		// (no terminal marker, or stop_reason=="max_tokens"). The partial text is
86		// still returned so the caller can show it, but it must not be cached or
87		// persisted as if complete. Transient: not serialized.
88		Truncated bool `json:"-"`
89	
90		// Provenance — stamped by the producing engine / chain.
91		Engine string `json:"engine,omitempty"`
92		Model  string `json:"model,omitempty"`
93	
94		// Dictionary payload (Mode == ModeDict); nil for translate mode.
95		Dictionary *DictEntry `json:"dictionary,omitempty"`
96		// Learn payload (Request.Learn); nil outside learn mode. Translation still holds
97		// the main foreign-language sentence (the corrected sentence, or the translation)
98		// so copy/history/speak keep working unchanged; the structured extras ride here.
99		Learn *LearnResult `json:"learn,omitempty"`
100		// Bilingual is the doc-mode payload: prose-segment number (1-based, as numbered
101		// in the prompt) → translation. nil outside bilingual doc mode. Transient.
102		Bilingual map[int]string `json:"-"`
103		// Suggestions is a ranked "did you mean" list, set by the dictionary engine
104		// when no exact entry was found (Dictionary and Translation stay empty). The
105		// frontend decides how to present/select — the engine no longer auto-picks.
106		Suggestions []string `json:"suggestions,omitempty"`
107	
108		// SuggestDistance is the edit distance of the best entry in Suggestions (English
109		// fuzzy lookups only; 0 when unknown/not applicable, e.g. Chinese prefix matches).
110		// The smart-dict engine reads it to tell a likely typo from a match too far off.
111		// Transient: not serialized.
112		SuggestDistance int `json:"-"`
113	}
114	
115	// DictEntry is a dictionary lookup payload (populated by the dictionary engine).
116	type DictEntry struct {
117		Word      string    `json:"word"`
118		Phonetic  string    `json:"phonetic,omitempty"`
119		Meanings  []Meaning `json:"meanings,omitempty"`
120		SourceURL string    `json:"source_url,omitempty"`
121	}
122	
123	// Meaning groups definitions by part of speech.
124	type Meaning struct {
125		PartOfSpeech string       `json:"part_of_speech"`
126		Definitions  []Definition `json:"definitions"`
127		Synonyms     []string     `json:"synonyms,omitempty"`
128		Antonyms     []string     `json:"antonyms,omitempty"`
129	}
130	
131	// Definition is a single sense of a word.
132	type Definition struct {
133		Text    string `json:"definition"`
134		Example string `json:"example,omitempty"`
135	}
136	
137	// LearnResult is the structured payload for learn/tutor mode (Request.Learn). The
138	// model fills only the fields relevant to the auto-detected direction; all glosses,
139	// explanations, and notes are written in the native (home) language.
140	type LearnResult struct {
141		Direction   string         `json:"direction"`           // "teach" (native→foreign) | "correct" (foreign→native)
142		Original    string         `json:"original"`            // the user's input as received
143		Corrected   string         `json:"corrected,omitempty"` // correct-direction: the fixed foreign sentence
144		Translation string         `json:"translation"`         // teach: foreign translation; correct: native translation of intent
145		Notes       string         `json:"notes,omitempty"`     // short tip/encouragement, in the NATIVE language
146		Issues      []LearnIssue   `json:"issues,omitempty"`    // correct-direction grammar/usage fixes
147		Vocab       []LearnGloss   `json:"vocab,omitempty"`     // teach-direction glosses
148		Examples    []LearnExample `json:"examples,omitempty"`  // teach-direction usage examples
149	}
150	
151	// LearnIssue is one grammar/usage correction (correct-direction).
152	type LearnIssue struct {
153		Span        string `json:"span"`        // the problematic fragment of the input
154		Fix         string `json:"fix"`         // the corrected fragment
155		Explanation string `json:"explanation"` // why — in the NATIVE language
156	}
157	
158	// LearnGloss is one vocabulary explanation (teach-direction).
159	type LearnGloss struct {
160		Term     string `json:"term"`               // foreign word/term
161		Pos      string `json:"pos,omitempty"`      // part of speech
162		Phonetic string `json:"phonetic,omitempty"` // KK/IPA for English, pinyin for Chinese
163		Meaning  string `json:"meaning"`            // meaning in the NATIVE language
164	}
165	
166	// LearnExample is one usage example (teach-direction).
167	type LearnExample struct {
168		Foreign string `json:"foreign"` // example sentence in the foreign language
169		Native  string `json:"native"`  // its native-language translation
170	}
171	
172	// ChunkKind distinguishes streamed tokens from the terminal result/error.
173	type ChunkKind int
174	
175	const (
176		// ChunkToken is one streamed unit of translation text.
177		ChunkToken ChunkKind = iota
178		// ChunkDone carries the final structured result and ends the stream.
179		ChunkDone
180		// ChunkError carries a terminal error and ends the stream.
181		ChunkError
182	)
183	
184	// Chunk is one unit emitted on an engine's result channel.
185	type Chunk struct {
186		Kind   ChunkKind
187		Text   string           // token text (ChunkToken)
188		Result *TranslateResult // final result (ChunkDone)
189		Err    error            // terminal error (ChunkError)
190	}
191	
192	// Engine is the provider abstraction. Every method honors ctx cancellation.
193	//
194	// Translate returns a receive-only channel and MUST close it after sending
195	// exactly one terminal Chunk (ChunkDone or ChunkError). Streaming engines emit
196	// zero or more ChunkToken then one ChunkDone; non-streaming engines emit a
197	// single ChunkDone. This uniform "channel closed == finished" contract lets the
198	// TUI's self-resubscribing reader and the CLI's drain loop share one code path.
199	// The synchronous error return is only for immediate setup failures; all
200	// runtime/network errors flow as a terminal ChunkError.
201	type Engine interface {
202		Name() string
203		Translate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan Chunk, error)
204		Detect(ctx context.Context, text string) (string, error)
205		Available(ctx context.Context) bool
206		Supports(m Mode) bool
207	}
208	
209	// single is a helper for non-streaming engines: it returns a closed channel
210	// carrying exactly one terminal Chunk.
211	func single(res *TranslateResult, err error) <-chan Chunk {
212		ch := make(chan Chunk, 1)
213		if err != nil {
214			ch <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkError, Err: err}
215		} else {
216			ch <- Chunk{Kind: ChunkDone, Result: res}
217		}
218		close(ch)
219		return ch
220	}
221	
222	// Drain consumes an engine channel to completion, returning the final result.
223	// It streams tokens to onToken (if non-nil) as they arrive. Used by the
224	// one-shot CLI path; the TUI drives the channel directly via its Update loop.
225	func Drain(ch <-chan Chunk, onToken func(string)) (*TranslateResult, error) {
226		for c := range ch {
227			switch c.Kind {
228			case ChunkToken:
229				if onToken != nil {
230					onToken(c.Text)
231				}
232			case ChunkDone:
233				return c.Result, nil
234			case ChunkError:
235				return nil, c.Err
236			}
237		}
238		return nil, ErrNoResult
239	}
240
```

I need to correct something important: `frq` is actually a rank where lower values mean more frequent, with 0 indicating unknown entries. This means I should sort by `frq ASC` and push the 0s to the end—which contradicts what the task brief specified about descending frequency ranking. Now I'm testing prefix query performance with `word_lc LIKE 'test%'`, and SQLite can optimize this with the index only under specific conditions like having case-insensitive LIKE enabled and the right collation on the column.

Since `word_lc` uses BINARY collation and the default `case_sensitive_like` is off, the LIKE optimization won't kick in and I'll get a full table scan. 1	// Package appcore holds the transport-agnostic core shared by every front-end:
```text
2	// the engine builders (constructed from resolved config) and a Service that wraps
3	// a warm engine + history store behind Translate/Define/History methods. The
4	// one-shot CLI, the HTTP server (translate serve), and the MCP server (translate
5	// mcp) all drive this same core and diverge only at their transport edge.
6	//
7	// It imports only config/engine/store/lang/debug — never tui or cmd — so both cmd
8	// and the server packages can import it without an import cycle.
9	package appcore
10	
11	import (
12		"fmt"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/config"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/translate/internal/engine"

18	
19	// BuildEngine constructs the Engine for an invocation from resolved settings.
20	// engine="auto" builds a fallback Chain over the providers named in chain.order;
21	// engine="smartauto" builds the smart default (dictionary for words, LLM for
22	// phrases, bidirectional); a named provider builds a single LLM engine.
23	func BuildEngine(res config.Resolved) (engine.Engine, error) {
24		cfg := res.Cfg
25	
26		switch res.Engine {
27		case "auto":
28			return BuildAutoChain(res)
29		case "smartauto":
30			// Needs an LLM provider for the word-miss fallback and phrase translation;
31			// without one, behave like the plain auto chain (google/dict).
32			if res.Provider == nil {
33				return BuildAutoChain(res)
34			}
35			return SmartAutoFromConfig(res), nil
36		case "google":
37			return GoogleFromConfig(cfg), nil
38		case "llm":
39			// "llm" means "the resolved provider" (already chosen by Resolve).
40			if res.Provider != nil {
41				return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), nil
42			}
43			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown engine/provider %q (check %s)", res.Engine, config.Path())
44		default:
45			// A named provider (e.g. "copilot", "ollama").
46			if res.Provider != nil {
47				return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), nil
48			}
49			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown engine/provider %q (check %s)", res.Engine, config.Path())
50		}
51	}
52	
53	// BuildAutoChain builds the "auto" fallback Chain over the providers/google named
54	// in chain.order. (google/dict engines otherwise join only via smart-auto or the
55	// TUI ^e cycle.)
56	func BuildAutoChain(res config.Resolved) (engine.Engine, error) {
57		cfg := res.Cfg
58		var engines []engine.Engine
59		for _, name := range cfg.Chain.Order {
60			switch {
61			case cfg.ProviderByName(name) != nil:
62				p := cfg.ProviderByName(name)
63				engines = append(engines, LLMFromProvider(p, p.ModelForTier(res.Tier)))
64			case name == "google" && cfg.Google.Enabled:
65				engines = append(engines, GoogleFromConfig(cfg))
66			}
67			// "dict" is wired in via smart-auto / the TUI engine cycle.
68		}
69		if len(engines) == 0 {
70			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no engines available in chain.order (check %s)", config.Path())
71		}
72		if len(engines) == 1 {
73			return engines[0], nil
74		}
75		return engine.NewChain(engines, 5*time.Second), nil
76	}
77	
78	// LLMFromProvider builds an LLM engine for a provider using the given model id.
79	func LLMFromProvider(p *config.Provider, model string) *engine.LLMEngine {
80		if model == "" {
81			model = p.Model
82		}
83		return engine.NewLLM(engine.LLMConfig{
84			Name:      p.Name,
85			BaseURL:   p.BaseURL,
86			Model:     model,
87			APIKeyEnv: p.APIKeyEnv,
88		})
89	}
90	
91	// GoogleFromConfig builds the free Google engine from config.
92	func GoogleFromConfig(cfg *config.Config) *engine.GoogleEngine {
93		return engine.NewGoogle(engine.GoogleConfig{
94			Endpoint:  cfg.Google.Endpoint,
95			ExtraDT:   cfg.Google.ExtraDT,
96			UserAgent: cfg.Google.UserAgent,
97			Timeout:   time.Duration(cfg.Google.TimeoutMs) * time.Millisecond,
98		})
99	}
100	
101	// DictFromConfig builds the dictionary engine from config: the offline bilingual
102	// engine (source=local, default) or the dictionaryapi.dev engine (source=api).
103	func DictFromConfig(cfg *config.Config) engine.Engine {
104		if cfg.Dict.Source == "api" {
105			return engine.NewDict(engine.DictConfig{
106				Endpoint: cfg.Dict.Endpoint,
107				Lang:     cfg.Dict.Lang,
108				Fuzzy:    cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
109				Wordlist: cfg.Dict.Wordlist,
110			})
111		}
112		var apiFb *engine.DictEngine
113		if cfg.Dict.APIFallback {
114			apiFb = engine.NewDict(engine.DictConfig{
115				Endpoint: cfg.Dict.Endpoint,
116				Lang:     cfg.Dict.Lang,
117				Fuzzy:    cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
118				Wordlist: cfg.Dict.Wordlist,
119			})
120		}
121		return engine.NewLocalDict(engine.LocalDictConfig{
122			Dir:          cfg.Dict.Dir,
123			CedictURL:    cfg.Dict.CedictURL,
124			EcdictURL:    cfg.Dict.EcdictURL,
125			AutoDownload: cfg.Dict.AutoDownload,
126			Fuzzy:        cfg.Dict.Fuzzy,
127			APIFallback:  apiFb,
128		})
129	}
130	
131	// SmartDictFromConfig builds the smart-dict engine: the plain dictionary plus an
132	// LLM fallback (resolved provider/model) for misses and too-weak fuzzy matches.
133	// The caller must ensure res.Provider != nil.
134	func SmartDictFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
135		cfg := res.Cfg
136		return engine.NewSmartDict(DictFromConfig(cfg), LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model), engine.SmartDictConfig{
137			CloseDistance: cfg.SmartDict.CloseDistance,
138			Preset:        cfg.SmartDict.Preset,
139		})
140	}
141	
142	// SmartAutoFromConfig builds the smart-auto default: a single word/term is a
143	// dictionary lookup (smart-dict, with an LLM fallback), and a phrase is an LLM
144	// translation via the auto chain (so phrases keep provider→google resilience).
145	// The caller must ensure res.Provider != nil.
146	func SmartAutoFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
147		llm, err := BuildAutoChain(res)
148		if err != nil {
149			// No chain engines (unlikely once a provider exists): fall back to the bare
150			// resolved provider so phrases can still translate.
151			llm = LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model)
152		}
153		return engine.NewSmartAuto(SmartDictFromConfig(res), llm)
154	}
155	
156	// LearnEngineFromConfig builds the engine for learning mode: a bare LLM engine
157	// (the resolved provider/model), bypassing smart-auto/dictionary routing so a
158	// single word still gets the structured tutor treatment. Caller ensures Provider != nil.
159	func LearnEngineFromConfig(res config.Resolved) engine.Engine {
160		return LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model)
161	}
162	
163	// DefineEngine picks the dictionary engine for a definition lookup: the plain
164	// offline dictionary, or smart-dict (with an LLM fallback) when a provider is
165	// available and not overridden. plain forces plain; smart forces smart. It is the
166	// single source of truth shared by `translate define` and the Service.
167	func DefineEngine(res config.Resolved, plain, smart bool) engine.Engine {
168		cfg := res.Cfg
169		if plain || res.Provider == nil {
170			return DictFromConfig(cfg)
171		}
172		if smart || cfg.SmartDict.DefineDefault {
173			return SmartDictFromConfig(res)
174		}
175		return DictFromConfig(cfg)
176	}
```

```text
14	// Service is the warm, transport-agnostic core: it builds the translate/define
15	// engines once at startup and holds the history store for the process lifetime.
16	// A single Service is safe to share across many goroutines — the engines are
17	// concurrency-safe and the store serializes its own writes.
18	//
19	// The Service deliberately never touches state.json (the CLI's remembered pair):
20	// a long-lived server must not fight the interactive CLI over that file.
21	type Service struct {
22		cfg      *config.Config
23		res      config.Resolved
24		trans    engine.Engine // warm translate engine
25		define   engine.Engine // warm define engine
26		store    store.Store   // shared history; nil when disabled / NoHistory
27		provider string        // resolved provider name (for per-request model overrides)
28	
29		source string // resolved default source (usually "auto")
30		home   string // resolved home target
31		away   string // resolved pair "away" language; "" when pair is off
32		pair   bool
33	}
34	
35	// Options tunes Service construction.
36	type Options struct {
37		NoHistory bool // do not open/record history
38	}
39	
40	// Params is one translation request. Empty fields fall back to the Service
41	// defaults resolved at startup; Pair is a tri-state (nil => use the default).
42	type Params struct {
43		Text         string
44		Source       string // "" => service default (usually "auto")
45		Target       string // "" => service home target
46		Preset       string // "" => service default
47		Instructions string // "" => service default
48		Model        string // "" => the warm engine's model
49		MaxAlts      int    // 0 => engine default
50		Pair         *bool  // nil => service default; non-nil overrides
51	}
52	
53	// NewService resolves config (flags empty, env honored) once, warms both engines,
54	// and opens the history store. It fails fast on a misconfigured provider, mirroring
55	// the CLI's guard in runRoot.
56	func NewService(cfg *config.Config, opt Options) (*Service, error) {
57		res := cfg.Resolve(config.Overrides{}, config.ModeCLI)
58		if res.Provider == nil && res.Engine != "auto" {
59			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no provider configured; check %s", config.Path())
60		}
61		trans, err := BuildEngine(res)
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, err
64		}
65		def := DefineEngine(res, false, false)
66		st := openStore(cfg, opt.NoHistory)
67		return newService(cfg, res, trans, def, st), nil
68	}
69	
70	// newService assembles a Service from already-built parts. It is the unexported
71	// seam used by tests to inject stub engines and an in-memory store (no network).
72	func newService(cfg *config.Config, res config.Resolved, trans, def engine.Engine, st store.Store) *Service {
73		source, home, away, pair := resolveRouting(res)
74		provider := ""
75		if res.Provider != nil {
76			provider = res.Provider.Name
77		}
78		return &Service{
79			cfg: cfg, res: res, trans: trans, define: def, store: st,
80			provider: provider, source: source, home: home, away: away, pair: pair,
81		}
82	}
83	
84	// resolveRouting fuzzy-resolves the source/target/pair-with languages the same way
85	// the CLI does (resolvePair + lang.Resolve), so "chinese" → "zh" etc.
86	func resolveRouting(res config.Resolved) (source, home, away string, pair bool) {
87		sm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.Source)
88		tm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.Target)
89		source, home = sm.Code, tm.Code
90		pair = res.Pair
91		if res.Pair {
92			pwm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.PairWith)
93			away = pwm.Code
94		}
95		return source, home, away, pair
96	}
97	
98	// Translate performs a non-streaming translation and records it in history.
99	func (s *Service) Translate(ctx context.Context, p Params) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
100		return s.translate(ctx, p, false, nil)
101	}
102	
103	// TranslateStream performs a streaming translation, delivering tokens to onToken
104	// as they arrive, and records the final result in history.
105	func (s *Service) TranslateStream(ctx context.Context, p Params, onToken func(string)) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
106		return s.translate(ctx, p, true, onToken)
107	}
108	
109	func (s *Service) translate(ctx context.Context, p Params, stream bool, onToken func(string)) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
110		req := s.buildRequest(p, stream)
111		ch, err := s.trans.Translate(ctx, req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, err
114		}
115		res, err := engine.Drain(ch, onToken)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, err
118		}
119		s.record(ctx, res, req.Text, req.Source, req.Target)
120		return res, nil
121	}
122	
123	// buildRequest maps Params onto an engine.Request, mirroring the CLI's oneShot +
124	// EffectiveTarget so the API and CLI route identically.
125	func (s *Service) buildRequest(p Params, stream bool) engine.Request {
126		source := firstNonEmpty(p.Source, s.source)
127		home := firstNonEmpty(p.Target, s.home)
128		pair := s.pair
129		if p.Pair != nil {
130			pair = *p.Pair
131		}
132		target := EffectiveTarget(pair, home, s.away, p.Text)
133	
134		req := engine.Request{
135			Text:     p.Text,
136			Source:   source,
137			Target:   target,
138			Mode:     engine.ModeTranslate,
139			Stream:   stream,
140			MaxAlts:  p.MaxAlts,
141			Preset:   firstNonEmpty(p.Preset, s.res.Preset),
142			Extra:    firstNonEmpty(p.Instructions, s.res.Instructions),
143			Pair:     pair,
144			PairHome: home,
145			PairAway: s.away,
146		}
147		if p.Model != "" {
148			// Scope the override to the resolved provider so a copilot model id never
149			// leaks into an Ollama fallback (see engine.Request.ModelProvider).
150			req.Model = p.Model
151			req.ModelProvider = s.provider
152		}
153		return req
154	}
155	
156	// Define performs a dictionary/definition lookup (not recorded in history, matching
157	// the CLI's `translate define`).
158	func (s *Service) Define(ctx context.Context, word string) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
159		ch, err := s.define.Translate(ctx, engine.Request{Text: word, Mode: engine.ModeDict, Stream: false})
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		return engine.Drain(ch, nil)
164	}
165	
166	// HistoryRecent returns up to limit history records, newest first (empty when
167	// history is disabled).
168	func (s *Service) HistoryRecent(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]store.Record, error) {
169		if s.store == nil {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return s.store.Recent(ctx, limit)
173	}
174	
175	// HistorySearch fuzzy-searches history (empty when history is disabled).
176	func (s *Service) HistorySearch(ctx context.Context, query string, limit int) ([]store.Record, error) {
177		if s.store == nil {
178			return nil, nil
179		}
180		return s.store.Search(ctx, query, limit)
181	}
182	
183	// Close releases the history store.
184	func (s *Service) Close() error {
185		if s.store != nil {
186			return s.store.Close()
187		}
188		return nil
189	}
190	
191	// record persists a successful, complete result. Truncated results (a stream cut
192	// short) are never recorded, so a partial translation is never cached as complete.
193	func (s *Service) record(ctx context.Context, res *engine.TranslateResult, input, source, target string) {
194		if s.store == nil || res == nil || res.Truncated {
195			return
196		}
197		_, _ = s.store.Add(ctx, ToRecord(res, input, source, target))
198	}
199	
200	// openStore opens the history store, or returns nil when history is disabled or
201	// suppressed. Unlike the CLI helper it stays silent on failure (the server logs
202	// separately); a nil store simply disables history for this process.
203	func openStore(cfg *config.Config, noHistory bool) store.Store {
204		if !cfg.History.Enabled || noHistory {
205			return nil
206		}
207		path := cfg.History.Path
208		if path == "" {
209			path = xdgpath.HistoryFile()
210		}
211		st, err := store.OpenJSONL(path)
212		if err != nil {
213			return nil
214		}
215		return st
216	}
217	
218	func firstNonEmpty(a, b string) string {
219		if a != "" {
220			return a
221		}
222		return b
223	}
```

```text
53		flagSpeakLang     string

55	
56	// NewRootCmd builds the root command and its subcommands.
57	func NewRootCmd() *cobra.Command {
58		root := &cobra.Command{
59			Use:   "translate [text...]",
60			Short: "Fast terminal translation (CLI + TUI)",
61			Long: "translate is a fast CLI/TUI translator.\n\n" +
62				"  translate \"hola mundo\" --to en    one-shot\n" +
63				"  echo hola | translate --to en       pipe\n" +
64				"  translate                           interactive TUI",
65			Version:       buildVersion(),
66			SilenceUsage:  true,
67			SilenceErrors: true,
68			// ArbitraryArgs lets bare text fall through to translation while exact
69			// subcommands (config, lang, …) still route. Without it, cobra rejects
70			// `translate "hola"` as an unknown command once subcommands exist.
71			Args: cobra.ArbitraryArgs,
72			RunE: runRoot,
73		}
74		f := root.PersistentFlags()
75		f.StringVarP(&flagTo, "to", "t", "", "target language (fuzzy; e.g. en, chinese)")
76		f.StringVarP(&flagFrom, "from", "f", "", "source language (\"auto\" to detect)")
77		f.StringVar(&flagModel, "model", "", "LLM model id override")
78		f.StringVar(&flagProvider, "provider", "", "provider name (e.g. copilot, ollama)")
79		f.StringVar(&flagEngine, "engine", "", "engine: auto|<provider>|google|dict")
80		f.StringVar(&flagTier, "tier", "", "model tier: default|fast|max")
81		f.StringVar(&flagPreset, "preset", "", "LLM prompt style: concise|contextual|dictionary")
82		f.StringVar(&flagInstructions, "instructions", "", "extra system-prompt guidance (domain focus, etc.)")
83		f.BoolVar(&flagPair, "pair", false, "bidirectional mode: home-language input → --pair-with, else → --to")
84		f.StringVar(&flagPairWith, "pair-with", "", "the other language for --pair (e.g. en)")
85		f.BoolVar(&flagLearn, "learn", false, "learning mode: teach (native→foreign) or grammar-correct (foreign→native)")
86		f.BoolVarP(&flagBilingual, "bilingual", "2", false, "bilingual pipe mode: keep original (with color) + translation beneath (stdin only)")
87		f.StringVar(&flagBilingualMode, "bilingual-mode", "doc", "bilingual strategy: doc (context-aware, one LLM call) | blocks (per-block)")
88		f.BoolVar(&flagJSON, "json", false, "emit the full result as JSON")
89		f.BoolVar(&flagStream, "stream", false, "force token streaming to stdout even when it is not a TTY (for piped consumers, e.g. the Raycast extension)")
90		f.BoolVar(&flagNoHistory, "no-history", false, "do not record this translation in history")
91		f.BoolVar(&flagDebug, "debug", false, "log intermediate decisions (routing, engine choice, dict hit/miss)")
92		f.BoolVarP(&flagSpeak, "speak", "s", false, "speak the foreign side of the result aloud (free TTS)")
93		f.StringVar(&flagSpeakLang, "speak-lang", "", "force the spoken language (e.g. en, zh-TW)")
94	
95		root.SuggestionsMinimumDistance = 2
96		root.AddCommand(newConfigCmd(), newLangCmd(), newDefineCmd(), newHistoryCmd(), newInitCmd(), newDictCmd(), newSpeakCmd(), newServeCmd(), newMcpCmd())
97		return root
98	}
99	
100	// Execute runs the root command with the given (cancellable) context.
101	func Execute(ctx context.Context) error {
102		// Stamp the writing app version into any config Save this run makes.
103		config.Generator = shortVersion()
104		return NewRootCmd().ExecuteContext(ctx)
105	}
106	
107	// overrides collects the explicitly-set flag values.
108	func overrides() config.Overrides {
109		return config.Overrides{
110			Source:       flagFrom,
111			Target:       flagTo,
112			Engine:       flagEngine,
113			Provider:     flagProvider,
114			Model:        flagModel,
115			Tier:         flagTier,
116			Preset:       flagPreset,
117			Instructions: flagInstructions,
118			Pair:         flagPair,
119			PairWith:     flagPairWith,
120			Learn:        flagLearn,
121			Debug:        flagDebug,
122		}
123	}
124	
125	// invocationMode reports whether this run is the one-shot CLI (arguments or piped
126	// stdin) or the interactive TUI (a TTY with no arguments). It mirrors the dispatch
127	// switch in runRoot and is computed before Resolve so the [cli]/[tui] overlay applies.
128	func invocationMode(args []string) config.Mode {
129		if len(args) > 0 {
130			return config.ModeCLI
131		}
132		if !term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
133			return config.ModeCLI
134		}
135		return config.ModeTUI
136	}
137	
138	func runRoot(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
139		ctx := cmd.Context()
140	
141		cfg, created, err := config.Load()
142		if err != nil {
143			return err
144		}
145		if created {
146			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: wrote default config to %s (run `translate init` to customize)\n", config.Path())
147		} else if cfg.Outdated() {
148			// Schema bumps so far are additive: Load already filled any new fields with
149			// their Default() values in memory, so re-saving materializes them on disk
150			// (every existing value preserved) and re-stamps the schema — no wizard
151			// needed. A genuinely breaking change would instead need an explicit
152			// migration here before the re-save.
153			from := cfg.Schema
154			if err := config.Save(cfg); err != nil {
155				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: config is outdated but auto-upgrade failed (%v) — run `translate init`\n", err)
156			} else {
157				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: upgraded config schema v%d→v%d (new settings use defaults; `translate init` to review)\n", from, config.SchemaVersion)
158			}
159		}
160	
161		res := cfg.Resolve(overrides(), invocationMode(args))
162		if res.Debug {
163			// The one-shot CLI logs to stderr; the TUI logs to a file, since its
164			// alt-screen would be corrupted by stderr writes.
165			if invocationMode(args) == config.ModeCLI {
166				debug.Enable(os.Stderr)
167			} else if w := openDebugLog(); w != nil {
168				debug.Enable(w)
169			}
170		}
171		applyLastPair(cfg, &res) // remember_last_pair: seed source/target from state
172		src, tgt := resolvePair(res.Source, res.Target)
173		pairWith := ""
174		if res.Pair {
175			pwm, _ := lang.Resolve(res.PairWith)
176			pairWith = pwm.Code
177		}
178		// Learn mode is bidirectional; ensure a distinct "away" (foreign) language so
179		// direction routing has two sides to choose between.
180		if res.Learn && (pairWith == "" || strings.EqualFold(pairWith, tgt)) {
181			pairWith = defaultAway(tgt)
182		}
183		debug.Logf("resolved: engine=%s tier=%s preset=%s source=%s target=%s pair=%v pair_with=%s learn=%v",
184			res.Engine, res.Tier, res.Preset, src, tgt, res.Pair, pairWith, res.Learn)
185		if res.Pair && !res.Learn && (pairWith == "" || strings.EqualFold(pairWith, tgt)) {
186			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: warning: pair mode is on but pair-with (%q) equals the target (%q) — pair mode is a no-op; set a different pair_with (run `translate init`)\n", pairWith, tgt)
187		}
188	
189		if res.Provider == nil && res.Engine != "auto" {
190			return fmt.Errorf("no provider configured; check %s", config.Path())
191		}
192		eng, err := appcore.BuildEngine(res)
193		if err != nil {
194			return err
195		}
196	
197		// The one-shot CLI path routes a learn request through a bare LLM engine
198		// (bypassing smart-auto/dictionary); the TUI keeps its normal primary engine and
199		// toggles learn at runtime against Params.LearnEngine.
200		learnCLI := res.Learn && invocationMode(args) == config.ModeCLI
201		if learnCLI && res.Provider == nil {
202			return fmt.Errorf("learn mode requires an LLM provider; check %s", config.Path())
203		}
204		oneShotEng := eng
205		if learnCLI {
206			oneShotEng = appcore.LearnEngineFromConfig(res)
207		}
208	
209		st := openStore(cfg)
210		if st != nil {
211			defer st.Close()
212		}
213	
214		switch {
215		case len(args) > 0:
216			text := strings.Join(args, " ")
217			effTgt := appcore.EffectiveTarget(res.Pair, tgt, pairWith, text)
218			r, err := oneShot(ctx, oneShotEng, text, src, effTgt, res.Stream, res.Preset, res.Instructions, res.Pair, tgt, pairWith, res.Learn)
219			if err != nil {
220				return err
221			}
222			recordAndRemember(ctx, st, cfg, r, text, src, effTgt, tgt)
223			if shouldSpeak(cfg) {
224				speakResult(ctx, cfg, r, text, src, effTgt, speakForeign(cfg, pairWith))
225			}
226			return nil
227	
228		case !term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())):
229			b, err := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
230			if err != nil {
231				return err
232			}
233			// Strip ANSI/SGR escapes so colored piped input (e.g. `tldr rg | translate`)
234			// never pollutes the prompt. The raw bytes are retained only for --bilingual,
235			// which needs the original styling for display.
236			text := strings.TrimSpace(bitext.Strip(string(b)))
237			if text == "" {
238				return fmt.Errorf("no input on stdin")
239			}
240			// Bilingual is a multi-block reading view; --json/--learn keep their own
241			// structured output and take precedence.
242			if flagBilingual && !flagJSON && !res.Learn {
243				// doc mode needs an LLM (structured JSON, empty Text confuses
244				// smartauto/chain routing) — build a bare LLM like learn mode; nil when
245				// no provider, in which case runBilingual falls back to per-block.
246				var docEng engine.Engine
247				if res.Provider != nil {
248					docEng = appcore.LearnEngineFromConfig(res)
249				}
250				return runBilingual(ctx, oneShotEng, docEng, string(b), src, tgt, res.Instructions, flagBilingualMode)
251			}
252			effTgt := appcore.EffectiveTarget(res.Pair, tgt, pairWith, text)
253			r, err := oneShot(ctx, oneShotEng, text, src, effTgt, res.Stream, res.Preset, res.Instructions, res.Pair, tgt, pairWith, res.Learn)
254			if err != nil {
255				return err
256			}
257			recordAndRemember(ctx, st, cfg, r, text, src, effTgt, tgt)
258			if shouldSpeak(cfg) {
259				speakResult(ctx, cfg, r, text, src, effTgt, speakForeign(cfg, pairWith))
260			}
261			return nil
262	
263		default:
264			return runTUI(ctx, eng, res, st, src, tgt, pairWith)
265		}
266	}

268	// openDebugLog opens (append) the TUI debug log file, creating the state dir.
269	// Returns nil on failure (debug simply stays off).
270	func openDebugLog() io.Writer {
271		if err := xdgpath.EnsureDirs(); err != nil {
272			return nil
273		}
274		f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(xdgpath.StateDir(), "debug.log"),
275			os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o600)

282	// applyLastPair overrides the resolved source/target with the persisted last
283	// pair when remember_last_pair is on and the user did not pass flags/env.
284	func applyLastPair(cfg *config.Config, res *config.Resolved) {
285		if !cfg.General.RememberLastPair {
286			return
287		}
288		// Pair (and learn) mode anchors BOTH languages from config: Target is the home
289		// language, PairWith is the away language, and routing is decided per input. A
290		// remembered target must not override the home here — if the last session
291		// happened to translate into the away language, restoring it as the home makes
292		// home == away and pair mode collapses to a no-op (the "en⇄en" bug). Source is
293		// always auto-detected in pair mode too, so skip the whole override.
294		if res.Pair {
295			debug.Logf("remember_last_pair: skipped (pair mode anchors languages from config)")
296			return
297		}
298		stt, err := state.Load()
299		if err != nil || stt == nil {
300			return
301		}
302		if flagFrom == "" && os.Getenv("TRANSLATE_SOURCE") == "" && stt.Source != "" {
303			res.Source = stt.Source
304			debug.Logf("remember_last_pair: source ← %s (from state)", stt.Source)
305		}
306		if flagTo == "" && os.Getenv("TRANSLATE_TARGET") == "" && stt.Target != "" {
307			res.Target = stt.Target
308			debug.Logf("remember_last_pair: target ← %s (from state)", stt.Target)
309		}
310	}

312	// openStore opens the history store, or returns nil when history is disabled or
313	// suppressed with --no-history.
314	func openStore(cfg *config.Config) store.Store {
315		if !cfg.History.Enabled || flagNoHistory {
316			return nil
317		}
318		path := cfg.History.Path
319		if path == "" {
320			path = xdgpath.HistoryFile()
321		}
322		st, err := store.OpenJSONL(path)
323		if err != nil {
324			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: history disabled (%v)\n", err)
325			return nil
326		}
327		return st
328	}

330	// recordAndRemember writes the translation to history and persists the last pair.
331	//
332	// target is the effective target actually used (for history); rememberTarget is
333	// the stable home target (== target unless pair mode redirected this one input),
334	// so persisting it keeps pair mode from drifting its home to the away language.
335	func recordAndRemember(ctx context.Context, st store.Store, cfg *config.Config, res *engine.TranslateResult, input, source, target, rememberTarget string) {
336		if st != nil {
337			_, _ = st.Add(ctx, appcore.ToRecord(res, input, source, target))
338		}
339		if cfg.General.RememberLastPair {
340			saveLastPair(source, rememberTarget, res.Engine)
341		}
342	}

344	// saveLastPair persists the source/target pair and source mode.
345	func saveLastPair(source, target, engineName string) {
346		mode := "fixed"
347		if source == "auto" {
348			mode = "auto"
349		}
350		_ = state.Save(&state.State{
351			Source:     source,
352			Target:     target,
353			SourceMode: mode,
354			Engine:     engineName,
355		})
356	}

358	// runTUI launches the interactive Bubble Tea front-end and persists the last
359	// pair on exit.
360	func runTUI(ctx context.Context, eng engine.Engine, res config.Resolved, st store.Store, source, target, pairWith string) error {
361		// A model source for the ^p model picker: the resolved LLM provider (if any).
362		var modelSrc engine.ModelLister
363		modelProvider := ""
364		if res.Provider != nil {
365			modelSrc = appcore.LLMFromProvider(res.Provider, res.Model)
366			modelProvider = res.Provider.Name
367		}
368		// Learn mode (^n) runs against a bare LLM engine; nil when no provider is
369		// configured, in which case the toggle refuses.
370		var learnEng engine.Engine
371		if res.Provider != nil {
372			learnEng = appcore.LearnEngineFromConfig(res)
373		}
374		p := tui.Params{
375			Engines:       buildEngineSet(res, eng),
376			ModelSource:   modelSrc,
377			ModelProvider: modelProvider,
378			Store:         st,
379			Source:        source,
380			Target:        target,
381			Pair:          res.Pair,
382			PairWith:      pairWith,
383			Learn:         res.Learn,
384			LearnEngine:   learnEng,
385			Model:         res.Model,
386			Preset:        res.Preset,
387			Instructions:  res.Instructions,
388			Live:          res.LiveTranslate,
389			DebounceMs:    res.DebounceMs,
390			Speaker:       tuiSpeaker(res.Cfg),
391			Foreign:       speakForeign(res.Cfg, pairWith),
392		}
393		final, err := tea.NewProgram(tui.New(ctx, p), tea.WithContext(ctx)).Run()
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		if res.Cfg.General.RememberLastPair {
398			if fm, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
399				s, t := fm.Pair()
400				saveLastPair(s, t, "")
401			}
402		}
403		return nil
404	}

406	// resolvePair fuzzy-resolves the source and target languages, printing an
407	// "(interpreted X as Y)" note on stderr when a fuzzy correction was applied.
408	func resolvePair(rawSource, rawTarget string) (source, target string) {
409		sm, _ := lang.Resolve(rawSource)
410		tm, _ := lang.Resolve(rawTarget)
411		if !sm.Exact && sm.Score > 0 && !strings.EqualFold(rawSource, sm.Code) {
412			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: interpreted source %q as %s (%s)\n", rawSource, sm.Code, sm.Name)
413		}
414		if !tm.Exact && tm.Score > 0 && !strings.EqualFold(rawTarget, tm.Code) {
415			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: interpreted target %q as %s (%s)\n", rawTarget, tm.Code, tm.Name)
416		}
417		return sm.Code, tm.Code
418	}
419	
420	// oneShot translates text once and prints the result, returning it for history.
421	//
422	// Tokens stream live to stdout only when stdout is a TTY (so `translate x | pbcopy`
423	// stays clean) and --json was not requested. Piped output is the plain translation
424	// with no ANSI; --json emits the full structured result.
425	func oneShot(ctx context.Context, eng engine.Engine, text, source, target string, streamPref bool, preset, instructions string, pair bool, pairHome, pairAway string, learn bool) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
426		stdoutTTY := term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdout.Fd()))
427		// Stream when the config asks for it on a TTY, or when --stream forces it (a
428		// piped consumer like the Raycast extension). --json/--learn are structured
429		// and never stream.
430		stream := (flagStream || (streamPref && stdoutTTY)) && !flagJSON && !learn
431	
432		req := engine.Request{
433			Text:     text,
434			Source:   source,
435			Target:   target,
436			Mode:     engine.ModeTranslate,
437			Stream:   stream,
438			Preset:   preset,
439			Extra:    instructions,
440			Pair:     pair,
441			PairHome: pairHome,
442			PairAway: pairAway,
443			Learn:    learn,
444		}
445		ch, err := eng.Translate(ctx, req)
446		if err != nil {
447			return nil, err
448		}
449	
450		// streamed tracks whether any visible token actually reached stdout. We may
451		// request streaming (stream == true) yet the engine that answers ignores it and
452		// returns a single terminal result with zero tokens — every non-streaming engine
453		// does (the dictionary/smart-dict single-word path, google, a provider that fell
454		// back to a non-streaming completion). In that case nothing was printed during
455		// draining, so the final result must still be emitted below.
456		var onTok func(string)
457		streamed := false
458		if stream {
459			onTok = func(t string) {
460				if t != "" {
461					streamed = true
462				}
463				fmt.Print(t)
464			}
465		}
466		res, err := engine.Drain(ch, onTok)
467		if err != nil {
468			if streamed {
469				fmt.Println() // terminate any partial streamed line before the error surfaces
470			}
471			return nil, err
472		}
473	
474		// Never downgrade silently: if the auto-chain fell back, say which engine
475		// failed and why, and how to switch.
476		for _, w := range res.Warnings {
477			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: warning: %s\n", w)
478		}
479		if len(res.Warnings) > 0 && res.Learn == nil {
480			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: used %q (switch with --engine, or check the model/provider)\n", res.Engine)
481		}
482	
483		switch {
484		case flagJSON:
485			enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
486			enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
487			if err := enc.Encode(res); err != nil {
488				return nil, err
489			}
490		case res.Learn != nil:
491			fmt.Print(renderLearnCLI(res))
492		case streamed:
493			fmt.Println() // newline after the streamed tokens
494		default:
495			// Piped output, or a non-streaming engine answered a stream request with no
496			// tokens (dictionary single-word, google, …): emit the full result now.
497			fmt.Println(res.Translation)
498		}
499		return res, nil
500	}
501	
502	// runBilingual renders the "immersive" bilingual view for piped input: every
503	// original block is printed verbatim (ANSI/color intact) and a translation is shown
504	// beneath each prose block; indented command/code blocks are echoed untranslated.
505	// mode "doc" (default) translates the whole document in one context-aware call via
506	// docEng (a bare LLM); "blocks" (or a doc-mode fallback) translates each prose block
507	// in isolation via blockEng. Pair and learn routing are out of scope for this view.
508	func runBilingual(ctx context.Context, blockEng, docEng engine.Engine, raw, source, target, instructions, mode string) error {
509		blocks := bitext.Split(raw)
510		if len(blocks) == 0 {
511			return fmt.Errorf("no input on stdin")
512		}
513	
514		var translations map[int]string
515		switch mode {
516		case "blocks":
517			translations = bilingualBlocks(ctx, blockEng, blocks, source, target, instructions)
518		default: // "doc"
519			if docEng != nil {
520				if t, ok := bilingualDoc(ctx, docEng, blocks, source, target, instructions); ok {
521					translations = t
522				}
523			}
524			if translations == nil { // no LLM provider, or the doc call failed/was unparseable
525				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "translate: bilingual: doc mode unavailable, using per-block")
526				translations = bilingualBlocks(ctx, blockEng, blocks, source, target, instructions)
527			}
528		}
529	
530		dim := dimFunc(term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdout.Fd())))
531		fmt.Print(bitext.Render(blocks, translations, dim))
532		return nil
533	}
534	
535	// bilingualBlocks translates each prose block in isolation (concurrent, bounded).
536	// The original strategy: works with any engine, but has no cross-block context.
537	func bilingualBlocks(ctx context.Context, eng engine.Engine, blocks []bitext.Block, source, target, instructions string) map[int]string {
538		translations := make(map[int]string)
539		errs := make(map[int]error)
540		var mu sync.Mutex
541		var wg sync.WaitGroup
542		sem := make(chan struct{}, 5) // bound concurrent LLM calls
543	
544		for i, blk := range blocks {
545			if blk.Kind != bitext.Prose {
546				continue
547			}
548			wg.Add(1)
549			go func(i int, plain string) {
550				defer wg.Done()
551				sem <- struct{}{}
552				defer func() { <-sem }()
553	
554				// Force concise (Stream:false, Preset:"") so each block maps to exactly
555				// one translation — contextual/dictionary presets would reshape output.
556				r, err := translateOnce(ctx, eng, engine.Request{
557					Text:   plain,
558					Source: source,
559					Target: target,
560					Mode:   engine.ModeTranslate,
561					Extra:  instructions,
562				})
563				mu.Lock()
564				defer mu.Unlock()
565				if err != nil {
566					errs[i] = err
567					return
568				}
569				tr := strings.TrimSpace(r.Translation)
570				// Drop echoes (proper nouns / already-target text): nothing to add beneath.
571				if tr != "" && !strings.EqualFold(tr, strings.TrimSpace(plain)) {
572					translations[i] = tr
573				}
574			}(i, blk.Plain)
575		}
576		wg.Wait()
577	
578		// Never fail silently: report untranslated blocks (originals still printed).
579		if len(errs) > 0 {
580			var sample error
581			for _, e := range errs {
582				sample = e
583				break
584			}
585			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "translate: warning: %d block(s) not translated (%v)\n", len(errs), sample)
586		}
587		return translations
588	}
589	
590	// bilingualDoc translates the whole document in ONE context-aware structured call:
591	// the model sees every block (prose + code as context) and returns a JSON map of
592	// prose-segment number → translation. Returns ok=false when structured output isn't
593	// available (no LLM, error, or unparseable/empty reply) so the caller falls back.
594	func bilingualDoc(ctx context.Context, eng engine.Engine, blocks []bitext.Block, source, target, instructions string) (map[int]string, bool) {
595		var segs []engine.Segment
596		proseBlock := make(map[int]int) // prose-segment number (1-based) → block index
597		n := 0
598		for i, blk := range blocks {
599			switch blk.Kind {
600			case bitext.Prose:
601				n++
602				proseBlock[n] = i
603				segs = append(segs, engine.Segment{Text: blk.Plain})
604			case bitext.Code:
605				segs = append(segs, engine.Segment{Text: blk.Plain, Code: true})
606			}
607		}
608		if n == 0 {
609			return map[int]string{}, true // nothing to translate
610		}
611	
612		r, err := translateOnce(ctx, eng, engine.Request{
613			Bilingual: true,
614			Segments:  segs,
615			Source:    source,
616			Target:    target,
617			Mode:      engine.ModeTranslate,
618			Extra:     instructions,
619		})
620		if err != nil {
621			debug.Logf("bilingual doc: LLM call failed: %v", err)
622			return nil, false
623		}
624		if r == nil || len(r.Bilingual) == 0 {
625			warn := ""
626			if r != nil && len(r.Warnings) > 0 {
627				warn = r.Warnings[0]
628			}
629			debug.Logf("bilingual doc: empty/unparseable structured result (warnings: %q)", warn)
630			return nil, false
631		}
632	
633		translations := make(map[int]string)
634		for num, tr := range r.Bilingual {
635			bi, ok := proseBlock[num]
636			if !ok {
637				continue
638			}
639			t := strings.TrimSpace(tr)
640			if t != "" && !strings.EqualFold(t, strings.TrimSpace(blocks[bi].Plain)) {
641				translations[bi] = t
642			}
643		}
644		return translations, true
645	}
646	
647	// translateOnce runs a single non-streaming translation and returns the result,
648	// draining the engine channel with no token callback. It is the printing-free core
649	// shared by bilingual mode.
650	func translateOnce(ctx context.Context, eng engine.Engine, req engine.Request) (*engine.TranslateResult, error) {
651		ch, err := eng.Translate(ctx, req)
652		if err != nil {
653			return nil, err
654		}
655		return engine.Drain(ch, nil)
656	}
657	
658	// dimFunc returns the styler for bilingual translation lines. It dims (grey) only
659	// when stdout is a TTY and NO_COLOR is unset, so piping the output onward stays
660	// clean; otherwise it is the identity function. The original block's own ANSI is
661	// never touched — only our added translation lines are styled.
662	func dimFunc(stdoutTTY bool) func(string) string {
663		if !stdoutTTY || os.Getenv("NO_COLOR") != "" {
664			return func(s string) string { return s }
665		}
666		style := lg.NewStyle().Foreground(lg.Color("#6C6C6C"))
667		return func(s string) string { return style.Render(s) }
668	}
669	
670	// defaultAway picks the "away" (foreign) language for learn/pair mode when none is
671	// configured: English speakers default to learning zh-TW, everyone else to en. It
672	// mirrors the TUI ^g heuristic so the CLI and TUI agree.
673	func defaultAway(home string) string {
674		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(home), "en") {
675			return "zh-TW"
676		}
677		return "en"
678	}
679	
680	// renderLearnCLI formats a learn-mode result as plain text (no ANSI, pipe-safe).
681	func renderLearnCLI(res *engine.TranslateResult) string {
682		l := res.Learn
683		if l == nil {
684			return res.Translation + "\n"
685		}
686		var b strings.Builder
687		if l.Direction == "correct" {
688			corrected := strings.TrimSpace(l.Corrected)
689			if corrected == "" {
690				corrected = res.Translation
691			}
692			b.WriteString("✔ " + corrected + "\n")
693			if s := strings.TrimSpace(l.Translation); s != "" {
694				b.WriteString("  ↳ " + s + "\n")
695			}
696			for _, is := range l.Issues {
697				frag := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(is.Span+" → "+is.Fix, " → "), " → "))
698				expl := strings.TrimSpace(is.Explanation)
699				line := expl
700				switch {
701				case frag != "" && expl != "":
702					line = frag + ": " + expl
703				case frag != "":
704					line = frag
705				}
706				if line != "" {
707					b.WriteString("  ✎ " + line + "\n")
708				}
709			}
710		} else {
711			tr := strings.TrimSpace(l.Translation)
712			if tr == "" {
713				tr = res.Translation
714			}
715			b.WriteString(tr + "\n")
716			for _, v := range l.Vocab {
717				head := "  • " + v.Term
718				if v.Pos != "" {
719					head += " (" + v.Pos + ")"
720				}
721				if v.Phonetic != "" {
722					head += " " + v.Phonetic
723				}
724				if v.Meaning != "" {
725					head += " — " + v.Meaning
726				}
727				b.WriteString(head + "\n")
728			}
729			for _, ex := range l.Examples {
730				b.WriteString("  ✎ " + ex.Foreign + "\n")
731				if s := strings.TrimSpace(ex.Native); s != "" {
732					b.WriteString("    ↳ " + s + "\n")
733				}
734			}
735		}
736		if s := strings.TrimSpace(l.Notes); s != "" {
737			b.WriteString("  ⓘ " + s + "\n")
738		}
739		return b.String()
740	}
741
```

```text
68	interface Prefs {

75	const PROBE_DIRS = [
76	  join(homedir(), ".local", "bin"),
77	  "/opt/homebrew/bin",
78	  "/usr/local/bin",
79	  join(homedir(), "go", "bin"),
80	];

82	let cachedBin: string | undefined;
83	
84	/**
85	 * Resolve an ABSOLUTE path to the translate binary. Raycast runs under launchd
86	 * with a restricted PATH that does not inherit the shell rc, so a bare
87	 * `translate` throws ENOENT — we probe known install dirs (preference first).
88	 */
89	export function resolveBinary(): string {
90	  const prefs = getPreferenceValues<Prefs>();
91	  if (prefs.binaryPath && existsSync(prefs.binaryPath)) return prefs.binaryPath;
92	  if (cachedBin) return cachedBin;
93	  for (const dir of PROBE_DIRS) {
94	    const candidate = join(dir, "translate");
95	    if (existsSync(candidate)) {
96	      cachedBin = candidate;
97	      return candidate;
98	    }
99	  }
100	  throw new Error(
101	    "translate CLI not found. Set the binary path in extension preferences, or install it (just install / brew install daviddwlee84/tap/translate).",
102	  );
103	}
104	
105	/** True when an error came from resolveBinary failing to locate the CLI. */
106	export function isBinaryMissing(e: unknown): boolean {
107	  return e instanceof Error && e.message.startsWith("translate CLI not found");
108	}
109	
110	function baseEnv(): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
111	  // Ensure the CLI can locate its config.toml (providers/API keys) under launchd.
112	  return { ...process.env, HOME: process.env.HOME ?? homedir() };
113	}
114	
115	export interface TranslateOptions {
116	  to?: string;
117	  from?: string;
118	  engine?: string;
119	  tier?: string;
120	  noHistory?: boolean;
121	  signal?: AbortSignal;
122	}
123	
124	export async function runTranslate(
125	  text: string,
126	  opts: TranslateOptions = {},
127	): Promise<TranslateResult> {
128	  const prefs = getPreferenceValues<Prefs>();
129	  const bin = resolveBinary();
130	  const args = [text, "--to", opts.to ?? prefs.defaultTarget ?? "en", "--json"];
131	  if (opts.from) args.push("--from", opts.from);
132	  const engine = opts.engine ?? prefs.engine;
133	  if (engine) args.push("--engine", engine);
134	  const tier = opts.tier ?? prefs.tier;
135	  if (tier) args.push("--tier", tier);
136	  if (opts.noHistory) args.push("--no-history");
137	
138	  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, args, {
139	    timeout: 60_000, // LLM engines routinely exceed useExec's 10s default
140	    maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
141	    env: baseEnv(),
142	    signal: opts.signal, // cancel a superseded call when the user keeps typing
143	  });
144	  return JSON.parse(stdout) as TranslateResult;
145	}
146	
147	/**
148	 * `translate define <word> --json`. The top-level payload is a TranslateResult
149	 * whose `.dictionary` holds the entry (on a dict hit); on a miss it falls back
150	 * to an LLM definition in `.translation` with a `warnings[]` note.
151	 */
152	export async function runDefine(
153	  word: string,
154	  signal?: AbortSignal,
155	): Promise<TranslateResult> {
156	  const bin = resolveBinary();
157	  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, ["define", word, "--json"], {
158	    timeout: 60_000,
159	    maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
160	    env: baseEnv(),
161	    signal,
162	  });
163	  return JSON.parse(stdout) as TranslateResult;
164	}
165	
166	/**
167	 * `translate history --json` (recent) or `translate history search <q> --json`.
168	 * Both return an array of HistoryEntry. Local + fast (no network).
169	 */
170	export async function runHistory(
171	  query?: string,
172	  limit = 200,
173	  signal?: AbortSignal,
174	): Promise<HistoryEntry[]> {
175	  const bin = resolveBinary();
176	  const q = query?.trim();
177	  const args = q
178	    ? ["history", "search", q, "--json"]
179	    : ["history", "--json", "--limit", String(limit)];
180	  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, args, {
181	    timeout: 30_000,
182	    maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
183	    env: baseEnv(),
184	    signal,
185	  });
186	  const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
187	  return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as HistoryEntry[]) : [];
188	}
189	
190	/** Fire-and-forget TTS via `translate <text> --to <lang> --speak`. */
191	export function speak(text: string, to: string): void {
192	  const bin = resolveBinary();
193	  execFile(bin, [text, "--to", to, "--speak"], { env: baseEnv() }, () => {
194	    /* ignore — best-effort audio */
195	  });
196	}
197	
198	/** The effective CLI config (subset we care about) from `config show --json`. */
199	export interface CliConfig {
200	  general?: {
201	    default_target?: string;
202	    default_source?: string;
203	    debounce_ms?: number;
204	    engine?: string;
205	    tier?: string;
206	    live_translate?: boolean;
207	  };
208	}
209	
210	let cachedConfig: CliConfig | undefined;
211	
212	/**
213	 * Read the CLI's effective config via `translate config show --json` (cached per
214	 * command run). Lets the extension inherit the default target / debounce from
215	 * ~/.config/translate/config.toml when the Raycast preferences are left empty.
216	 */
217	export async function readConfig(): Promise<CliConfig> {
218	  if (cachedConfig) return cachedConfig;
219	  const bin = resolveBinary();
220	  const { stdout } = await pexecFile(bin, ["config", "show", "--json"], {
221	    timeout: 10_000,
222	    maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
223	    env: baseEnv(),
224	  });
225	  cachedConfig = JSON.parse(stdout) as CliConfig;
226	  return cachedConfig;
227	}
228	
229	export interface StreamHandlers {
230	  onData: (chunk: string) => void;
231	  onDone: (code: number | null) => void;
232	  onError: (err: Error) => void;
233	}
234	
235	/**
236	 * Spawn `translate <text> --to <lang> [--engine] --stream` and stream plain-text
237	 * stdout chunks (the `--stream` flag forces streaming over a pipe). Returns a
238	 * cancel function that kills the child (call it on unmount). Whether output arrives
239	 * progressively depends on the provider — ollama streams; copilot-proxy buffers its
240	 * claude responses. `--no-history` avoids duplicating a history row the live view
241	 * may already have recorded.
242	 */
243	export function spawnTranslateStream(
244	  text: string,
245	  opts: TranslateOptions,
246	  h: StreamHandlers,
247	): () => void {
248	  const bin = resolveBinary();
249	  const args = [text, "--to", opts.to ?? "en", "--stream", "--no-history"];
250	  if (opts.engine) args.push("--engine", opts.engine);
251	  if (opts.from) args.push("--from", opts.from);
252	  if (opts.tier) args.push("--tier", opts.tier);
253	
254	  const child = spawn(bin, args, { env: baseEnv() });
255	  child.stdout?.setEncoding("utf8");
256	  child.stdout?.on("data", (d: Buffer | string) => h.onData(d.toString()));
257	  child.on("close", (code) => h.onDone(code));
258	  child.on("error", (err) => h.onError(err));
259	  return () => {
260	    if (!child.killed) child.kill("SIGTERM");
261	  };
262	}
```

```text
1	import { useRef, useState } from "react";
2	import { ActionPanel, Action, Icon, List, showHUD } from "@raycast/api";
3	import { usePromise } from "@raycast/utils";
4	import {
5	  runDefine,
6	  speak,
7	  isBinaryMissing,
8	  TranslateResult,
9	} from "./lib/translate";
10	import { useDebouncedValue } from "./lib/hooks";
11	import { BinaryNotFound } from "./lib/binary-not-found";
12	import { DidYouMean } from "./lib/did-you-mean";
13	
14	export default function Command() {
15	  const [word, setWord] = useState("");
16	  const debounced = useDebouncedValue(word, 500);
17	  const abortable = useRef<AbortController>();
18	
19	  const { data, isLoading, error } = usePromise(
20	    async (w: string): Promise<TranslateResult | undefined> => {
21	      const trimmed = w.trim();
22	      if (!trimmed) return undefined;
23	      return runDefine(trimmed, abortable.current?.signal);
24	    },
25	    [debounced],
26	    { abortable },
27	  );
28	
29	  const pending = word.trim().length > 0 && word.trim() !== debounced.trim();
30	  const showSuggestions =
31	    !!data && !data.dictionary && !!data.suggestions?.length;
32	
33	  return (
34	    <List
35	      isLoading={isLoading || pending}
36	      searchText={word}
37	      onSearchTextChange={setWord}
38	      searchBarPlaceholder="Look up a word…"
39	      isShowingDetail={!!data && !showSuggestions}
40	    >
41	      {error ? (
42	        isBinaryMissing(error) ? (
43	          <BinaryNotFound />
44	        ) : (
45	          <List.EmptyView
46	            icon={Icon.Warning}
47	            title="Lookup failed"
48	            description={String(error.message ?? error)}
49	          />
50	        )
51	      ) : !data ? (
52	        <List.EmptyView
53	          icon={Icon.Book}
54	          title="Define"
55	          description="Type a word to look it up."
56	        />
57	      ) : showSuggestions ? (
58	        <DidYouMean suggestions={data.suggestions!} onPick={setWord} />
59	      ) : (
60	        <List.Item
61	          title={data.dictionary?.word ?? word}
62	          subtitle={data.engine}
63	          detail={
64	            <List.Item.Detail
65	              markdown={renderDefine(data, word)}
66	              metadata={renderMetadata(data)}
67	            />
68	          }
69	          actions={
70	            <ActionPanel>
71	              <Action.CopyToClipboard
72	                title="Copy Definition"
73	                content={data.translation}
74	              />
75	              <Action.CopyToClipboard
76	                title="Copy Word"
77	                content={data.dictionary?.word ?? word}
78	                shortcut={{ modifiers: ["cmd"], key: "i" }}
79	              />
80	              <Action
81	                title="Speak"
82	                icon={Icon.SpeakerHigh}
83	                onAction={async () => {
84	                  speak(
85	                    data.dictionary?.word ?? word.trim(),
86	                    data.target || "en",
87	                  );
88	                  await showHUD("Speaking…");
89	                }}
90	              />
91	            </ActionPanel>
92	          }
93	        />
94	      )}
95	    </List>
96	  );
97	}
98	
99	function renderDefine(r: TranslateResult, word: string): string {
100	  const d = r.dictionary;
101	  if (d) {
102	    const lines = [`# ${d.word}`];
103	    if (d.phonetic) lines.push(`*/${d.phonetic}/*`);
104	    lines.push("");
105	    for (const m of d.meanings ?? []) {
106	      lines.push(`## ${m.part_of_speech}`);
107	      for (const def of m.definitions ?? []) {
108	        lines.push(
109	          `- ${def.definition}${def.example ? `\n  - _${def.example}_` : ""}`,
110	        );
111	      }
112	      lines.push("");
113	    }
114	    return lines.join("\n");
115	  }
116	  // No dictionary entry — LLM fallback lives in `translation`.
117	  const lines = [`# ${word}`, "", r.translation, ""];
118	  if (r.warnings?.length) lines.push("---", ...r.warnings.map((w) => `> ${w}`));
119	  return lines.join("\n");
120	}
121	
122	function renderMetadata(r: TranslateResult) {
123	  return (
124	    <List.Item.Detail.Metadata>
125	      <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label title="Engine" text={r.engine ?? "—"} />
126	      {r.dictionary?.phonetic ? (
127	        <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label
128	          title="Phonetic"
129	          text={r.dictionary.phonetic}
130	        />
131	      ) : null}
132	      {r.model ? (
133	        <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label title="Model" text={r.model} />
134	      ) : null}
135	      {r.dictionary?.source_url ? (
136	        <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Link
137	          title="Source"
138	          target={r.dictionary.source_url}
139	          text="link"
140	        />
141	      ) : null}
142	    </List.Item.Detail.Metadata>
143	  );
144	}
```

```text
45	  const ctx = props.launchContext;
46	  const prefDebounce = Number(prefs.liveDebounceMs);
47	  const [debounceMs, setDebounceMs] = useState(
48	    prefDebounce > 0 ? Math.max(250, prefDebounce) : 700,
49	  );
50	  const [text, setText] = useState(ctx?.seed ?? "");
51	  const [to, setTo] = useState(ctx?.to || prefs.defaultTarget || "");
52	  const [engine, setEngine] = useState("");
53	
54	  // Inherit the default target + debounce from the CLI config (~/.config/translate)
55	  // when the matching Raycast preference is empty. Falls back to "en"/700ms.
56	  useEffect(() => {
57	    if (to && prefs.liveDebounceMs) return; // nothing to inherit
58	    readConfig()
59	      .then((cfg) => {
60	        if (!to && cfg.general?.default_target)
61	          setTo(cfg.general.default_target);
62	        if (!prefs.liveDebounceMs && cfg.general?.debounce_ms)
63	          setDebounceMs(Math.max(250, cfg.general.debounce_ms));
64	      })
65	      .catch(() => {
66	        /* fall back to defaults */
67	      })
68	      .finally(() => setTo((t) => t || "en"));
69	  }, []);
70	
71	  // On first open, seed the input from the current selection (or clipboard), per the
72	  // "Prefill input from" preference — unless we were launched with a seed (from
73	  // Translate Selection). Empty when there's nothing to grab, so you can also type.
74	  useEffect(() => {
75	    if (ctx?.seed) return;
76	    const mode = prefs.prefill ?? "selection";
77	    if (mode === "none") return;
78	    (async () => {
79	      let seed = "";
80	      if (mode === "selection") {
81	        try {
82	          seed = (await getSelectedText()).trim();
83	        } catch {
84	          seed = "";
85	        }
86	      } else if (mode === "clipboard") {
87	        seed = ((await Clipboard.readText()) ?? "").trim();
88	      }
89	      if (seed) setText(seed);
90	    })();
91	  }, []);
92	
93	  // Only translate once the user pauses (debounce) and cancel superseded in-flight
94	  // calls (abortable) — so typing a phrase no longer fires an LLM call per keystroke.
95	  const debouncedText = useDebouncedValue(text, debounceMs);
96	  const abortable = useRef<AbortController>();
97	
98	  const { data, isLoading, error } = usePromise(
99	    async (
100	      q: string,
101	      target: string,
102	      eng: string,
103	    ): Promise<TranslateResult | undefined> => {
104	      const trimmed = q.trim();
105	      if (!trimmed) return undefined;
106	      return runTranslate(trimmed, {
107	        to: target,
108	        engine: eng || undefined,
109	        signal: abortable.current?.signal,
110	      });
111	    },
112	    [debouncedText, to, engine],
113	    { abortable },
114	  );
115	
116	  // Keep the loading bar up while the typed text is still ahead of the debounced value.
117	  const pending =
118	    text.trim().length > 0 && text.trim() !== debouncedText.trim();
119	
120	  // A single-word typo routes to the dictionary and comes back with an empty
121	  // translation + fuzzy suggestions — surface them as "did you mean?".
122	  const showSuggestions =
123	    !!data && !data.translation && !!data.suggestions?.length;
124	
125	  return (
126	    <List
127	      isLoading={isLoading || pending}
128	      searchText={text}
129	      onSearchTextChange={setText}
130	      searchBarPlaceholder="Type text to translate…"
131	      isShowingDetail={!!data?.translation}
132	      searchBarAccessory={
133	        <List.Dropdown tooltip="Target language" value={to} onChange={setTo}>
134	          {LANGS.map((l) => (
135	            <List.Dropdown.Item key={l.value} title={l.title} value={l.value} />
136	          ))}
137	        </List.Dropdown>
138	      }
139	    >
140	      {error ? (
141	        isBinaryMissing(error) ? (
142	          <BinaryNotFound />
143	        ) : (
144	          <List.EmptyView
145	            icon={Icon.Warning}
146	            title="Translation failed"
147	            description={String(error.message ?? error)}
148	          />
149	        )
150	      ) : !data ? (
151	        <List.EmptyView
152	          icon={Icon.Globe}
153	          title="Translate"
154	          description="Enter text above and pick a language."
155	        />
156	      ) : showSuggestions ? (
157	        <DidYouMean suggestions={data.suggestions!} onPick={setText} />
158	      ) : data.translation ? (
159	        <List.Item
160	          title={data.translation}
161	          subtitle={data.engine}
162	          detail={
163	            <List.Item.Detail
164	              markdown={renderMarkdown(data)}
165	              metadata={renderMetadata(data)}
166	            />
167	          }
168	          actions={
169	            <ActionPanel>
170	              <Action.CopyToClipboard
171	                title="Copy Translation"
172	                content={data.translation}
173	              />
174	              <Action.Paste
175	                title="Paste Translation"
176	                content={data.translation}
177	              />
178	              <Action.Push
179	                title="Translate (streaming)"
180	                icon={Icon.Text}
181	                shortcut={{ modifiers: ["cmd"], key: "return" }}
182	                target={
183	                  <StreamView
184	                    text={debouncedText.trim()}
185	                    to={to}
186	                    engine={engine}
187	                  />
188	                }
189	              />
190	              <Action.CopyToClipboard
191	                title="Copy Source Text"
192	                content={debouncedText.trim()}
193	                shortcut={{ modifiers: ["cmd"], key: "i" }}
194	              />
195	              <Action
196	                title="Speak"
197	                icon={Icon.SpeakerHigh}
198	                onAction={async () => {
199	                  speak(debouncedText.trim(), to);
200	                  await showHUD("Speaking…");
201	                }}
202	              />
203	              <ActionPanel.Submenu
204	                title="Engine"
205	                icon={Icon.Gear}
206	                shortcut={{ modifiers: ["cmd"], key: "e" }}
207	              >
208	                {ENGINES.map((e) => (
209	                  <Action
210	                    key={e.value || "auto"}
211	                    title={e.title}

213	                    onAction={() => setEngine(e.value)}
214	                  />
215	                ))}
216	              </ActionPanel.Submenu>

224	          description="No result for this input — try rephrasing or another engine (⌘E)."
225	        />
226	      )}

231	function renderMarkdown(r: TranslateResult): string {
232	  // Plain paragraph (not an H1) so long translations read comfortably.
233	  const lines = [r.translation, ""];
234	  if (r.alternatives?.length)
235	    lines.push("## Alternatives", ...r.alternatives.map((a) => `- ${a}`), "");
236	  if (r.notes) lines.push("## Notes", r.notes, "");
237	  if (r.warnings?.length)
238	    lines.push("## Warnings", ...r.warnings.map((w) => `> ${w}`), "");
239	  return lines.join("\n");
240	}
241	
242	function renderMetadata(r: TranslateResult) {
243	  return (
244	    <List.Item.Detail.Metadata>
245	      <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label title="Engine" text={r.engine ?? "—"} />
246	      {r.model ? (

252	      />
253	      <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label title="Target" text={r.target} />
254	      {typeof r.confidence === "number" ? (
255	        <List.Item.Detail.Metadata.Label
256	          title="Confidence"
257	          text={r.confidence.toFixed(2)}
258	        />
259	      ) : null}
260	    </List.Item.Detail.Metadata>
261	  );
262	}
```

```text
3	/**
4	 * A Google-style "did you mean?" section built from the engine's fuzzy dictionary
5	 * suggestions — returned (in `TranslateResult.suggestions`) when a single-word
6	 * lookup/translation has no exact match, e.g. "cononical" → ["canonical", …].
7	 * Picking one re-runs the search with the corrected term. Full sentences skip this
8	 * (they go to the LLM, which corrects typos implicitly).
9	 */
10	export function DidYouMean({
11	  suggestions,
12	  onPick,
13	}: {
14	  suggestions: string[];
15	  onPick: (s: string) => void;
16	}) {
17	  const [best, ...rest] = suggestions;
18	  return (
19	    <List.Section title="Did you mean?">
20	      {[best, ...rest].map((s, i) => (
21	        <List.Item
22	          key={s}
23	          title={s}
24	          icon={i === 0 ? Icon.Checkmark : Icon.MagnifyingGlass}
25	          accessories={i === 0 ? [{ text: "closest" }] : undefined}
26	          actions={
27	            <ActionPanel>
28	              <Action
29	                title="Use This"
30	                icon={Icon.ArrowRight}
31	                onAction={() => onPick(s)}
32	              />
33	            </ActionPanel>
34	          }
35	        />
36	      ))}
37	    </List.Section>
38	  );
39	}
```

```text
1	import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
2	import { ActionPanel, Action, Detail } from "@raycast/api";
3	import { spawnTranslateStream } from "./translate";
4	
5	/** A pushed Detail that streams `translate … --stream` output token-by-token.
6	 *  Opt-in from the Translate view (⌘↵) — useful for long text and streaming
7	 *  engines; on a buffering provider it simply appears after first-token latency. */
8	export function StreamView({
9	  text,
10	  to,
11	  engine,
12	}: {
13	  text: string;
14	  to: string;
15	  engine?: string;
16	}) {
17	  const [md, setMd] = useState("");
18	  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
19	  const acc = useRef("");
20	
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    acc.current = "";
23	    setMd("");
24	    setIsLoading(true);
25	    const cancel = spawnTranslateStream(
26	      text,
27	      { to, engine: engine || undefined },
28	      {
29	        onData: (chunk) => {
30	          acc.current += chunk;
31	          setMd(acc.current);
32	        },
33	        onDone: () => setIsLoading(false),
34	        onError: (err) => {
35	          acc.current += `\n\n> error: ${err.message}`;
36	          setMd(acc.current);
37	          setIsLoading(false);
38	        },
39	      },
40	    );
41	    return cancel;
42	  }, [text, to, engine]);
43	
44	  return (
45	    <Detail
46	      isLoading={isLoading}
47	      markdown={md || "…"}
48	      navigationTitle={`Translate → ${to}`}
49	      actions={
50	        <ActionPanel>
51	          <Action.CopyToClipboard title="Copy Translation" content={md} />
52	          <Action.Paste title="Paste Translation" content={md} />
53	        </ActionPanel>
54	      }
55	    />
56	  );
57	}
```

```text
1	import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
2	
3	/** Debounce a value so an expensive call only fires after the user pauses typing. */
4	export function useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
5	  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
6	  useEffect(() => {
7	    const id = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
8	    return () => clearTimeout(id);
9	  }, [value, delayMs]);
10	  return debounced;
11	}
12
```

```text
16	func newHistoryCmd() *cobra.Command {
```
